aspecteditems.description_cn: 由岛屿决议会安置，以便能在升登前或下行后休息。

aspecteditems.name: Delightful Repose
aspecteditems.description: Placed by the Curia of the Isle to allow a rest before an ascent. Or after a descent.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 由岛屿决议会安置，以便能在升登前或下行后休息。

aspecteditems.name: Soft Blue Sofa
aspecteditems.description: Gently complements the seas and skies around Brancrug.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 温柔地填补了布兰库格周围的大海与天空。

aspecteditems.name: Chaise-Longue of Conclusions
aspecteditems.description: Here the Librarian van Lauren lay, to ponder the paradoxes he had inherited from Harries.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 图书管理员范·劳伦曾躺在上面，思索自己从哈里斯那儿继承来的悖论。

aspecteditems.name: Russet Couch
aspecteditems.description: A utilitarian item, arms varnished, upholstery shiny with hard use.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一样实用的物件，扶手上涂着清漆，衬垫因频繁使用而光滑发亮。

aspecteditems.name: Brooding Sofa
aspecteditems.description: Here sink in gloom.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在此沉沦于晦暗之思。

aspecteditems.name: Sea-Green Sofa
aspecteditems.description: Here, Lady Eva Dewulf would weave her intrigues, and satisfy her secret craving for sentimental novels.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在这儿，伊娃·德沃尔夫女士会编织她的阴谋，以及满足自己对伤感小说的私密渴望。

aspecteditems.name: Treasury of Shelters
aspecteditems.description: It's like an armoury for not getting pneumonia.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 就像是一处抵御肺炎的军械库。

aspecteditems.name: 'Authority'
aspecteditems.description: Once this shepherd's crook represented the authority of the Church. Perhaps the Suppression Bureau kept it here because they liked the idea of authority, in general.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 这根牧羊人曲柄杖曾代表着教会的权威。防剿局把它留在这儿或许是因为他们一向喜欢权威的概念。

aspecteditems.name: 'Lady de Braose'
aspecteditems.description: Sometimes known affectionately as 'the first Eva'. Lady de Braose never visited the Isle, but it was her generous endowment that allowed the Abbey to thrive and grow in the thirteenth century.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 有时被亲切地称为“第一位伊娃”。德·布劳斯夫人从未造访过这座小岛，但正是她的慷慨捐赠使修道院在13世纪得以繁荣发展。

aspecteditems.name: 'Lady Rowena'
aspecteditems.description: For as long as there has been a Hush House, there have been stories of its enigmatic protectress.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 自噤声居屋存在以来，关于它神秘女守护者的故事就一直时有流传。

aspecteditems.name: Painter's Stool
aspecteditems.description: A comfortable enough perch.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一处足够舒适的栖枝。

aspecteditems.name: Carpenter's Stool
aspecteditems.description: Irreparably wobbly. Perhaps it's haunted.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 晃得厉害。说不定有什么在作祟。

aspecteditems.name: Violet Stool
aspecteditems.description: Damson cushion, holly-wood marquetry.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 黑紫坐垫，冬青木镶花。

aspecteditems.name: Prison Stool
aspecteditems.description: A cheerful lavender colour, possibly to encourage rehabilitative enthusiasm.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 明快的薰衣紫，或许是为了激励起改过自新的热情。

aspecteditems.name: Librarian's Stool
aspecteditems.description: A sea-coloured, star-ornamented stool.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一把色如海洋，星形花纹的凳子。

aspecteditems.name: Moon Stool
aspecteditems.description: Polished to pallor by the posteriors of past Librarians.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 被往届图书管理员的屁股擦得煞白。

aspecteditems.name: Pale Stool
aspecteditems.description: Bleached beech.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 漂白的山毛榉木。

aspecteditems.name: Plain Stool
aspecteditems.description: The most reliable object imaginable. How old is it?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 人能想象出的最可靠之物。它究竟有多老了？

aspecteditems.name: Cypress-Wood Table
aspecteditems.description: The only piece of furniture Kitty Mazarine brought East.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 凯蒂·马扎林东渡时带来的唯一一件家具。

aspecteditems.name: Chronsichord
aspecteditems.description: A music-box that only performs once; a typewriter that can only send one message; a clock that can only strike Now.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 只能演奏一次的音乐盒；只能发送一条信息的打字机；只能在现在报时的钟。

aspecteditems.name: Dearday Lens
aspecteditems.description: A fiendishly simple - and wretchedly fragile - optical device.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种极度简单——以及极度脆弱的——光学装置。

aspecteditems.name: Flushed Mommet
aspecteditems.description: A crimson-stained little cloth doll with merry button eyes and a frill of twitching ribbons.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一个沾满了深红污渍的小布娃娃，有着快活的纽扣眼睛和不断颤动的褶边。

aspecteditems.name: Pale Mommet
aspecteditems.description: A gently twitching little cloth doll with melancholy button eyes and a frill of coloured ribbons.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一个微微抽搐着的小布娃娃，有着忧郁的纽扣眼睛和彩色的缎带褶边。

aspecteditems.name: Hen's Egg
aspecteditems.description: Delicious when cooked, alarming when dropped.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 烹饪时美味可口，摔落时惊心动魄。

aspecteditems.name: Gull's Egg
aspecteditems.description: 'At Brancrug, even the Hours are kind, and the years are kinder.' This egg might stay viable quite a while yet.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “在布兰库格，连司辰都是温和的，而岁月更是温和有加。”接下来相当一段时间内，这枚蛋大抵都能保持活性。

aspecteditems.name: Outsized Egg
aspecteditems.description: An ostrich egg? A crocodile egg? Surely neither.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一枚鸵鸟蛋？或是鳄鱼蛋？想必都不是。

aspecteditems.name: Viper Egg
aspecteditems.description: A serpent in waiting.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一条静候降生的蛇。

aspecteditems.name: Bolt of Buttercup Linen
aspecteditems.description: Suitable for a summer suit or an altar-veil.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 适合做成夏衣或圣坛罩布。

aspecteditems.name: Bolt of Pale Silk
aspecteditems.description: Suitable for handkerchiefs or anbaric experiments.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 适合做成手帕或用于电学实验。

aspecteditems.name: Bolt of Moss-Green Velvet
aspecteditems.description: Suitable for a ball gown or a jewel's cushion.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 适合做成舞会长裙或是珠宝展垫。

aspecteditems.name: Frith-Weft
aspecteditems.description: The 'peace-weaving' for which the Abbey was famous, long before it was named for St Brandan, when it was the Abbey of the Black Dove or the Abbey of the White Crow
aspecteditems.description_cn: 修道院早在被命名为圣布伦丹前便以其“平息之网”闻名，彼时它还被称为黑鸽修道院或白鸦修道院。

aspecteditems.name: Human Hair
aspecteditems.description: Of interest to wig-makers, cushion-stuffers, and crude sorcerers.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 假发匠、填垫工与粗浅的巫师都会对它感兴趣。

aspecteditems.name: Swaddled Thunder
aspecteditems.description: A storm swathed in subtle threads, ready to be released with a few judicious snips.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 紧裹于精密纺线中的雷暴，几下精确的裁剪就可将之释放。

aspecteditems.name: Wyrd-Weft
aspecteditems.description: A weave that either entrains, or follows, Fate. It's hard to be sure which.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种牵引，或追随命运的织纹。很难说清楚到底是哪个。

aspecteditems.name: Warmly Coloured Yarns
aspecteditems.description: A blushing nest of possibilities.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一团鲜红的可能性。

aspecteditems.name: Agave Aeterna
aspecteditems.description: agave aeterna, the 'history plant', unlike its cousin the century plant, blooms every year. Perhaps it will do so forever.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 永恒龙舌兰，“历史植物”。与它被称为世纪植物的表亲不同，它每年都会绽放。也许它会永远如此。

aspecteditems.name: Aglaophotis
aspecteditems.description: The rosy colour of good memories; but not the colour of the rose.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 美好回忆的瑰色；但并不是玫瑰的颜色。

aspecteditems.name: Blue Crown
aspecteditems.description: The sky-coloured petals of blue crown are always cold as frost.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它的天蓝色花瓣总是寒冷如霜。

aspecteditems.name: Fragrant Chalice
aspecteditems.description: A glorious globe of wine-coloured flowers.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 绚烂的酒红色花球。

aspecteditems.name: Honeyscar Jasmine
aspecteditems.description: Sweet-scented, night-blooming.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 甜美芳香，夜间绽放。

aspecteditems.name: Lenten Rose
aspecteditems.description: Pretty; poisonous; no true rose.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 妩媚；有毒；不是真正的玫瑰。

aspecteditems.name: Moth Orchid
aspecteditems.description: The 'true moth', the flower that opens as it changes.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “真正的飞蛾”——随蜕变而绽放之花。

aspecteditems.name: Pot of Malachite Daisies
aspecteditems.description: Thomas Dewulf was fond of these. It's not what you'd expect from Thomas Dewulf.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 托马斯·德沃尔夫喜欢这些小花。很难想象他会这样。

aspecteditems.name: Potted Pink Orchid
aspecteditems.description: A little smudge of dawn.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 拂晓的一抹浅痕。

aspecteditems.name: Potted White Orchid
aspecteditems.description: A little smudge of snow.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 白雪的一抹痕迹。

aspecteditems.name: Shadowless Silk
aspecteditems.description: A variant of the Persian silk tree, golden as the Shadowless Kings.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 波斯合欢的变种，金灿如无影众王。

aspecteditems.name: Sea Holly
aspecteditems.description: Umbelled spiny flowers, the steel-blue of a winter afternoon.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 伞形而多刺的花朵，呈冬日午后的钢蓝色。

aspecteditems.name: Trumpeter's Lily
aspecteditems.description: A glorious efflorescence of sunset orange.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 绚烂盛放的橘色夕晖。

aspecteditems.name: Vase of Amaryllis
aspecteditems.description: A soft-flowered ornament.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件柔嫩的花饰。

aspecteditems.name: Vase of Golden Bulrushes
aspecteditems.description: It won't need watering.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它不需要浇水。

aspecteditems.name: Vase of Carnations
aspecteditems.description: A bright-flowered ornament.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件鲜艳的花饰。

aspecteditems.name: Vase of Lilies
aspecteditems.description: An elegant ornament.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件高雅的装饰品。

aspecteditems.name: Vase of Roses
aspecteditems.description: A proud ornament.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件华美的装饰品。

aspecteditems.name: Batter
aspecteditems.description: [Add Dripping for something horrifyingly tasty; or use with a Knife and Onions.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [添加烤肉滴油以制作某种好吃得惊人的东西；或者用刀将其与洋葱一同处理。]

aspecteditems.name: Beef
aspecteditems.description: [Roast it, or perhaps marinate it first - if you have something Intoxicating for the marinade.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [烤制，或者先腌制——如果你有某种含酒精饮料可作腌料的话。]

aspecteditems.name: Marinated Beef (Uncooked)
aspecteditems.description: Tangy with the harbingers of a roastful destiny.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 扑鼻浓香，预示其将被烤制的命运。

aspecteditems.name: Butter
aspecteditems.description: [Try adding an egg or a Pheasant; mix with Sugar or Flour in a Bowl; or the culinarily intrepid might add spice and Moly.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [尝试加入蛋或野鸡；在碗中与糖或面粉混合；而勇于冒险的厨师可能会加入香料与摩吕。]

aspecteditems.name: Dough
aspecteditems.description: [Mix with an egg in a Bowl to make cake batter, or use to bake various delectable pies. For the sweeter pies, you'll want to use spices too.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [在碗里加鸡蛋搅拌以制作蛋糕面糊，或者用以烤制各种美味的派。若想制作味道更甜的派，就再加些香料。]

aspecteditems.name: Cake Batter
aspecteditems.description: [Add something sweet like jam - or add Almonds and spices.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [加入果酱之类的甜味剂——或者加入杏仁与香料]

aspecteditems.name: Dripping
aspecteditems.description: [Not an appetising name, but use it to make rich leek or onion soup - or with or without a knife, use dripping to exalt Potatoes to their full potential.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [它的名字说不上开胃，但可用于制作香浓的韭葱或洋葱汤——或用它来激发出土豆的全部风味，用不用刀都行。]

aspecteditems.name: Flour
aspecteditems.description: Pulverised grains, bread's precursor. [Mix with Butter or Milk for Dough; mix with Water for Batter.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 磨碎的谷物，面包的前身。[加入黄油或牛奶揉成生面团，加水则能得到面糊。]

aspecteditems.name: Mackerel
aspecteditems.description: Eat it while it's fresh or keep it while it's salted.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 趁鲜吃掉，或在腌渍后贮存。

aspecteditems.name: Marinated Onions
aspecteditems.description: Add it to Mackerel for Soused Mackerel.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 把它和鲭鱼一起做成醋渍鲭鱼。

aspecteditems.name: Meringue
aspecteditems.description: Add to milk for a legendary dessert. Or, with Spicing, add to apples or pears - even to mushrooms, if you're feeling perverse.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 加入奶来做一种传奇的甜点。或者加入香料，以及苹果或者梨子——如果你想更另类些，加蘑菇。

aspecteditems.name: Pheasant
aspecteditems.description: [Roast it, or add Butter if you intend to jug it.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [烤着吃。如果想焖着吃，就加黄油。]

aspecteditems.name: Pilchards
aspecteditems.description: [Pickle them alone; or they're pretty good on toast.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [可以单独腌渍；搭配吐司也很美味。]

aspecteditems.name: Potatoes
aspecteditems.description: [Slice 'em with a Knife and add dripping to make Game Chips; or roast 'em with or without dripping.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [用刀切条，加入烤肉滴油以制成野味薯条；加不加烤肉滴油都能烤着吃。]

aspecteditems.name: Sugar
aspecteditems.description: [Cream it with Butter in a mixing bowl; add Almonds and spices for Jumble; or with an egg, a Bowl, and care, you can make Meringue.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [在搅拌碗里与黄油一并打发；加入杏仁与香料以制作甜饼；或者用一枚蛋，一只碗，并妥加操作，做出蛋白酥。]

aspecteditems.name: Creamed Sugar
aspecteditems.description: A precursor to Sticky Toffee Pudding (with bread) and to Fudge (without bread): both notorious as founding crimes of twentieth-century culinary debauchery.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 此物加面包可以制成黏太妃糖布丁，不加面包也可以制成乳脂软糖：二者皆为二十世纪烹饪界奢靡放纵之风的奠基之作，臭名昭著。

aspecteditems.name: Catsclaw
aspecteditems.description: Watch the thorns.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 小心刺。

aspecteditems.name: Eva's Locks
aspecteditems.description: A pale wrack washed up on the beach by Brancrug.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 被冲上布兰库格海滩的苍白海藻。

aspecteditems.name: Healing Herbs
aspecteditems.description: A helpful harvest of healing herbs.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 疗效显著的草药收获。

aspecteditems.name: C&H Second Flush Assam  (Packet)
aspecteditems.name_cn: C＆H公司夏摘阿萨姆茶（包装）
aspecteditems.description: Tea from the land of the real unicorn, imported by Cater & Hero.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 来自真实的独角兽栖息之地的茶饮，由凯特&赫洛有限公司进口。

aspecteditems.name: Veiled Goddess Lapsang Souchong (Packet)
aspecteditems.name_cn: 面纱女神正山小种（包装）
aspecteditems.description: Named for an enigmatic minor deity whose charge is the healing of burns.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 以一位司掌疗愈烧伤的神秘次级神明命名。

aspecteditems.name: Potted Bamboo
aspecteditems.description: Water it, and you can almost hear it growing.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 浇灌它，你几乎能听见它生长的声音。

aspecteditems.name: Tiny Potted Tree
aspecteditems.description: Tiny as a ship in a bottle.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 就如瓶中船那样迷你。

aspecteditems.name: Potted Dragon Tree
aspecteditems.description: A determined, spiky little survivor.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一位坚定而带刺的小小幸存者。

aspecteditems.name: Potted Fern
aspecteditems.description: A pleasantly primitive plant.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一棵讨人喜欢的原始植物。

aspecteditems.name: Potted Snake Plant
aspecteditems.description: A sturdy sun-loving relic from a warmer place.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一株健壮而喜阳的活化石，来自更加温暖的地区。

aspecteditems.name: Potted Monstera
aspecteditems.description: A defiant plant.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一株叛逆的植物。

aspecteditems.name: Potted Avidity
aspecteditems.description: A lush and hungry ornament.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一盆茂盛且饥渴的装饰。

aspecteditems.name: Vase of Gorse
aspecteditems.description: As Cornish a plant as any.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 不逊色于康沃尔的任何植物。

aspecteditems.name: Vase of Rushes
aspecteditems.description: A subtle ornament.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件精巧的装饰品。

aspecteditems.name: Amethyst Ampoule
aspecteditems.description: Were it released from the glass, it would be quite another colour.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 若是将内容物倒出玻璃瓶，它将呈现出截然不同的颜色。

aspecteditems.name: Wolf-Snow Ampoule
aspecteditems.description: Far too cold ever to melt in anything but the hottest noonday sun. It will, very gradually, consume human flesh.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 此物冷到任何事物都无法将之融化，除了最炎热的正午阳光。它会一点一点，极缓地蚕食人类的血肉。

aspecteditems.name: Ashartine
aspecteditems.description: Lies written in Ashartine tend to fade or be misspelt. It's legible in the dark. An Ink of Revelation.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 用阿夏廷写下的谎言会褪色或错拼。它在黑暗中也清晰可辨。一种启示之墨。

aspecteditems.name: Asimel
aspecteditems.description: A silver ink that can only be made and used in dreams. An Ink of Revelation.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种仅可于梦中制作与使用的银色墨水。一种启示之墨。

aspecteditems.name: Azoth
aspecteditems.description: A solvent of frightening voracity.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种有着骇人贪欲的溶剂。

aspecteditems.name: Black Sapphire Wash
aspecteditems.description: The colour, perhaps, of the doors of the House of the Moon.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 这颜色许是月亮居屋之门的色彩。

aspecteditems.name: Catwink
aspecteditems.description: The smell of catwink puts off vermin; but it is very difficult to read in sunlight. An Ink of Containment.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 猫瞬墨的气味能驱赶害虫；但它在阳光下难以被阅读。一种收容之墨。

aspecteditems.name: Iotic Essence
aspecteditems.description: 'In the later operations of the Forge, the Madrugad yields to the true Forge of Days, and the essence begins to redden.' The bit about the 'true Forge of Days' nearly got St Melancthe burned for heresy, but no-one ever said she was wrong about the second part.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “在铸炉的后期运转中，昕旦让位于真正的白日铸炉，这种精华也开始变红。”圣梅兰瑟关于“真正的白日铸炉”的说辞差点害她因异端言论被烧死，但从没人指出她关于第二部分的说法有错。

aspecteditems.name: Xanthotic Essence
aspecteditems.description: The rich gold of a summer afternoon. 'If sunlight precedes moonlight,' St Anselm observed, 'the Meniscate must precede the Madrugad; and the light that was lost will remain.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: 夏日午后的浓金色。“如果日光先于月光，”圣安塞姆曾注意到，“则弧月必先于昕旦；而失落之光将留存。”

aspecteditems.name: Holiest Hemolymph
aspecteditems.description: Thirza Blake claimed that she first synthesised this from her own tears. She was almost certainly lying.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 蒂尔扎·布雷克声称她最初是用自己的眼泪合成这东西的，几乎能确信她在说谎。

aspecteditems.name: Houndsgall
aspecteditems.description: Books written in Houndsgall are more likely to return to their owner, or one to whom they have been legitimately sold. An Ink of Containment.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 用猃瘿墨写出的书更有可能回到它们的主人，或是被合法售予的人手中。一种收容之墨。

aspecteditems.name: Ichor Auroral
aspecteditems.description: No dawn knows only a single colour. No sky knows only a single dawn.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 没有拂晓仅知晓一种颜色。没有天空仅知晓一种拂晓。

aspecteditems.name: Ichor Vitreous
aspecteditems.description: A pale and watchful fluid that can be gathered, sometimes, when the Door-in-the-Eye is opened.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种浅色而警觉的液体，偶尔能在瞳中扉开启时被收集到。

aspecteditems.name: January Sanguinary
aspecteditems.description: Also called sanguis saltandis or, by the ignorantly superstitious, 'true blood of St Januarius'.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 也被称作跃动之血，又或者，按愚昧迷信者的说法，“圣雅纳略的真血”。

aspecteditems.name: Kerosene
aspecteditems.description: For the brightest flame.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 为最明亮的烈火而准备。

aspecteditems.name: Paraffin
aspecteditems.description: For a bright flame.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 为明亮的烈火而准备。

aspecteditems.name: Petrol
aspecteditems.description: Black oil rendered pale.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 稀释的重石油。

aspecteditems.name: Gideon's Soaks
aspecteditems.description: A therapeutic collection of beneficial bottles.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 由有益健康的瓶瓶罐罐组成的疗护组剂。

aspecteditems.name: Regensburg Balm
aspecteditems.description: An invaluable herbal cure introduced to Hush House by the physician Natan after his exile from Regensburg.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种无价的草药制剂，被流亡自雷根斯堡的纳坦医生引进噤声居屋。

aspecteditems.name: Marakat
aspecteditems.description: The encaustum terminale of the Fifth History. The colour of the Principle that once occupied the place that Heart does now. In the Fifth History itself, the cult of Marakat was everywhere suppressed, but it's sometimes been venerated otherwise. [Use an Encaustum ink with your Journal to make Determinations and record Histories. If the Hours listen, the world changes.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 第五史的终刻墨。与之同色的准则曾占据着如今的心的位置。在第五史中，有关石翠的崇拜受到普遍压制，但它有时还是会以其他方式被崇敬。[用一种终刻墨书写你的日记，以裁定与记录历史。若是司辰将之聆听，世界便会为之改写。]

aspecteditems.name: Nillycant
aspecteditems.description: The encaustum terminale of the Third History. It's the bleak white-blue of Winter. It has spawned an itinerant order of secret celebrants who regard Worms as semi-gods, and who are sometimes called on to celebrate difficult funerals. [Use an Encaustum ink with your Journal to make Determinations and record Histories. If the Hours listen, the world changes.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 第三史的终刻墨，冬之阴郁蓝白。它催生了一个视蠕虫为半神的秘仪托钵修会，他们有时会被召唤去主持棘手的葬礼。[用一种终刻墨书写你的日记，以裁定与记录历史。若是司辰将之聆听，世界便会为之改写。]

aspecteditems.name: Scintillate Oil
aspecteditems.description: Cater & Hero's Finest Scintillate Oil.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 凯特与赫洛公司最优质的烁油。

aspecteditems.name: Umbrous Oil
aspecteditems.description: Cater & Hero's First-Grade Umbrous Oil.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 凯特与赫洛公司的头等暗油。

aspecteditems.name: Oscillate Oil
aspecteditems.description: Cater & Hero's Finest Oscillate Oil.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 凯特与赫洛公司最优质的颤油。

aspecteditems.name: Orpiment Exultant
aspecteditems.description: The encaustum terminale of the Fourth History. It's the incandescent orange of Forge. One ingredient - it's been, as it were, long-rumoured - is the blood of candescents. Certain Masonic and related traditions venerate what they call 'O.E'. [Use an Encaustum ink with your Journal to make Determinations and record Histories. If the Hours listen, the world changes.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 第四史的终刻墨，铸之炽橙。长久以来，一直有传言称它的原料之一就是炽热者的鲜血。某共济会组织在典仪中呼之为“O·E”，并对其膜拜至极。[用一种终刻墨书写你的日记，以裁定与记录历史。若是司辰将之聆听，世界便会为之改写。]

aspecteditems.name: Paint: Blue
aspecteditems.description: The sky is rarely this colour.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 天空鲜少是这种颜色。

aspecteditems.name: Paint: Dusk-Blue
aspecteditems.description: This paint is the precise colour of the Atlantic Ocean at four o'clock on a clear autumn afternoon.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 这种油漆是对大西洋在晴朗秋日午后四点时颜色的精确复现。

aspecteditems.name: Paint: Palest Blue
aspecteditems.description: Snow is not quite this colour.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 落雪不过略似此种颜色。

aspecteditems.name: Paint: Bosk-Green
aspecteditems.description: The Wood is probably not this colour.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 林地可未必是这种颜色。

aspecteditems.name: Paint: Green
aspecteditems.description: Trees are rarely this colour.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 树木鲜少是这种颜色。

aspecteditems.name: Paint: Moth-Gold
aspecteditems.description: Moths are seldom this colour.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 飞蛾可不常是这种颜色。

aspecteditems.name: Paint: Pink
aspecteditems.description: People are never this colour.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 活人绝不会是这种颜色。

aspecteditems.name: Paint: Red
aspecteditems.description: Blood is only occasionally this colour. If they say more research is needed, don't listen.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 血液只偶尔是这种颜色。如果他们说需要就此事做更多研究，别听进去。

aspecteditems.name: Paint: Yellow
aspecteditems.description: This paint is nothing like the sun.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 这油漆压根不像太阳。

aspecteditems.name: Perhibiate
aspecteditems.description: Which binds to the one whose name is there written. A minor Ink of Power.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 会和用它写下的名字绑定。一种次级的力量之墨。

aspecteditems.name: Perinculate
aspecteditems.description: Deadly. Use gloves to read texts produced with this pigment. An Ink of Power (sometimes considered an Unsanctioned Ink).
aspecteditems.description_cn: 十分致命。由这种墨水写下的文本需要戴手套才能阅读。一种力量之墨（有时被认为是一种未经批准的墨水）。

aspecteditems.name: Porphyrine
aspecteditems.description: The encaustum terminale of the Second History. It's the glowing crimson-mauve of the Secret Histories. Porphyrine was venerated in secret by a confraternity of corresponding Cluniacs and Benedictines. [Use an Encaustum ink with your Journal to make Determinations and record Histories. If the Hours listen, the world changes... Porphyrine might also be used to compose a petition for the labyrinth season, if you can provide at least 20 of , , or ; no , , or at all; and suitable writing material.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 第二史的终刻墨。秘史之熠熠紫红。某些克吕尼会士和本笃会士组成的兄弟会在暗中敬拜贵紫。[用一种终刻墨书写你的日记，以裁定与记录历史。若是司辰将之聆听，世界便会为之改写…… 如果你能提供至少20点的，，或 ；且不包含 ，或 ；及准备好适合书写的材料，贵紫也可用于撰写一份能唤来迷宫时节的恳愿书。]

aspecteditems.name: Stargall Ink
aspecteditems.description: An ink traditionally (but only rarely) made with meteoric iron; a minor Ink of Power.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种在传统上（但实际很少）用陨铁制成的墨水；一种次级的力量之墨。

aspecteditems.name: Glassfinger Toxin
aspecteditems.description: 'What is within, without; what is without, within.' A poison sacred to the votaries of the Meniscate.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “内外相易，表里互替。”一种对弧月信徒来说地位神圣的毒素。

aspecteditems.name: Turpentine
aspecteditems.description: An odorous eraser of errors.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种有气味的错误擦除剂。

aspecteditems.name: Uzult
aspecteditems.description: The ink in which the First History was recorded by the Unwise Mortal. Uzult is the bright yellow-gold of Lantern. Light lingers on it for a little while even in the dark. Gold is not needed to mix Uzult, but amber is. Unobtrusive shrines to Uzult could sometimes be found in the churches of the Unconquered Sun.  [Use an Encaustum ink with your Journal to make Determinations and record Histories. If the Hours listen, the world changes.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 不智凡人用以记录第一史的墨水，珀金是灯之明亮金黄。即使在黑暗中，光芒也会在其上盘桓片刻。调合珀金无需黄金，但需琥珀。无敌太阳教会的教堂中偶能发现供奉它的不起眼神龛。[用一种终刻墨书写你的日记，以裁定与记录历史。若是司辰将之聆听，世界便会为之改写。]

aspecteditems.name: Yewgall Ink
aspecteditems.description: A variant of iron gall ink, particularly difficult to erase; a minor Ink of Power.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 铁瘿墨的变种，尤难擦除；一种次级的力量之墨。

aspecteditems.name: Bisclavret's Knot
aspecteditems.description: The bisclavret is the half-human hill-child of these parts, and this is its sign.
aspecteditems.description_cn: Bisclavret（狼骑）是活动于这附近一带的半人丘陵之子，此乃其符号。

aspecteditems.name: Midnight Mark
aspecteditems.description: A blemish left on a page (or a skin) by a careful incision (or a judicious sting) to preserve a little of the power of night.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一个通过小心地雕凿（或精确地扎刺）在纸张（或皮肤）上留下的污点，用以保存黑夜力量的些许余痕。

aspecteditems.name: Salt-Sign
aspecteditems.description: Too bad it won't last. But then again, what does?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 可惜它并不能长久存续，但话说回来，又有什么能呢？

aspecteditems.name: Year-Tally
aspecteditems.description: A chitty worth an additional year of life, scrupulously obtained through carefully balanced thaumaturgic attention to the Cindered Tally of the Madrugad.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一张价值一年额外寿命的单据，通过小心地平衡昕旦对灰烬账簿那玄妙的关注取得。

aspecteditems.name: Ambergris Chunk
aspecteditems.description: Never, never, never call it 'whale vomit'.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 永远，永远，永远别管它叫“鲸鱼呕吐物”。

aspecteditems.name: Arsenic
aspecteditems.description: A poison sometimes known as 'the Message of the Swan'.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 这种毒药有时会被称为“天鹅之讯”。

aspecteditems.name: Atlantic Amber
aspecteditems.description: Sunset's colours, pine's blood.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 日落之色，松树之血。

aspecteditems.name: Awakened Feather
aspecteditems.description: Alive to every draught and spark.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 对每一丝气息与电火花都活力四射。

aspecteditems.name: Beeswax
aspecteditems.description: It begins as a flower. [Beeswax can be used to make candles, if you have a skill with the Chandlery aspect.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它始于一朵鲜花。[蜂蜡可以用来制作蜡烛——只要你会一项带有“制烛术”性相的技艺。]

aspecteditems.name: Cinnabar
aspecteditems.description: A bright scarlet powder with a silvery brilliance locked within.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 里面封存着银光闪闪的猩红粉末。

aspecteditems.name: Curious Seashell
aspecteditems.description: Brancrug is said to lie in the Bounds where the world ends. Odd creatures have made their dying way to the beach.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 据说布兰库格位于世界尽头的边境附近。怪异的生物曾于濒死之际爬至海滩，在此死去。

aspecteditems.name: Driftwood Fragment
aspecteditems.description: Long ago there was a forest between the waves of Brancrug Bay. This driftwood is not nearly that old, but it's shared salt with its lost forerunners…
aspecteditems.description_cn: 很久以前，在布兰库格湾的波涛中有一片森林。这段浮木没有如此古老，但它与它那失落的先祖共享同一份海盐……

aspecteditems.name: Gervinite
aspecteditems.description: An alloy equivalent in some respects to the clockmaker's invar - but instead of a constant weight, it retains the same origin in every history.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种合金，从某种角度看类似于钟表匠的不变钢——但不变的并非它的重量，而是它在每重历史中的起源。

aspecteditems.name: Glue
aspecteditems.description: A substance that ensures the continued proximity of things to other things.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 确保一样东西与另一样东西一直紧密无间的物质。

aspecteditems.name: Hawthorn Blank
aspecteditems.description: A wood favoured by the Horned-Axe.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种为双角斧所青睐的木料。

aspecteditems.name: Leathy Lees
aspecteditems.description: The dark aftermath of a dark drink.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一场黑暗痛饮的黑暗残渣。

aspecteditems.name: Lignum Vitae Blank
aspecteditems.description: The hardest of all woods.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在所有木材中最为坚硬。

aspecteditems.name: Westcott's Compounds
aspecteditems.description: Reagents and activants to enhance alchemical operations, or the flavour of one's pipe tobacco.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 有助于炼金术实验的进行，或是用作增进烟草风味的试剂与催化剂。

aspecteditems.name: T.R.N. Limited Drinking Cocoa (Packet)
aspecteditems.name_cn: T.R.N.有限公司可可饮料（包装）
aspecteditems.description: T.R.N.'s Spices and Savours Department markets this as 'the Secret Sacrament of the Last Inca!'
aspecteditems.description_cn: T.R.N.有限公司的香料与滋味部将其形容为“印加末帝的神秘圣餐！”

aspecteditems.name: Dawnlion Coffee (Packet)
aspecteditems.description: Coffee from beyond the great deserts.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 来自大漠彼端的咖啡。

aspecteditems.name: Evening Isles Coffee (Packet)
aspecteditems.description: Coffee from beyond the sunset sea.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 来自日落之海彼端的咖啡。

aspecteditems.name: Rose-Pearl
aspecteditems.description: Surprisingly common in these waters.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在这些水域里出人意料地常见。

aspecteditems.name: Refulgin
aspecteditems.description: A white so pure that it remains visible even in utter darkness, like the moon, or an insistent cat.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 如此纯粹的白色，即便在一片漆黑中依旧可见，宛若明月，亦或一只引人注目的猫。

aspecteditems.name: Quartz Chunk
aspecteditems.description: Ice, rock, winking light.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 寒冰、岩石、瞬目之光。

aspecteditems.name: Rags
aspecteditems.description: Scraps of fabric. Possibly useful as fuel.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一些碎布，兴许能当燃料。

aspecteditems.name: Bitterblack Salts
aspecteditems.description: Bitter as chicory, dark as secrets, but the first rung of the traditional alchemical ascent.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 苦如菊苣，黑如秘密，但这是传统炼金术的第一步。

aspecteditems.name: Sand
aspecteditems.description: An hourglass, of course, is sand contained by sand.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 沙漏，就是沙中盛沙

aspecteditems.name: Phosphorescent Scrapings
aspecteditems.description: Rendered inert, but still luminous.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 已经失活，但仍闪烁着荧光。

aspecteditems.name: Wooden Scraps
aspecteditems.description: Scraps of wood. Possibly useful as fuel.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一些碎木头，兴许能当燃料。

aspecteditems.name: Sea-Glass
aspecteditems.description: Smooth as an egg, frosted like a winter window.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 光滑如卵；面若霜覆，如冬日之窗。

aspecteditems.name: Granite Slab
aspecteditems.description: Long-cold volcano-blood.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 冷却已久的火山之血。

aspecteditems.name: Serpentinite Slab
aspecteditems.description: The grey-green root-rock of the Cornish coast.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 康沃尔郡海滨那灰绿色的基岩。

aspecteditems.name: Tanglebrag
aspecteditems.description: A clot of wood, leaves and feathers that might draw the attention of the entity called Knotwingknot.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一团纠结在一起的木头、树叶与羽毛，可能引起一位名为异结翼的存在之注意。

aspecteditems.name: Labhitic Tincture
aspecteditems.description: A much more potent preparation can be extracted from the remains of a labhite, but labhites generally frown on this technique.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 从狻猊的遗骸里可以提炼出另一种强力得多的制剂，但狻猊们基本都反对这一技术。

aspecteditems.name: Whispering Sand
aspecteditems.description: White-silver sand in which the voice of the waves lingers...
aspecteditems.description_cn: 萦绕着浪涛之声的银白沙粒……

aspecteditems.name: Wire (Copper)
aspecteditems.description: The Malachite's metal.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 石绿的金属。

aspecteditems.name: Wire (Gold)
aspecteditems.description: The Lionsmith has sometimes been associated with this metal… as has the Hour called the Flowermaker.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 狮子匠有时会被与这种金属联系在一起……被称为制花人的司辰也是如此。

aspecteditems.name: Wire (Orichalcum)
aspecteditems.description: A metal which alters its estate in every age, but in every age can be used to catalyse the azoth.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种性质随着时代而改变的金属，不过在每个时代，它都能用来催化阿佐特。

aspecteditems.name: Wire (Silver)
aspecteditems.description: The Meniscate's metal.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 弧月的金属。

aspecteditems.name: Wire (Steel)
aspecteditems.description: The Colonel's metal.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 上校的金属。

aspecteditems.name: Wire (Tin)
aspecteditems.description: The white metal of the Sun-in-Rags.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 残阳的白色金属。

aspecteditems.name: Desiccated Witchworms
aspecteditems.description: Nasty little things, but almost safe when they're this dead.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 凶恶丑陋的小东西，但它们死到这个份上就基本无害了。

aspecteditems.name: Yew Blank
aspecteditems.description: A wood sacred to the Malachite, who is also called the Ring-Yew; but also the tree that the Dead pass in the dark.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 此乃石绿，亦被称作环杉之神的圣木；但亦是亡者暗中行经之树。

aspecteditems.name: Bittersweet Certainty
aspecteditems.description: Eventually, the Sun-in-Rags always brings its beautiful ending.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 最后，残阳总是带来它的凄美结尾。

aspecteditems.name: Confounding Parable
aspecteditems.description: 'The Moth, the Grail, and the Egg Unhatching all tell different stories of the world's beginning. One of those stories is the oldest, but it may not be the first.' - Abbess Nonna
aspecteditems.description_cn: “飞蛾、圣杯与逆孵之卵各自讲述了关于世界起源的故事。其中一个故事是最古老的，但可能不是最初的。”——诺娜院长

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Contradiction
aspecteditems.description: Something uncomfortable.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 让人不适之事。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: A Stolen Secret
aspecteditems.description: Something I overheard in dreams?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 梦中偶闻之事？

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Fear
aspecteditems.description: 'The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear, and the oldest and strongest kind of fear is fear of the unknown.' - Lovecraft
aspecteditems.description_cn: “人类最古老最强烈的情绪是恐惧，而最古老最强烈的恐惧是对未知的恐惧。”——洛夫克拉夫特

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Foresight
aspecteditems.description: 'Wit's forge and fire-blast, meaning's press and screw.' - Coleridge, 'On Donne's Poetry'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “才智的重塑与迸发，思想的凝炼与回旋。”——柯勒律治，《论多恩的诗歌》

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Gossip
aspecteditems.description: Frivolous, but tasty.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 轻浮，但美味可口。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Hindsight
aspecteditems.description: Some things we can only really understand when they're gone.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 有些事只有在消逝之后才能理解。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Impulse
aspecteditems.description: It doesn't exactly make sense - but I understand it anyway.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 很难说得清——但我还是明白了。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Intuition
aspecteditems.description: You just know, you know?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 你就是明白，你明白吗？

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Loss
aspecteditems.description: Whatever it was, now it isn't.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 无论曾经为何，它都不复从前。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Pattern
aspecteditems.description: Something fits just right.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 恰到好处之事。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Regret
aspecteditems.description: Every choice has its shadow.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 每重选择皆有其影。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Revelation
aspecteditems.description: Some truths come to us from outside, or above.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 有些真相是我们从外面，或从上面得知的。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Salt
aspecteditems.description: Sea-spray, depth-sorrow.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 海上薄雾，渊洋之殇。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Satisfaction
aspecteditems.description: Some appetites are easier to satisfy than others.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 有些欲望比其他的更容易满足。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Scent
aspecteditems.description: Green scents recall rain.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 绿茵之香让人想起雨水。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Sight
aspecteditems.description: 'The eye sees more than the heart knows.' - Blake
aspecteditems.description_cn: “眼见胜于心知。”——布雷克

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Solace
aspecteditems.description: Peace after trouble.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 化险为夷。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Sound
aspecteditems.description: A memory lasts longer than an echo. Of course when Speech came into the world, and we could cast echoes into words, things got more complicated.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 回忆比回声更持久。当然，当言辞进入世界，我们可以用语言把回声变成词语时，事情就变得更复杂了。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Storm
aspecteditems.description: There are storms great enough to shake the moon from the sky, and one's thoughts from one's skull.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 世上有足以撼动天上月亮、动摇颅中思想的风暴。

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Taste
aspecteditems.description: 'Every sweet has its sour.' - Emerson
aspecteditems.description_cn: “每种甜蜜都有其酸涩。”——爱默生

aspecteditems.name: Memory: Touch
aspecteditems.description: Craft is learnt through the tips of the fingers.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 手艺唯有通过指尖的触碰方能学习。

aspecteditems.name: Beguiling Melody
aspecteditems.description: A sweet enchantment of a song.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 歌曲中的甜蜜魔咒。

aspecteditems.name: Cheerful Ditty
aspecteditems.description: A rousing little rhythm.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 振奋人心的简单旋律。

aspecteditems.name: Savage Hymn
aspecteditems.description: A music that urges valour and violence.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一段能唤起勇气与狂热的音乐。

aspecteditems.name: Thunderskin's Paean
aspecteditems.description: A song of joyous sacrifice.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一首欢乐的祭歌。

aspecteditems.name: Wistful Air
aspecteditems.description: A half-sorrowful music of half-pleasant longing.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 半悦渴慕的半悲乐音。

aspecteditems.name: Old Moment
aspecteditems.description: You've had them too; those moments when we seem to look out at the world through another's eyes. What if those moments were real?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 你也曾体验过它们；那些我们似乎在以他者的眼睛观察世界的时刻。如果那些时刻是真实存在的呢？

aspecteditems.name: Nameday Riddle
aspecteditems.description: A deceptively intricate riddle that might just teach us who we really are. Gervinus van Lauren was notoriously fond of these.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一个看似简单实则复杂的谜语,它兴许能教会我们认识真正的自己。格维努斯·范·劳伦以酷爱这些谜语而闻名。

aspecteditems.name: Secret Threshold
aspecteditems.description: It's not easy to draw our own doors, but it's not impossible.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 绘制我们自己的门绝非易事，但也并非不可能。

aspecteditems.name: Torgue's Cleansing
aspecteditems.description: The librarian Natalia Brulleau learnt this powerful - if unpleasant - technique from the priest and Edge-long, Reverend Torgue.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 图书管理员纳塔莉娅·布鲁洛夫从教士兼刃之长生者图格牧师那儿学到了这种强大——尽管并不令人愉快的技巧。

aspecteditems.name: Wild Surmise
aspecteditems.description: 'Eyes open, skies open!'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “双眼睁大，天穹辽阔！”

aspecteditems.name: Wind-Rumour
aspecteditems.description: 'If the cloud were a canvas, who spread it? If the sky were a sheet, who knotted it?' A Wind-Rumour is an auspice found in the sky by those who look too long, interpretable only by the wise.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “如果云朵是一片画布，是谁把它铺展？如果天空是一面帆篷，是谁把它结起？”风之流言是藏匿于空中的征兆，长久注视天空的人能察觉，但唯有智者才能解读。

aspecteditems.name: Winning Move
aspecteditems.description: Those who've studied the Hours of the Edge often say the world is a war - the Corrivality. Every event that might happen differently is a battle in that war, a contention between alternate outcomes. The Wisdoms can sometimes show those battles might be won.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 那些研习刃之司辰的人常说世界是一场战争——角争。每一个可能以不同方式发生的事件都是那场战争中的一场战斗，是可能的不同结果间的斗争。诸般智慧有时会展示这些战斗可能如何被赢得。

aspecteditems.name: Ascendant Harmony
aspecteditems.description: A bright and ringing music which evokes the blue sweep of the lower heavens.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一段明快且响亮的音乐，唤起了下层天界的蔚蓝天穹。

aspecteditems.name: Curious Hunch
aspecteditems.description: A sudden unlikely certainty.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种突然而未然的确然。

aspecteditems.name: Didumos
aspecteditems.description: No Star is permitted upon Earth, but we may cozen them to dream of us, and the Dream of a Star may take a kind of form, which we call didumos.' - Thomas Dewulf
aspecteditems.description_cn: “星辰不许现于大地之上，但我们或可将其诱入我们梦中。星辰之梦许会以一种形式出现，我们称之为孪星降梦。”——托马斯·德沃尔夫

aspecteditems.name: Earth-Sign
aspecteditems.description: 'In the Tracks of Beasts, in the Convolutions of his own Carapace, in Egg-vein and Shell-shadow, the Many-Eyed One found the Signs which can be History.' An Earth-Sign is an auspice traced on the cloaked shape of the earth, perceptible to the sensitive, interpreted only by the wise.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “于野兽的踪迹里，于他自身介壳的沟回中，于卵之脉与壳之影，多目者发现了那可为历史之兆。”大地之兆是刻画在大地上的征兆，敏感的人能察觉，但唯有智者才能解读。

aspecteditems.name: Enduring Reflection
aspecteditems.description: Refine what is; recall what remains.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 精炼现有；唤回余留。

aspecteditems.name: Forbidden Epic
aspecteditems.description: 'The attention of the Hours is drawn to the bloodiest wars. Afterwards, the Histories are braided like hair.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “众司辰被最为血腥的战争吸引了注意。而后，重重历史被编结如发辫。”

aspecteditems.name: Horizon-Sight
aspecteditems.description: 'On a clear autumn day, the story goes, you can see Ys from the Watchman's Tower. I don't know whether that's true. But on a clear day in Numa… you would see the City Unbuilt.' - Dr Brian Levinsen
aspecteditems.description_cn: “传说，如果在晴朗的秋日站在守夜人塔的塔顶眺望远方，就能看到伊苏。我不知道那是真是假，但若是在闰时的晴日这样做……你就会看见那未建之城。”——布莱恩·莱文森博士

aspecteditems.name: Invincible Audacity
aspecteditems.description: 'A general says: when I make the right choice, I win. An Illuminate says: when I win, I determine which choice was the right one.' - Natalia Brulleau
aspecteditems.description_cn: “一位将军说：当我做对了选择，我就能获胜。而照明学家会说：当我获胜，我就能确定哪个选择是对的。”——纳塔莉娅·布鲁洛夫

aspecteditems.name: Hive's Lament
aspecteditems.description: A song of pragmatic sorrow.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一首务实哀伤之歌。

aspecteditems.name: Earthquake Name
aspecteditems.description: Everything comes when it is called - even the nightmares that trouble stone's deep sleep.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 世间万物唤名皆至——哪怕烦扰岩石深眠的梦魇亦是如此。

aspecteditems.name: Occult Scrap
aspecteditems.description: Secret histories are layered beneath the one we know, like the notes in rare wine. The Librarian knows this well.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 隐秘的历史被掩盖于我们所知的历史之下，就像珍贵红酒的气味。而图书管理员通晓此事。

aspecteditems.name: Old Wound
aspecteditems.description: The wound is visible; the pain is not.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 伤口易见，苦痛不然。

aspecteditems.name: Wind-in-Waiting
aspecteditems.description: 'When the sun was redder, when the world was softer, and the Thirty ruled the sky… the winds were better neighbours.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “曾经太阳更赤红，世界更柔软，那时卅者仍主宰天穹……风也更宜为伴。”

aspecteditems.name: Wormwood Dream
aspecteditems.description: If there are laws which apply only in dream - then it must also be that there are crimes which can only be committed there.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 如果有只适用于梦中的法则——就一定有只能在梦中犯下的罪业。

aspecteditems.name: Numen: Merciless Alteration
aspecteditems.description: The fundamental flaw; the irresistible shortcut; the hate that heats; the change that mars; the scar that opens. These are the foulest Histories.  [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Artist and the Archaeologist can win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 根本的缺陷；诱人的捷径；高涨的憎恶；毁灭性变革；绽开的伤疤。这些便是最为恶劣肮脏的历史。[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但艺术家与考古学家可以赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: the Paths of the Sun
aspecteditems.description: The Sun has charted his Paths - paths beyond walls and woods and Bounds. When the Sun lights our way, when we are ready, all of us will enter Eternity - at least, in the right History... [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Cartographer and the Twice-Born can win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 太阳已开辟其道途——那越过围墙与丛林与边境的道途。当太阳照亮我等的道路，当我等就绪之时，我们都将步入永恒——至少，在恰当的历史中如此……[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但制图师与二度降生者可以赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: Back Into Balance
aspecteditems.description: When the travelling Carapace-kinds passed beyond the wave and the sky, they made arrangements for their return. There are Histories where those arrangements might be invoked...  [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Executioner and the Revolutionary can win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 远行的介壳诸族在飞越波涛与天空时便为自己的回归做了准备。有些历史或许能唤起这些准备……[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但处刑者与革命者可以赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: the Bells of Ys
aspecteditems.description: Ys, by her arts, found the strike-tone that shakes the Hours. For this reason among many the Hours discourage traffic with Ys. But a bell cast with this secret could speak the Ys-note…  [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Prodigal and the Revolutionary can win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 伊苏，她用她的技艺找到了可以震颤司辰的钟鸣。众司辰出于诸多原因阻碍着与伊苏的往来，尤其是这一点。然而由这一秘密浇铸而成的钟将能发出伊苏的鸣响……[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但浪子与革命者可以赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: Inescapable Confinement
aspecteditems.description: Everything ultimately comes down to a choice between Eternity and History. There's only one place you're safe from both, and it's not a place anyone would want to be. It's a prison that can only exist in certain Histories...  [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Prodigal and the Archaeologist can win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 万事万物最终都可归结于永恒与历史间的抉择。只有一处地方可以令你免受二者的威胁，而那可不是个谁都乐意待的去处。那是一座只存在于特定历史中的监牢……[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但浪子与考古学家可以赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: the Sun's Weakness
aspecteditems.description: The Sun's sins and the Sun's scars are our salvation. There are Histories where they will trap us - prevent us rising to Eternity - [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Executioner can use it to win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 太阳的罪孽与伤疤乃是我们的救赎。在某些历史中它们将把我们禁锢——阻止我们升入永恒——[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但处刑者可以用它赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: an Irresistible Feast
aspecteditems.description: It was Hunger that made Worms of Dragons - when they consumed the corpses of Hours. Without the savour-secret of the Carapace, their hunger would not have been sufficient. In certain Histories, that savour-secret still has power... [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Artist can use it to win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 当巨龙吞噬司辰的尸身之际，正是此等饥饿使它们蜕化为了蠕虫。要是没有介壳种的滋味之秘，它们的饥饿将永不满足。在特定的历史中，那滋味之秘依旧具有力量……[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但艺术家可以用它赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: Loopholes
aspecteditems.description: When Eternity came into the world, certain prudent powers arranged loopholes: the House of the Moon, the persistence of possibility, the right to vengeance. In the right Histories, those loopholes will open again... [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Twice-Born can win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 当永恒降临世间，某些谨慎的神灵布下了罅隙：月亮的居屋，机会的存续，复仇的权利。在恰当的历史中，这些罅隙将再度开启。[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但二度降生者可以赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: That Old Lost Music
aspecteditems.description: In the right Histories, every song ever sung still lingers in wind and echo, untouched by the demands of Eternity…  [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Symurgist and the Magnate can win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在恰当的历史中，每首曾被吟唱过的歌谣都依旧流连于风与回声中，未被永恒的索求侵扰……[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但鸟慧者与富豪可以赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: the Great Counterfeit
aspecteditems.description: The Sun-in-Splendour and the Forge of the Days could not be joined. But Sunset Celia and the Swan King could. This secret is the trick of it. [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Twice-Born can win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 骄阳与白日铸炉不可结合，但日落西莉亚与天鹅王可以。此秘密便是上述的诡计。[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但二度降生者可以赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: Three Rules
aspecteditems.description: The Hours are bound by their own edicts - even the Chancel and the Calyptra. That's why their deepest rules are secret. In certain Histories, if we know those deepest rules, we know what even the Chancel and the Calyptra may not do.  [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Revolutionary can win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 司辰会被祂们自己立下的敕令束缚——即使是圣坛与根冠。这便是为何祂们最根本的律法秘而不宣。在特定的历史中，如果我们知道了这些最根本的律法，我们就能知晓连圣坛与根冠都无法做到的事。[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但革命者可以赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: a Final Understanding
aspecteditems.description: Eternity and History cannot be reconciled. Freedom cannot be perfection - not unless we understand the paradox of the eternal ending. And only in certain Histories is that paradox possible... [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Magnate can use it to win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 永恒与历史不可调和。自由与完美无法并立——除非我们能参透永恒终结的悖论，且只在特定的历史中此悖论才可能成真……[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但富豪可以用它赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Numen: Weaving the World
aspecteditems.description: The Histories, they say, are braided like hair - or tangled like roots. What is the shape of that knot? Funny you should ask…  [Any Librarian can use this to establish a History and complete the game - but the Symurgist and the Cartographer can win a particular victory.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 诸史，如他们所说，如发辫般编结——亦如树根般纠缠。那结扣会是什么形状？这是个有趣的问题……[任何一位图书管理员都能用它构筑一重历史并完成游戏——但鸟慧者与制图师可以赢得特殊胜利。]

aspecteditems.name: Animal Bones
aspecteditems.description: What remains?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 何物余存？

aspecteditems.name: Essential Periost
aspecteditems.description: What happens when you boil and scrape us down to our utter fundamentals.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 这便是你将我等烹煮刮净，直至彻底唯余根本物质时所得到的。

aspecteditems.name: Heart in a Jar
aspecteditems.description: An offering, or an exhibit?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件祭品，亦或一罐展品？

aspecteditems.name: Sample Jar
aspecteditems.description: A rare fluid drawn from an internal cavity.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 从内腔中抽取的罕见液体。

aspecteditems.name: Skaptodon Fang
aspecteditems.description: It is rare for the Lionsmith to make skaptodons, now; but they are difficult to kill, and they live a very long time.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 狮子匠如今甚少制造剑齿兽了；但是它们很难被杀死，而且寿命极长。

aspecteditems.name: Urn of Ashes
aspecteditems.description: Some poor soul who probably won't mind if they're repurposed for a worthy experiment. I probably wouldn't.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一些可怜的魂灵，它们应该不介意被拿去做点有用的实验，如果是我就不会。

aspecteditems.name: Bronze Spintria
aspecteditems.description: Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. Bronze spintriae usually display the act of shaping on their reverse side.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 隐秘的宝物要用隐秘的货币购买：斯宾特里亚古币。古铜币背面通常画着塑造的场景。

aspecteditems.name: Gold Spintria
aspecteditems.description: Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. Gold spintriae display scenes that are not visible to mortal eyes on their reverse side.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 隐秘的宝物要用隐秘的货币购买：斯宾特里亚古币。古金币背面画着凡人肉眼不可见的情景。

aspecteditems.name: Iron Spintria
aspecteditems.description: Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. Iron spintriae are the lowest denomination, and display scenes of murder on their reverse side.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 隐秘的宝物要用隐秘的货币购买：斯宾特里亚古币。古铁币面值最低，背面画着凶杀的情景。

aspecteditems.name: Silver Spintria
aspecteditems.description: Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. Silver spintriae are more valuable, and usually display scenes of debauchery on their reverse side.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 隐秘的宝物要用隐秘的货币购买：斯宾特里亚古币。古银币更具价值，背面通常画着淫荡的情景。

aspecteditems.name: Tin Spintria
aspecteditems.description: Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. Tin spintriae usually display a wild face on their reverse side: shouting, screaming, or singing?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 隐秘的宝物要用隐秘的货币购买：斯宾特里亚古币。古锡币背面通常画着一副野蛮的面孔：是在呼喊、尖叫，还是纵情歌唱？

aspecteditems.name: Almonds
aspecteditems.description: [Add Sugar and spice to make Jumble.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [加入糖与香料以制作甜饼。]

aspecteditems.name: Apple Charlotte
aspecteditems.description: A classic English pudding of apples stewed with cinnamon and layered with crisp golden bread.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一道经典英式甜点。由炖煮过的苹果与肉桂制成，一层一层铺在酥脆金黄的面包之间。

aspecteditems.name: Ham and Potato Bake
aspecteditems.description: Filling and tasty.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 顶饱又美味。

aspecteditems.name: Mushroom & Potato Bake
aspecteditems.description: Collers tried out a variation on this as Cucurbit prison fare. It was tasty; but allegedly also he was interested in the connection between the modulation of the taste of mushrooms, and the suppression of the Crowned Growth.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 科勒斯曾将它的改良版本作为炼金瓶监狱的供餐。味道不错，但据说他更感兴趣的是调整蘑菇风味与抑制戴冠之孳间的联系。

aspecteditems.name: Roast Beef
aspecteditems.description: Our fathers of old were robust, stout, and strong, And kept open house, with good cheer all day long, Which made their plump tenants rejoice in this song— Oh! The Roast Beef of old England, And old English Roast Beef! - Henry Fielding, The Grub Street Opera
aspecteditems.description_cn:
咱老祖宗结实孔武又有力，
敞门迎客热心肠，整日欢喜好心气
直叫圆润胖房客，快乐沉浸此歌里——
哦！老英格兰里爱吃烤牛的人儿，
还有那悠久的英式烤牛！

——亨利·菲尔丁，《文丐街唱游》

aspecteditems.name: Marinated Roast Beef
aspecteditems.description: But since we have learnt from all-vapouring France To eat their ragouts as well as to dance, We're fed up with nothing but vain complaisance Oh! the Roast Beef of Old England, And old English Roast Beef! - Henry Fielding, The Grub Street Opera
aspecteditems.description_cn:
自从咱沾了法国的飘飘然
吃他们那蔬菜炖肉跳得欢，
咱们对那没用殷勤已厌烦
哦！老英格兰里爱吃烤牛的人儿，
还有悠久的英式烤牛！

——亨利·菲尔丁，《文丐街唱游》

aspecteditems.name: Blackberries
aspecteditems.description: Berries promised by darkness.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 黑暗许诺的浆果。

aspecteditems.name: Crusty Bread
aspecteditems.description: [Use bread with a Knife and mushrooms, ham, pilchards, or other savoury things… or add apples and spice for a classic English pudding.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [可以用刀料理面包，同时加上蘑菇、火腿、沙丁鱼，或者其它咸味食材……或者加入苹果与香料，制作经典英式甜点。]

aspecteditems.name: Eggy Bread
aspecteditems.description: On the continent, they call it 'pain perdu': sounds like damnation but tastes like sin.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在大陆，人们管这叫“pain perdu”（遭弃的面包）：听起来很糟糕，吃起来却罪恶般美味。

aspecteditems.name: Pillas-Oat Bread
aspecteditems.description: Gritty bread made with the hardy, ancient oats that grow at Land's End.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 用生长在大陆尽头的古老耐寒燕麦做出的粗面包。

aspecteditems.name: Blackberry Sponge Cake
aspecteditems.description: Light, sweet sponge cake and the taste of autumn hedgerows.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 轻盈而甜美的海绵蛋糕，伴着仿佛刚撷自秋日树篱般的新鲜滋味。

aspecteditems.name: Cornish Honey Cake
aspecteditems.description: Under no circumstances should this ever be confused with Devonshire Honey Cake, which everyone in Brancrug could instantly identify as an inferior variation.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在任何情况下都不应将它与德文郡蜂蜜蛋糕相混淆，因为在布兰库格，每个人都能立刻认出后者只是它的低劣变种。

aspecteditems.name: Knot-Cake
aspecteditems.description: According to the ancient pattern.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 依古代式样制作。

aspecteditems.name: Madeira Cake
aspecteditems.description: In the eighteenth century, one would have a slice of this in the morning with a glass of Madeira - fortified wine from the Madeira islands, volcanic yet lush, rugged yet balmy, bright with the calls of sandpipers and firecrests… this is the twentieth century. We have afternoon tea now. We don't drink fortified wine at ten o'clock in the morning. No more sandpipers. No more firecrests. But the cake's still good. Almonds.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在十八世纪，人们会在早晨享用一片这种蛋糕，搭配来自马德拉群岛的马德拉加度红酒；火山般强劲而繁盛，粗糙而平柔，鲜亮的滋味伴着鹬鸟和火冠雀清亮的啼鸣……但如今已是二十世纪。我们改成了下午茶。我们已经不在上午十点喝加度红酒了。没有鹬鸟，也没有火冠雀。但这蛋糕依旧美味。赞美杏仁。

aspecteditems.name: Rosehip Sponge Cake
aspecteditems.description: Rosa rugosa, the beach rose, is often regarded as a foreign interloper on European shores, but this cake is a strong argument for our hospitality.
aspecteditems.description_cn: Rosa rugosa——海边玫瑰在欧洲的沿海地区常被视为外来入侵物种，但这块蛋糕却是我们殷勤好客的有力证明。

aspecteditems.name: Ham and Egg Casserole
aspecteditems.description: Tasty and filling.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 美味又顶饱。

aspecteditems.name: Game Chips
aspecteditems.description: Long before fish and chips, these went crunchily with game. Ideally you'd want bread sauce and breadcrumbs to complete the ensemble, but honestly it's hard enough not just to stuff these directly into your mouth.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 炸鱼薯条出现前，薯条就已经被用来搭配野味以凸显其酥脆了。理想情况下，还需要搭配面包酱和面包屑来使这道菜更加完美，但老实说，光是忍住不直接把它们塞进嘴里就已是难事。

aspecteditems.name: Egg Croquettes
aspecteditems.description: Come for the crunch, stay for the nourishment.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 为酥脆而来，为滋养而留。

aspecteditems.name: Plum Croutons
aspecteditems.description: One should never make this with plums that are not ripe enough to eat. One is quite serious.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 绝不能拿没熟透的西梅做这道菜。这可不是开玩笑。

aspecteditems.name: Boiled Egg
aspecteditems.description: Neatly packaged nutrition, pale as a December dawn.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 完美包裹的营养品，苍白如十二月的黎明。

aspecteditems.name: Scrambled Egg
aspecteditems.description: With bacon, scrambled eggs were the breakfast of Empire. In these less hegemonic times, Empire is optional; as is bacon.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 培根配炒蛋是帝国的传统早餐。在霸权不复往日的时代，帝国可有可无；培根亦是如此。

aspecteditems.name: Floating Island
aspecteditems.description: Vanilla, custard, and meringue, landscaped and caramelled: a Claridge's speciality.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 香草、卡仕达酱与蛋白酥，再精心摆盘并焦糖化处理：这就制成了一道凯莱奇酒店的特色甜点。

aspecteditems.name: Bowl of Sea-Blest Pears
aspecteditems.description: Smooth as butter and wonderfully juicy.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 滑如黄油，多汁无比。

aspecteditems.name: Misshapen Fruit
aspecteditems.description: Salvaged windfalls, lumpy but tasty.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 打捞来的意外收获，疙疙瘩瘩但好吃。

aspecteditems.name: Fudge
aspecteditems.description: All the bad things doing a good thing.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 祸兮福所倚。

aspecteditems.name: Bunch of Grapes
aspecteditems.description: A juicy blush-purple.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一串多汁的胭色紫红。

aspecteditems.name: Canned Ham
aspecteditems.description: The taste will remain reliably unchanged for many years to come; which is, in some respects, an advantage.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它的味道会在以后的许多年里纹丝不变；这，从某些方面讲，算是个优点吧。

aspecteditems.name: Honey
aspecteditems.description: The blood of the Hour called Malachite; also and furthermore, wonderful on toast.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 被称为石绿之司辰的血；除此之外，涂在烤面包片上很棒。

aspecteditems.name: Cuckoo-Honey
aspecteditems.description: The Blomberende were rogues and trickster-heroes among the Carapace-kinds: ingenious, brave, prolific, untrustworthy. In Numa, their children might yet bring their gifts to ordinary hives…
aspecteditems.description_cn: 绽莓族是介壳种中的捣蛋分子与欺诈英雄：机灵、勇敢、多产、善变难信。在闰时，它们的子嗣也许仍会将它们的礼物带进普通的蜂巢里……

aspecteditems.name: Blackberry Jam
aspecteditems.description: Plucked from hedgerows.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 采自灌木绿篱。

aspecteditems.name: Rosehip Jam
aspecteditems.description: Plucked from wild roses.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 采自野生玫瑰。

aspecteditems.name: Leek Gratin
aspecteditems.description: Harvey Hattington, who established a surprisingly persistent influence on the kitchens of Hush House during his short stay here, described leek as 'Onion's Empress.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: 哈维·哈廷顿只在噤声居屋停留了短暂时间，却对这里的厨房产生了令人惊讶的持久影响，他将韭葱描述为“洋葱的女皇”。

aspecteditems.name: Kedgeree
aspecteditems.description: A wonderfully versatile dish favoured for breakfast by the sons of the lark, and for supper by the daughters of the owl.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一道百搭的美味餐点，百灵之子的早餐优选，鸮鸟之女的晚宴佳肴。

aspecteditems.name: Mackerel Monte Carlo
aspecteditems.description: Most suitable, according to Mrs Arabella Boxer, for a light supper, or a ladies' lunch.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 据阿拉贝拉·博克瑟太太所言，它最适合作为一顿简便晚宴，或是淑女们的午宴。

aspecteditems.name: Pickled Mackerel
aspecteditems.description: Pickling is a kind of afterlife. What comes after afterlife?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 腌渍是来生的一种形式。来生之后有什么？

aspecteditems.name: Poached Mackerel
aspecteditems.description: We do not poach fish in Brancrug without recalling the Turbot Crisis of 1786, when Dr Westcott caught a prodigious turbot, and required the kitchen to poach it for him 'without division'; but no vessel of sufficient size could be found to poach it entire. At last they resorted to 'alchemical assistance'. Mackerel, fortunately, requires no alchemy for its poaching.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 我们在布兰库格煮鱼时，总会回想起1786年的多宝鱼危机，当时威斯考特博士钓上了一条巨大的多宝鱼，要求厨房为他“不分割”地烹煮；但找不到足够大的器皿来把它整条盛入。最后，他们不得不借助“炼金术手段”。还好煮鲭鱼不用炼金术。

aspecteditems.name: Soused Mackerel
aspecteditems.description: In Scotland, where the tradition began, soused herrings are more usual, but this far south, on the Marches' edge, we make our own rules.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在这项传统的起源地苏格兰，醋渍鲱鱼要更常见，但在这遥远的南方，边地的边缘，我们自有规矩。

aspecteditems.name: Stuffed Acrid Marrow
aspecteditems.description: This was not a marrow conducive to harmony. Now it's a dish for warriors.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它曾是不利于和谐的西葫芦，如今则是勇士们的餐点。

aspecteditems.name: Stuffed Dark Marrow
aspecteditems.description: This was a marrow with secrets. Now it's a dish for mystes.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它曾是藏有秘密的西葫芦，如今则是秘教徒的餐点。

aspecteditems.name: Stuffed Golden Marrow
aspecteditems.description: This marrow was accounted a beauty among its kind. Now it's a dish for those who understand fidelity.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它曾被视作西葫芦中的珍品，如今则是那些懂得忠诚之人的餐点。

aspecteditems.name: Stuffed Pale Marrow
aspecteditems.description: This was a marrow redolent of sorrow. Now it's a dish to comfort the damned.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它曾是让人忆起哀痛之事的西葫芦。如今则是安慰罪恶之人的餐点。

aspecteditems.name: Baked Apple Meringue
aspecteditems.description: Harvey Hattington, during his convalescence at the House, was so obsessed with meringuing techniques that he was ultimately banned from the kitchen.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在居屋疗养期间，哈维·哈廷顿痴迷于蛋白酥工艺，最终被禁止进入厨房。

aspecteditems.name: Mushroom Meringue
aspecteditems.description: What in the Wolf-Divided's most splintered Name hath here been wrought?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 裂分之狼至碎之名在上……此间所造何物耶？

aspecteditems.name: Baked Pear Meringue
aspecteditems.description: Harvey Hattington, during his convalescence at the House, became obsessed with meringuing techniques. He was known to sneak down to the kitchens and interfere with the cooks in pursuit of his ideal.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在居屋疗养期间，哈维·哈廷顿痴迷于蛋白酥工艺。他常常偷溜进厨房，干预厨师的工作，以追求他心中的理想蛋白酥。

aspecteditems.name: Walls-of-Ys
aspecteditems.description: A frankly insensitive name that commemorates the inundation of that fabled city.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 坦率地说，这是一个相当无情的名字，用以纪念那座传说之城的沉没。

aspecteditems.name: Moly
aspecteditems.description: 'Moly the gods call it, and it is hard for mortal men to dig; but with the gods all things are possible.' - Homer
aspecteditems.description_cn: “众神称其摩吕，凡人难以掘得；但与诸神同在，一切皆有可能。”——荷马

aspecteditems.name: Moly au Jus
aspecteditems.description: This has been called 'Moth, but delicious, but perhaps we all will be, at the end.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它曾被评价为“似蛾味美，终或同归。”

aspecteditems.name: Mushrooms
aspecteditems.description: Eat them on toast, bake them with potatoes or pickle them alone.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 可以配吐司吃，配土豆烤，亦或单独腌制。

aspecteditems.name: Pickled Mushrooms
aspecteditems.description: You'll learn to like them.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 你会试着喜欢它们的。

aspecteditems.name: Onion Gratin
aspecteditems.description: Harvey Hattington campaigned for the introduction of this dish to the infirmary during his time convalescing at Hush House, though Wakefield referred to it grumpily as 'Trojan Cheese'.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 哈维·哈廷顿在噤声居屋的疗养期间，曾积极将这道菜引进医务室。尽管韦克菲尔德不满地称其为“特洛伊奶酪”。

aspecteditems.name: Onion Rings
aspecteditems.description: An American import that became popular in England these last few years, improbably, via the pages of Vogue.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种近年来通过《Vogue》杂志意外引入英国并风靡的美国舶来品。

aspecteditems.name: Orange Jumble
aspecteditems.description: 'They should be the size of teacup rims, and should curl their crisp edges, faintly pink as the underneath of a young mushroom.' - Lady Jekyll, Kitchen Essays
aspecteditems.description_cn: “它们的大小应与茶杯口相当，酥脆的边缘微微卷起，呈现出嫩蘑菇底部褶皱那样的淡粉色。”——杰基尔夫人，《厨房杂谈》

aspecteditems.name: Poire Belle Hélène
aspecteditems.description: A sweet dish named (of course) to celebrate Offenbach's 1865 operetta La belle Hélène. Apparently a New York production made an impression on Thirza Blake in her youth…
aspecteditems.description_cn: 毫无疑问，这道甜品是为庆祝奥芬巴赫的轻歌剧《美丽的海伦》在1865年的首演而得名。据说，此剧在纽约的演出给年轻时的蒂尔扎·布雷克留下了深刻印象……

aspecteditems.name: Poires Ys
aspecteditems.description: Like Poire Belle Hélène, except it makes you dream of drowned sunsets.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 恰似梨海伦，只是它会令你梦见沉溺的落日。

aspecteditems.name: Jugged Pheasant
aspecteditems.description: The hunter's reward.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 属于猎手的犒赏。

aspecteditems.name: Roast Pheasant
aspecteditems.description: Best when roasted upside down to start, but turned right way up before the end.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 最好先倒着烤，要结束时再翻正。

aspecteditems.name: Cold Pheasant with Grape Salad
aspecteditems.description: This was the sort of dish you might expect to find for a late supper after the theatre, or halfway through a ball.' - Arabella Boxer
aspecteditems.description_cn: “这是那种适合在剧院散场后的夜宵、或舞会中途吃到的菜肴。”——阿拉贝拉·博克瑟

aspecteditems.name: Apple Pie
aspecteditems.description: Flaky, buttery crust; tart-sweet apples with cinnamon and nutmeg.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 酥脆的黄油饼皮，酸甜的苹果佐以肉桂与豆蔻。

aspecteditems.name: Pear Pie
aspecteditems.description: Flaky, buttery crust; luscious pears with cinnamon and nutmeg.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 酥脆的黄油饼皮，甘美的梨佐以肉桂与豆蔻。

aspecteditems.name: Cottage Pie
aspecteditems.description: A rich minced beef sauce under a golden crust of baked mash potatoes. Just the thing to come home to after a storm on the moors.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 浓郁的牛肉酱铺洒在金黄的烤土豆泥脆壳下面。正是暴风雨过后从旷野归家该享用的理想佳肴。

aspecteditems.name: Game Pie
aspecteditems.description: Pheasant or snipe or woodcock or rabbit, and tasty pastry.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 野鸡，沙锥鸟，山鹬或是兔肉，加上美味的酥皮。

aspecteditems.name: Kingsluck Pie
aspecteditems.description: Thirza Blake always insisted on calling it 'the Great Pie of Power', to the lasting annoyance of her peers.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 蒂尔扎·布雷克执意称它为“权力大馅饼”，搞得她的同僚们颇为恼火。

aspecteditems.name: Starygazy Pie
aspecteditems.description: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.' - Wilde, Lady Windermere's Fan
aspecteditems.description_cn: “身在井隅，心向星空。”——王尔德，《温德米尔夫人的扇子》

aspecteditems.name: Pumpkin Pie
aspecteditems.description: Take a pound of pumpion and slice it, a handful of thyme, a little rosemary, and sweet marjoram stripped off the stalks, chop them small, then take cinnamon, nutmeg, pepper, and a few cloves all beaten…' - Hannah Woolley, A Gentlewoman's Companion
aspecteditems.description_cn: “一磅南瓜切薄片。一把百里香，一点迷迭香，甜牛至去梗，把它们切碎，然后取肉桂、肉豆蔻、胡椒粉和几瓣丁香，全部捣碎……”——汉娜·伍利，《淑女的伴侣》

aspecteditems.name: Amber Pumpkin Pie
aspecteditems.description: A favourite of Kitty Mazarine's second son. Of course she had to leave them behind in the place of her birth, but she brought the recipe to Brancrug. Did she remember him each time she baked it? Even until the very end?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 凯蒂·马扎林第二个儿子的最爱。当然，她不得不将孩子们留在出生地，但她将这份食谱带到了布兰库格。每次烘焙时，她都会想起他么？直到最后一刻？

aspecteditems.name: Honey-Haunted Pumpkin Pie
aspecteditems.description: Harvey Hattington, perenially suspicious of the Blomberende-kind and their cuckoo-honey, nevertheless championed pumpkin pie made with cuckoo-honey as 'the Herald of Savour.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: 哈维·哈廷顿虽然一直对绽莓族及其杜鹃蜜心存猜忌，却仍推崇用杜鹃蜜制作的南瓜派，称其为“滋味的使节”。

aspecteditems.name: Sea-Pie
aspecteditems.description: Once a treat for sailors, hence the name. [With the Spices and Savours skill, and pears, you might recreate a legendary dish.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 曾是对水手们的犒赏，故此得名。[搭配香料与滋味之技艺，以及梨子，你或许可以重现一道传说中的菜肴。]

aspecteditems.name: Steamed Spring Vegetable Pie
aspecteditems.description: Originally a product of Lord Berners' kitchens at Faringdon House; favoured by Heber-Percy, 'the Mad Boy', Berners' companion, who inlaid the floor of his changing room with pennies and built steps up to his swimming pool…
aspecteditems.description_cn: 最初起源于伯纳斯勋爵在法林顿宅邸的厨房，深受伯纳斯的伴侣“疯小子”希伯·珀西青睐，此人在更衣室的地板上镶嵌硬币，还建造了通往泳池的台阶……

aspecteditems.name: Vegetable Stew
aspecteditems.description: Unexciting, but also unobjectionable.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 平淡无奇，但也无可指摘。

aspecteditems.name: Pickled Pilchards
aspecteditems.description: An acquired, and unforgettable, taste.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种独特而难忘的口味。

aspecteditems.name: Plums
aspecteditems.description: [Add Bread and use a Knife for Plum Croutons, or an Egg and use Mixing Bowls for Prune Whip.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: [加入面包，使用刀制成西梅面包丁，或者用蛋和搅拌碗做成西梅糕。]

aspecteditems.name: Roast Potatoes
aspecteditems.description: You really need rosemary for roast potatoes, but fortunately, the kitchen garden at Hush House has never been short of rosemary.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 土豆真的得配迷迭香烤才好，幸运的是，噤声居屋的菜园里从不缺迷迭香。

aspecteditems.name: Magnificent Roast Potatoes
aspecteditems.description: It's the dripping that elevates it. Roast potatoes are a feast for the senses, but the dripping deepens the flavour profile, makes the experience continue through the machinery of the mouth to become a kind of journey.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 烤肉滴油升华了它。烤土豆已是一场感官盛宴，但烤肉滴油加深了风味层次，这体验在口腔中久久回味，成为一段味觉旅程。

aspecteditems.name: Toffee Pudding
aspecteditems.description: Decadent in summer, comforting in winter.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 夏日的奢享，冬季的慰藉。

aspecteditems.name: Yorkshire Pudding
aspecteditems.description: Eggy, creamy, crispy, and the eternal supporting character in a Sunday roast. [To the similarly eternal confusion of English speakers who are not British, Yorkshire Pudding is not sweet and cannot be served for the Pudding course.]
aspecteditems.description_cn: 蛋香，奶香，酥脆可口，周日烤肉中亘古不变的配角。[为什么约克郡布丁既不甜，也不是布丁？对非英国人来说，无论其是否为英语母语者，这可能都是个永恒的谜。约克郡布丁无法作为甜点上桌。]

aspecteditems.name: Pumpkin
aspecteditems.description: Mash it, eat it, hide forbidden documents in it.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 捣碎，吃掉，把被封禁的文献藏在它里边。

aspecteditems.name: Amber Pumpkin
aspecteditems.description: A lovely golden gourd grown beside the soft sea.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一个长在轻柔海边的讨喜金瓜。

aspecteditems.name: Soft Amber Pumpkin
aspecteditems.description: A lovely golden gourd grown beside the soft sea.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一个长在轻柔海边的讨喜金瓜。

aspecteditems.name: Wormy Pumpkin
aspecteditems.description: At a glance, it seems uncorrupted - but it’s squirming with regrettable visitors.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 乍一看，它好像尚未腐烂——但其实已经蠕满了叫人遗憾的不速之客。

aspecteditems.name: Pyrus Auricalcinus
aspecteditems.description: A peculiar pear, with coppery skin that barely dints under the pressure of fingers.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一种异乎寻常的梨子，铜样的表皮在手指的按压下几乎毫无凹陷。

aspecteditems.name: Rosehips
aspecteditems.description: Berries that promise roses.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 许诺玫瑰的浆果。

aspecteditems.name: Sack of Vegetables
aspecteditems.description: Stew-in-waiting.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 静候炖煮。

aspecteditems.name: Grape Salad
aspecteditems.description: Just enough to fill in the gaps.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 恰好填补空隙。

aspecteditems.name: Egg Sandwiches
aspecteditems.description: Ennobled by cress but acceptable without.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 加些水芹更显高雅，没有亦无妨。

aspecteditems.name: Aglaophotis Soufflé
aspecteditems.name_cn: 阿格劳福提斯花舒芙蕾
aspecteditems.description: One of the most deliciously melting incarnations of occult power ever contrived.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 有史以来超自然之力的融化化身中最美味的之一。

aspecteditems.name: Leek Soup
aspecteditems.description: A milder taste than onion soup, but no less warming.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 味道比洋葱汤淡一些，但温暖不减。

aspecteditems.name: Onion Soup
aspecteditems.description: Just enough tang to tantalise.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 恰到好处的辛辣味，足以挑动味蕾。

aspecteditems.name: Pumpkin Soup
aspecteditems.description: A blessed warming broth.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一碗被祝福的暖心浓汤。

aspecteditems.name: Amber Pumpkin Soup
aspecteditems.description: The amber 'pompions' of Brancrug are, according to tradition, all descendants of the seeds brought by Kitty Mazarine from her home across the soft sea.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 按布兰库格的传统说法，这些珀色“金瓜”都源自凯蒂·马扎林跨越轻柔之海、自家乡带来的种子。

aspecteditems.name: Honey-Haunted Pumpkin Soup
aspecteditems.description: Harvey Hattington, perenially suspicious of the Blomberende-kind and their cuckoo-honey, nevertheless championed pumpkin soup made with cuckoo-honey as 'Savour's Consort.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: 哈维·哈廷顿虽然一直对绽莓族及其杜鹃蜜心存猜忌，却仍推崇用杜鹃蜜制作的南瓜汤，称其为“滋味的伴侣”。

aspecteditems.name: Ham and Cheese Toastie
aspecteditems.description: Breakfast, lunch or emergency.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 早餐，午宴，或是作为应急食品。

aspecteditems.name: Fried Mushrooms on Toast
aspecteditems.description: You can do great things with these with a simple white sauce with black pepper, but sometimes you're just hungry.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 可以加上简单的白酱和黑胡椒来做出美味佳肴，但有时候你只想要快点充饥。

aspecteditems.name: Pilchards on Toast
aspecteditems.description: Triply crunchy.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 三重酥脆。

aspecteditems.name: Basket of Vegetables
aspecteditems.description: Gifts from the garden.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 来自菜园的馈赠。

aspecteditems.name: Basket of Apples
aspecteditems.description: Notoriously hard to take just one bite.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 众所周知，很难忍住只吃一口。

aspecteditems.name: Basket of Leeks
aspecteditems.description: The mark of St David's triumph. And very good in soup.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 圣大卫凯旋的标志。煲汤很好喝。

aspecteditems.name: Basket of Onions
aspecteditems.description: The prima materia of cooking. This may be why the cosmos is shaped so like an onion.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 烹饪界的原初物质。也许这就是宇宙看起来像个洋葱的原因。

aspecteditems.name: Acrid Marrow
aspecteditems.description: In Brancrug, they take marrows seriously. This is not a marrow conducive to harmony.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在布兰库格，人们很重视西葫芦。这是不利于和谐的西葫芦。

aspecteditems.name: Dark Marrow
aspecteditems.description: In Brancrug, they take marrows seriously. This is a marrow with secrets.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在布兰库格，人们很重视西葫芦。这是藏有秘密的西葫芦。

aspecteditems.name: Golden Marrow
aspecteditems.description: In Brancrug, they take marrows seriously. This is accounted a beauty among its kind.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在布兰库格，人们很重视西葫芦。这个在同品类里也算是珍品。

aspecteditems.name: Pale Marrow
aspecteditems.description: In Brancrug, they take marrows seriously. This is a marrow redolent of sorrow.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在布兰库格，人们很重视西葫芦。这个西葫芦会叫人忆起哀痛之事。

aspecteditems.name: Prune Whip
aspecteditems.description: Much, much tastier than it sounds.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 比听上去美味得多。

aspecteditems.name: Genealogical Chart
aspecteditems.description: Six years ago, King George's heir Edward killed him in a quarrel over Edward's womanising. The kingdom was saved from constitutional collapse by  Henry Huddleston Abney-Hastings, 13th Count of Loudoun - who claimed descent through the Plantagenet line. Heaven lift the New King!
aspecteditems.description_cn: 六年前，乔治国王在一场因其继承人爱德华的风流行径而起的争执中被爱德华本人杀死。于宪法崩溃之危机中拯救王国的是亨利·赫德尔斯顿·阿布尼-黑斯廷斯，第十三任劳登伯爵——宣称血统承自金雀花王室之人。天佑新王！

aspecteditems.name: Brazen Clock
aspecteditems.description: It's not immediately apparent that this clock lacks hands, although, when wound, it dutifully ticks.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 不太明显的是，这块钟缺少指针；尽管如此，上发条后它依旧会尽职地嗒嗒响。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Sister-and-Witch'
aspecteditems.description: 'The Sister-and-Witch brings together what cannot be apart. She is sought beneath the moon and at the water's edge. She is pearl, amber, coral; she cannot be touched; she cannot be separated.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “双生巫女将不可分离之物结合。她位于月之底，水之缘。她是珍珠、是琥珀、是珊瑚；她不可触碰；她不可分离。”

aspecteditems.name: 'The Thunderskin'
aspecteditems.description: 'He cannot be stilled; he demands the dance; he is beaten, like a drum. He is heard in the Wood below the world.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “他不可止息；他渴求舞蹈；他受击如鼓。在世界之下的林地能听到他的声音。”

aspecteditems.name: 'The Velvet'
aspecteditems.description: 'The Glory is a question, and the Moth always answers Yes. The Velvet's answer is No, and that is always her answer.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “辉光是一个疑问，飞蛾总以肯定作答。丝毧以否定作答，从来如此。”

aspecteditems.name: 'The Witch-and-Sister'
aspecteditems.description: 'The Witch-and-Sister unites what is at rest. She is sought at the water's edge and beneath the moon. She cannot be separated; she cannot be touched; she is coral, amber, pearl'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “双生女巫令静止之物结合。她位于水之缘，月之底。她不可分离，她不可触碰；她是珊瑚，是琥珀，是珍珠。”

aspecteditems.name: Fractured Mirror
aspecteditems.description: Cracked and fly-specked.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 满是裂纹与苍蝇屎。

aspecteditems.name: Frosty Mirror
aspecteditems.description: A moon-coloured metal oval. It's shaped like a mirror, but no reflection is visible.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一面色泽如月的椭圆金属。它形状如同镜子，却无任何可见的映像。

aspecteditems.name: Night Mirror
aspecteditems.description: An oddly dim mirror.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一面黯淡得古怪的镜子。

aspecteditems.name: Shaving Mirror
aspecteditems.description: Snip snip!
aspecteditems.description_cn: 咔嚓，咔嚓！

aspecteditems.name: Silvery Mirror
aspecteditems.description: There are silvered mirrors, and there are silvery mirrors.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 世上有镀银的镜子，也有似银的镜子。

aspecteditems.name: Storm-Tossed Mirror
aspecteditems.description: Solid workmanship, but not obviously remarkable.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 坚固的工艺品，但并不十分引人注目。

aspecteditems.name: 'Our Benefactor'
aspecteditems.description: Evidently someone who donated to the Curia… but preferred to remain anonymous.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 显然是曾经赞助过决议会的某人……但他更愿意保持匿名。

aspecteditems.name: 'Our Benefactress'
aspecteditems.description: Evidently someone who donated to the Curia… but preferred to remain anonymous.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 显然是曾经赞助过决议会的某人……但她更愿意保持匿名。

aspecteditems.name: ALIIS LICET TIBI NON LICET
aspecteditems.description: 'To us it is permitted; to you it is not permitted.' The motto of the Suppression Bureau.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “于我则许，于尔则拒。”防剿局的座右铭。

aspecteditems.name: 'An Anointing'
aspecteditems.description: A silent crowd watches a robed priest bless a patient subject with sacred oils.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 人群沉默地注视着长袍牧师用圣油为受祝者祝福。

aspecteditems.name: 'Portrait of a Behatted Lady'
aspecteditems.description: 'The More Prominent the Headgear, the Closer to the Glory'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “帽子越高耸，离光辉越近。”

aspecteditems.name: 'Departure'
aspecteditems.description: Here Valentine has painted gulls migrating across a darkening sea.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 瓦伦丁在这幅画中描绘了飞越昏黑汪洋的迁徙鸥群。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Bridge at Ortucchio'
aspecteditems.description: A shadowy figure waits to accept its toll.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一抹模糊的身影正等待着收取通行费。

aspecteditems.name: The Chiliarch's Victory'
aspecteditems.description: A blurred, menacing depiction of a vast, flabby carcass the colour of dirty sulphur, patched with brighter yellow. Signed 'Brulleau, 1861'.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一幅模糊且令人生畏的画作，刻画了一具色如不洁硫磺，肥大且松弛的尸体，其间点缀着几块相对鲜艳的黄斑。署名“布鲁洛夫，1861”。

aspecteditems.name: 'Chac'
