aspecteditems.description: Valentine Dewulf's magnificent green cockatoo. The painting is signed by Valentine himself.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 瓦伦丁·德沃尔夫豢养的那只华丽绿羽鸡头鹦鹉，署名者是瓦伦丁本人。

aspecteditems.name: 'Love in a Quiet Place'
aspecteditems.description: One of Dr Levinsen's 'prefigures', a close (and impossible) copy of a painting made twenty years later by Kirchner, whose work Levinsen often anticipated in his mirror-dreams.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 莱文森博士的“预见”之一，一幅与二十年后的画作非常相似（且本不可能存在）的复制品，原画出自凯尔希纳之手，莱文森经常在他的镜像梦境中提前预见到那些作品。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Tattered Outlaw'
aspecteditems.description: Thirza Blake, Seventh Librarian of Hush House, liked painting donkeys. No-one else liked her donkey paintings, but Thirza never much cared what other people liked.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 蒂尔扎·布雷克，噤声居屋的第七任图书管理员，喜欢画驴子。没人喜欢她的驴子画，但蒂尔扎从不太在意别人喜欢什么。

aspecteditems.name: 'Eva and Abraham, 1724'
aspecteditems.description: A magnificent depiction in oils of an elegantly dressed eighteenth century couple. The face of the gentleman, however, was long ago obliterated by a splash of some dark, corrosive substance.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一幅华丽的油画，描绘着一对衣着高雅的十八世纪伴侣。然而，男方的面庞很久以前便被某种漆黑的腐蚀性物质抹去了。

aspecteditems.name: 'The First Threshold'
aspecteditems.description: A horned double axe stands alone in a sandy desert.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一柄双角利斧独自伫立于大漠中。

aspecteditems.name: 'The First End'
aspecteditems.description: A single candle burns against darkness; its flame is the crescent moon.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一支孤零的蜡烛在黑暗中燃烧，烛焰形如弯月。

aspecteditems.name: 'The First Birth'
aspecteditems.description: A single ripple disturbs the still surface of a well of blood.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一圈孤零的涟漪搅动了鲜血之井平静的表面。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Foundlings'
aspecteditems.description: A pair of human eyes peer from darkness in a tangle of roots.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一双人类的眼睛在缠结根系间的黑暗中向外窥视。

aspecteditems.name: 'Julian Coseley'
aspecteditems.description: Julian is known to be Winter-long: at a prescribed date, his Hour-patron will ensure him a beautiful ending, but until then, he is even harder than most Long to dispose of finally. That said, he is known to have been defeated by an ascendant Long in the 1920s, and his true current status - a diminished survivor? a determined memory? something else? - is the subject of esoteric debate.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 众所周知，朱利安是一位冬之长生者：在大限到来之日，庇护他的司辰将确保他有一个凄美的结尾。但在此之前，他比大多数长生者更难被彻底杀死。尽管如此，我们还是知道，他在1920年代被一位新晋长生者击败了。而他如今的真实状况——一位衰弱的幸存者？一段坚定的回忆？或是别的什么？——是个深奥的辩论主题。

aspecteditems.name: 'A Bargain'
aspecteditems.description: A serpent laps at the blood that drips from a sewn-closed mouth.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 毒蛇舔舐着从一张被缝合的嘴中滴落的鲜血。

aspecteditems.name: 'Glory's Gift'
aspecteditems.description: A human figure is silhouetted against a blazing sun.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一道人影在耀眼烈日的映衬下清晰可见。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Mansus'
aspecteditems.description: There have been many attempts to depict the House of the Sun. This, by the visionary painter known only as the Magyar, is the best known. It's signed and dated - if it's really the original, it must count as one of the great treasures of the House.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 曾有许多描画太阳居屋的尝试。而最有名的这张出自一位富有创见的画家，我们只知其自称马扎尔人。其上写有署名与日期——如果这真是原作，它肯定能列入居屋最珍贵的宝物之一。

aspecteditems.name: Mihail in Glory
aspecteditems.description: Mihail, Messenger to Darkness, depicted in the fullness of his power.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “黑暗信使”米哈尔，绘于他的全盛时期。

aspecteditems.name: Mihail in Chains
aspecteditems.description: Mihail, Messenger to Darkness, depicted after his defeat.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “黑暗信使”米哈尔，绘于他战败之后。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Wheel Still Turns'
aspecteditems.description: A shining spoked Wheel with a vaguely organic look turns beneath a full moon that holds her finger to her lips.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一个闪闪发亮、隐约有着血肉外观的辐条轮在一轮满月下旋转——那月亮正将手指抵在自己的双唇上。

aspecteditems.name: 'Mlle Matutine'
aspecteditems.description: An alluring young woman with deep blue eyes hard and dark as sapphires.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一位诱人的年轻女子，深蓝色的眼睛犹如坚硬深邃的蓝宝石。

aspecteditems.name: 'The First Answer'
aspecteditems.description: A vast moth spirals towards a burning sun, alone in a star-speckled void.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一只巨大的飞蛾独处于繁星如斑的虚空中，盘旋着飞向熊熊燃烧的太阳。

aspecteditems.name: 'To Hear Those Voices'
aspecteditems.description: A Levinsen 'prefigure' - a copy of a painting that would not be committed to canvas by the real artist for twenty years.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 莱文森的“预见”之一，是一幅复制的画作，其在二十年后才会被真正的作者呈现在画布上。

aspecteditems.name: 'Lord Munday'
aspecteditems.description: A well-dressed, middle-aged gentleman with receding hair and a clear expression of astonished delight.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一位衣着考究的中年绅士，发际线后退，面带显而易见的惊喜之情。

aspecteditems.name: 'Gods Return'
aspecteditems.description: A green shoot splits a rock.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一杆绿芽破石而出。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Watcher'
aspecteditems.description: Another of Valentine's paintings; a barn owl he nursed back to health.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 瓦伦丁的又一幅画作；一只在他的护理下康复的仓鸮。

aspecteditems.name: 'Red, Blue'
aspecteditems.description: It's a decent copy of a Picasso… painted twenty years before Picasso painted the original. Brian Levinsen, up to his tricks again.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一副像模像样的毕加索复制品……在毕加索画出原作的二十年前画下。布莱恩·莱文森又一次耍了他的小花招。

aspecteditems.name: 'To Be Fruitful'
aspecteditems.description: It's a decent copy of a Picasso… painted twenty years before Picasso painted the original. Brian Levinsen, up to his tricks again.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一副像模像样的毕加索复制品……在毕加索画出原作的二十年前画下。布莱恩·莱文森又一次耍了他的小花招。

aspecteditems.name: 'Raveline Summer'
aspecteditems.description: A dry spell in a still place.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 某个宁静之地的旱季。

aspecteditems.name: Caer Ys
aspecteditems.description: A spired city is dimly visible through a vast rolling wave.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一座于涛涛巨浪间朦胧可见的尖塔之城。

aspecteditems.name: 'A Sacrifice'
aspecteditems.description: A silent crowd watches a robed priest drown a struggling victim in a bowl of rainbowed oil.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 人群沉默地注视着长袍牧师将挣扎的牺牲者溺死于一盆缤纷斑斓的油脂中。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Hatching'
aspecteditems.description: Human figures crawl from a clamshell.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一个人形从蛤壳中缓缓爬出。

aspecteditems.name: 'Dr Serena Blackwood'
aspecteditems.description: No-one is in the picture - only an empty garden.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 画中无人——仅有一座空空荡荡的花园。

aspecteditems.name: 'Self-Born'
aspecteditems.description: A furry, cloven-looking foot reaches towards a mirror: its reflection is a bird's claw.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一只毛茸茸，看着像偶蹄目的蹄子伸向一面镜子：它的映像是一只鸟爪。

aspecteditems.name: 'As Above, So Below'
aspecteditems.description: A framed page of illustrated vellum. Up close, the colours dazzle and puzzle.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一页被装裱起来的牛皮纸插画。靠近观看，这些色彩炫目且眩目。

aspecteditems.name: 'Crowcross Sands at High Tide'
aspecteditems.description: A gloomy study of the sea in gloomy weather.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 对阴沉天气中大海的阴沉描绘。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Boy Prays'
aspecteditems.description: There's no sign of a boy in this distorted, menacing image, and no-one seems to be praying.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在这扭曲且险恶的画面中既没有男孩，也没人像是在祈祷。

aspecteditems.name: 'Sedona, Not Yet'
aspecteditems.description: One of Dr Levinsen's 'prefigures', an impossible copy of a painting that the real artist hadn't yet executed. He's signed it with the Illumination mark, and dated it '1958'.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 莱文森博士的“预见”之一，一幅画家本人尚未完成的画作的本不可能存在的复制品，他在其上标记了照明术的记号，并注明年份“1958”。

aspecteditems.name: 'Again, at Night'
aspecteditems.description: One of Dr Levinsen's 'prefigures', a close (and impossible) copy of a painting made twenty years later by Kirchner, whose work Levinsen often anticipated in his mirror-dreams.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 莱文森博士的“预见”之一，一幅与二十年后的画作非常相似（且本不可能存在）的复制品，原画出自凯尔希纳之手，莱文森经常在他的镜像梦境中提前预见到那些作品。

aspecteditems.name: 'Leaves in the Wind'
aspecteditems.description: A soothing but undistinguished work in oils. Someone evidently was good at trees, and wanted you to know it.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一幅舒缓却乏味的油画。某人显然很善于画树木，并且想要让观者知道。

aspecteditems.name: 'Lady Tryphon'
aspecteditems.description: A very old portrait in the Byzantine style.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一幅非常古老的拜占庭风格半身像。

aspecteditems.name: 'Supplication'
aspecteditems.description: The Sun-in Rags, but reversed, that is, blood is dripping down into the sun and being absorbed.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 残阳，但是颠倒着的，也就是说，是鲜血滴入太阳并被吸收。

aspecteditems.name: Red Drake Shield
aspecteditems.description: Painted leather, riveted to heavy iron.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 彩绘皮革，铆接在重型铁器上。

aspecteditems.name: Golden Lion Shield
aspecteditems.description: Painted leather, riveted to heavy iron.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 彩绘皮革，铆接在重型铁器上。

aspecteditems.name: Green Stag Shield
aspecteditems.description: Painted leather, riveted to heavy iron.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 彩绘皮革，铆接在重型铁器上。

aspecteditems.name: Finnian
aspecteditems.description: Ambrose Westcott liked to name his hunting trophies after former rivals or adversaries whom (he said) his trophies resembled.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 安布罗斯·威斯考特喜欢以（据他说）与其猎获相像的老对手或仇敌命名自己的猎获。

aspecteditems.name: Hokobald
aspecteditems.description: Ambrose Westcott liked to name his hunting trophies after former rivals whom (he said) his trophies resembled.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 安布罗斯·威斯考特喜欢以（据他说）与其猎获相像的老对手命名自己的猎获。

aspecteditems.name: Philemon
aspecteditems.description: Ambrose Westcott liked to name his hunting trophies after former rivals whom (he said) his trophies resembled.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 安布罗斯·威斯考特喜欢以（据他说）与其猎获相像的老对手命名自己的猎获。

aspecteditems.name: Tavish
aspecteditems.description: Ambrose Westcott liked to name his hunting trophies after former rivals whom (he said) his trophies resembled.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 安布罗斯·威斯考特喜欢以（据他说）与其猎获相像的老对手命名自己的猎获。

aspecteditems.name: Sol Invictis Symbol
aspecteditems.description: The eternal symbol of the Unconquered Sun, all the way back to the Shadowless Empire, even through the wild heresies of the Intercalate.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 无敌太阳永恒的徽记，可以追溯至无影帝国时期，即便历经置闰的黑暗岁月仍得以传承。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Foundation of the Sun'
aspecteditems.description: 'Long ago in this country, one did not build a church without first sacrificing a white bull to the Sun-in-Rags…' Solomon Husher brought this tapestry with him from - well, wherever it was that Solomon came from.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “很久以前，在这个国度，一个人若不先向残阳献祭一头白色公牛，便不可建立教堂……”所罗门·赫舍从他来的地方带来了这张织幔——好吧，不管所罗门是从哪来的。

aspecteditems.name: Red Deer Antlers
aspecteditems.description: Not quite hair, not quite teeth, but proof that someone killed something.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 不完全算毛发，不完全算牙齿，但无疑是某人杀死某物的凭证。

aspecteditems.name: Yeth-Hound Horns
aspecteditems.description: In times past the Yeth pursued the impious and impure across the moors of this country. Hendrik Dewulf never liked them.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在过去，夜嘶会在这片国家的荒野上追猎不虔者与不洁者。亨德里克·德沃尔夫从来不喜欢它们。

aspecteditems.name: Hunter's Bow
aspecteditems.description: A very practical weapon.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件相当实用的武器。

aspecteditems.name: Poacher's Bow
aspecteditems.description: A very practical weapon.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件相当实用的武器。

aspecteditems.name: Sentry's Bow
aspecteditems.description: A fearsome weapon.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件令人生畏的武器。

aspecteditems.name: Crossbow
aspecteditems.description: An antique crossbow from Hush House's early Baronial period.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一把来自噤声居屋男爵时期早期的古董十字弩。

aspecteditems.name: Dearday's Foil
aspecteditems.description: A pin-sharp length of flexible steel. The blade is inscribed DEARDAY.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一段锐利的韧钢，剑身上刻着蒂尔黛。

aspecteditems.name: Torgue's Foil
aspecteditems.description: A pin-sharp length of flexible steel. The blade is inscribed TORGUE.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一段锐利的韧钢，剑身上刻着图格。

aspecteditems.name: Red Practice Sword
aspecteditems.description: A leaf-shaped wooden sword of considerable age.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一柄相当古老的叶形木剑。

aspecteditems.name: Dappled Practice Sword
aspecteditems.description: A leaf-shaped wooden sword of considerable age.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一柄相当古老的叶形木剑。

aspecteditems.name: Matched Flintlock Pistols
aspecteditems.description: A pair of pistols - the style and maker's mark suggest late seventeenth century.  The initials 'MD' are marked in silver, above the wolf-sejant of the Barons Brancrug.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一对手枪——其款式与制作者标记暗示它来自十七世纪晚期。姓名首字母“MD”在布兰库格男爵的端坐之狼徽记上方用白银标出。

aspecteditems.name: Azita's Practice Sword
aspecteditems.description: A varnished length of wood. The name AZITA is inlaid in silver.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一段上过清漆的木头。其上以白银镶出阿齐塔之名。

aspecteditems.name: Fraser's Practice Sword
aspecteditems.description: A varnished length of wood. The name FRASER has been carved into the flat.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一段上过清漆的木头。剑身刻有弗雷泽之名。

aspecteditems.name: Red Quarterstaff
aspecteditems.description: A long staff marked with bands of red.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一根有赤色条纹的长棍。

aspecteditems.name: Greene's Practice Sword
aspecteditems.description: A varnished length of wood.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一段上过清漆的木头。

aspecteditems.name: Mehrad's Practice Sword
aspecteditems.description: A varnished length of wood. The name MEHRAD is inlaid in gold.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一段上过清漆的木头。其上以黄金镶出迈哈德之名。

aspecteditems.name: Dappled Quarterstaff
aspecteditems.description: A long staff marked with bands of black and white.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一根有饰有黑白条纹的长棍。

aspecteditems.name: Natalia's Practice Sword
aspecteditems.description: A varnished length of wood. The name NATALIA has been carved into the flat.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一段上过清漆的木头。剑身刻有纳塔莉娅之名。

aspecteditems.name: Sebastian's Swords
aspecteditems.description: Matching eighteenth-century cutlasses. The initials SD are engraved on the blade near the hilt.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一对十八世纪弯刀。刀刃靠近刀柄处刻着姓名首字母“SD”。

aspecteditems.name: Bokken: Captain Torgue and Mistress Dearday
aspecteditems.name_cn: 木刀：图格上尉与蒂尔黛夫人
aspecteditems.description: Souvenirs from the East, heavily padded.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 来自东方的纪念品，装填着厚重的垫料。

aspecteditems.name: Cudgels: Dyddgu and St Twrog
aspecteditems.name_cn: 棍棒：蒂迪佳与圣图瓦格
aspecteditems.description: Very old iron cudgels, recently and heavily padded.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 非常古老的铁棍，不久前填入了厚重的垫料。

aspecteditems.name: Wasters: Darling-Dear and Father Turk
aspecteditems.name_cn: 训练用剑：蒂儿宝贝与图克神父
aspecteditems.description: Wooden swords of recent manufacture, never used.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 近期制造的木剑，从未用过。

aspecteditems.name: Lepidoptery Display (Grail-centric)
aspecteditems.description: A collection of lepidopteran insects with unusual characteristics.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一套拥有罕见特征的鳞翅目昆虫收藏品。

aspecteditems.name: Lepidoptery Display (Heart-centric)
aspecteditems.description: A collection of lepidopteran insects with unusual characteristics.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一套拥有罕见特征的鳞翅目昆虫收藏品。

aspecteditems.name: Lepidoptery Display (Moth-centric)
aspecteditems.description: A collection of lepidopteran insects with unusual characteristics.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一套拥有罕见特征的鳞翅目昆虫收藏品。

aspecteditems.name: Lepidoptery Display (Scale-centric)
aspecteditems.description: A collection of lepidopteran insects with unusual characteristics.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一套拥有罕见特征的鳞翅目昆虫收藏品。

aspecteditems.name: Lepidoptery Display (Winter-centric)
aspecteditems.description: A collection of lepidopteran insects with unusual characteristics.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一套拥有罕见特征的鳞翅目昆虫收藏品。

aspecteditems.name: Aspect of the Axe: Xenodice Half-Faced
aspecteditems.name_cn: 双角斧之面相：半面的刻赛诺狄刻
aspecteditems.description: One of the more enigmatic aspects of the Horned-Axe: Xenodice Half-Faced, who welcomes or slays strangers at the threshold. Xenodice is sister sometimes to owl and cat, sometimes to bull and butterfly, sometimes to dove and serpent. This hybrid nature suggests a link with the prehuman Carapace Cross - but that's not so surprising in a Name of the Axe.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 双角斧相对神秘的面相之一：半面的刻赛诺狄刻，于门关欢迎或残杀陌生人者。刻赛诺狄刻有时是鸮与猫的姐妹，有时则是公牛和蝴蝶的，还有时是鸽子同毒蛇的。这种混合的特质暗示了她与先于人类存在的介壳种间的联系——不过这对一位双角斧的具名者来说也不那么意外。

aspecteditems.name: Dartboard
aspecteditems.description: The THOCK of the darts punctuated the long evenings and drifted down the corridor to the grilled doors of the cells. (The ex-Tragulari always won, and rather soon, none of the other guards would play with them unless they agreed to a blindfold.)
aspecteditems.description_cn: 飞镖的笃笃声不时划破长夜，飘荡到楼下牢房铁栅门前的过道中。（前图拉古拉里们总是赢，于是不久之后，除非他们同意蒙上双眼，否则其他狱警就不愿意再和他们玩了。）

aspecteditems.name: Aspect of the Grail: Lagiah, the Queen Unsated
aspecteditems.name_cn: 圣杯之面相：拉吉亚，无餍女王
aspecteditems.description: One of the crueller aspects of the Red Grail: Lagiah, the Queen Unsated, devouring mother, sister-lover of Antaios. One tradition has it that Lagiah took animal form so that she could satisfy her craving to devour her own children, and go unpunished - another that the animal form was the punishment for her incest. The Grail has often been tolerant of contradictions. Perhaps her part in the Intercalate really was, after all, a long and subtle move to undermine Eternity. Or perhaps she's just not to be trusted.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 赤杯相对残忍的面相之一：拉吉亚，无餍女王，吞噬之母，安泰俄斯的胞妹与情人。一种传统观点称拉吉亚化作了兽形，如此她便能满足自己吞噬子嗣的欲望而又不受惩处——另一种说法则称化作兽形是对她乱伦的惩罚；赤杯对矛盾常常宽容以待。毕竟，也许她在置闰中的作用，就是用长久且微妙的行动去侵害永恒。亦或她就只是不可信任而已。

aspecteditems.name: Key Hooks
aspecteditems.description: All the keys of all the cells still hang here. I can unlock them all at my leisure… but the most significant cells of the Cucurbit were protected by more than locks. (The Least Cells I shouldn't trouble with. The keys to the Most Cells are labelled: ADEPT; LONG; W.I.; and, unhelpfully, ?)
aspecteditems.description_cn: 这上面依旧挂着每间牢房的钥匙。我或许能在闲暇时把它们全打开……但“炼金瓶”最重要的牢房不仅仅由锁具保护。（我似乎不该打扰那间最小的牢房。其余牢房的钥匙大多贴着标签：学徒、长生者、W·I，以及，无用的……？）

aspecteditems.name: Aspect of the Malachite: Mylissa, Queen and Palace
aspecteditems.name_cn: 石绿之面相：蜜丽莎，女王与宫殿
aspecteditems.description: One of the kinder aspects of the Malachite: Mylissa, both Queen and Palace, who feeds all comers, whose body is the house in which her children dwell. Mylissa was not always a Name of the Malachite. She may have been a Name of another Hour - she may even have begun among the Carapace Cross, before she chose Eternity over History.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 石绿相对仁慈的面相之一：蜜丽莎，既是女王亦是宫殿，她喂养一切来者，其身躯即是她子嗣的栖所。蜜丽莎并不总是石绿的具名者，她也可能曾是另一位司辰的具名——在选择永恒而非历史前，她甚至可能曾位列介壳种。

aspecteditems.name: HMS Kerisham
aspecteditems.description: A fourth-rate ship of the line captained by Sebastian Dewulf in the Battle of Quiberon Bay. Lost with all hands.
aspecteditems.description_cn: “凯尔伊苏姆”号是一艘在基伯龙湾战役中由塞巴斯蒂安·德沃尔夫担任船长的四等阵列舰。全员阵亡。

aspecteditems.name: Stained Glass Window: the Madrugad
aspecteditems.description: THAT WHICH IS NOT NEEDED, THAT SHALL BE QUENCHED
aspecteditems.description_cn: 无用之物，必被熄灭

aspecteditems.name: Stained Glass Window: the Meniscate
aspecteditems.description: WHAT IS WITHIN, WITHOUT; WHAT IS WITHOUT, WITHIN
aspecteditems.description_cn: 内外相易，表里互替

aspecteditems.name: Stained Glass Window: the Sun-in-Rags
aspecteditems.description: WHEN IT ENDS, IT WILL BE A BEAUTIFUL ENDING
aspecteditems.description_cn: 皆有结尾，结尾凄美

aspecteditems.name: Stained Glass Window: the Watchman
aspecteditems.description: THE WAY IS LIT FOR THE WILLING AND FOR THE UNWILLING
aspecteditems.description_cn: 路途为愿者，也为不愿者照亮

aspecteditems.name: Basket of Dirty Laundry
aspecteditems.description: Once washed, it'll be suitable again.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 只需清洗晾干便可以再穿。

aspecteditems.name: Basket of Clean Linen
aspecteditems.description: A night-time luxury.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 夜间难得的享受。

aspecteditems.name: Basket of Towels
aspecteditems.description: A suitable companion for bathing.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 沐浴时难得的享受。

aspecteditems.name: Basket of Damp Towels
aspecteditems.description: A bath-time luxury (but soggy from use, now.)
aspecteditems.description_cn: 沐浴时难得的享受。（但被用湿了，至少眼下如此）

aspecteditems.name: Book Press
aspecteditems.description: I am charged with the care of books, but it's important they don't forget who's in charge.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 我受任看护书籍，但让它们记住谁是这儿的老大也很重要。

aspecteditems.name: Kitchen Bowls
aspecteditems.description: CAKE TIME.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 蛋糕时间。

aspecteditems.name: Cucurbit Burette
aspecteditems.description: A vessel with an ambiguous history.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件来历不明的器皿。

aspecteditems.name: 'Abbot Geffrey'
aspecteditems.description: It was Abbot Geffrey who gave Natan of Regensburg sanctuary here, and decreed the building of the Barber's Tower where Natan and his family could dwell. In fifteenth-century England, only a determined and well-respected abbot could have persuaded the brothers to shelter a Jewish physician.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 正是杰弗里院长在这里为雷根斯堡的纳坦提供了避难所，并下令建造理发师塔，让纳坦和他的家人可以住在那里。在15世纪的英国，只有一位坚定而受人尊敬的院长才能说服修士们收留一位犹太医生。

aspecteditems.name: 'Abbot Thomas'
aspecteditems.description: Thomas was one of the first abbots here, just before the beginning of the Solar Gothic period. This bust is much more recent - a nineteenth-century bronze. An inscription reads: SPEECH, THE FIRST SWORD.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在太阳哥特时期开始之前，托马斯是这里最初的修道院长之一。而这尊半身像的时代要近得多——一尊19世纪青铜器。上书铭文：言辞，第一柄利刃。

aspecteditems.name: 'Abduction, Salvation'
aspecteditems.description: Either interpretation is plausible.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 两种解释都貌似有理。

aspecteditems.name: Pale Bust
aspecteditems.description: A delicate-featured young (?) woman. An inscription reads ABRA SOUTHEY.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一位气质纤柔的年轻（？）女性。下方的铭牌上写着艾博拉·骚赛。

aspecteditems.name: Goddess-who-drinks-light
aspecteditems.description: 'To every shadow her name.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “向每缕暗影献上她的名讳。”

aspecteditems.name: Goddess-who-changes-skin
aspecteditems.description: 'To every god her skin.'
aspecteditems.description_cn: “向每位神祇献上她的肌肤。”

aspecteditems.name: 'SISTER'
aspecteditems.description: Priestess? Oracle? Queen? A very old image from the Dawn Period with a simple inscription.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 祭司？神谕者？女王？拂晓时期的一尊古旧雕像，上有简单的铭文。

aspecteditems.name: Reference Image
aspecteditems.description: This is no kind of reference for conventional medicine…
aspecteditems.description_cn: 这东西肯定没法用作常规医学的参考……

aspecteditems.name: 'St Melancthe'
aspecteditems.description: Visionary, philosopher, alchemist. Most revered, and most heterodox, of the isle's abbesses. An inscription in Latin reads: THE CROSS DIED NOT BUT PASSED WITHIN.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 灵视者，哲学家，炼金术士。岛屿最受尊敬，也是最异端的女修道院长。上面用拉丁语写着：介壳种未曾死亡，而是存续于内。

aspecteditems.name: Meteoric Iron Candelabra
aspecteditems.description: Rough and dark to the touch.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 摸起来粗糙而厚重。

aspecteditems.name: Tall Candelabra
aspecteditems.description: The wind gusts, the flames flicker.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 阵风忽过，烛焰闪烁。

aspecteditems.name: Persian Candelabra
aspecteditems.description: A gift long ago from the Labyrinth of Lions.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一件很久以前来自群狮迷宫的赠礼。

aspecteditems.name: Lacquered Bone Chess Set
aspecteditems.description: Born of battles?
aspecteditems.description_cn: 诞于战火？

aspecteditems.name: Daybreak Clock
aspecteditems.description: A particularly unrepentant example of the roccoco style of the mid-eighteenth century.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 18世纪中叶洛可可风迂腐僵化的一大典例。

aspecteditems.name: Stepstrike Clock
aspecteditems.description: Tuned in an unlikely city to ensure its chimes attract the attention of the unseen.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它的时间被调整得与一座未然之城同步，以确保它能引起那些不可见存在的注意。

aspecteditems.name: Masquewatch Clock
aspecteditems.description: Reputedly crafted for the Masque of Masques during the Great Writhing.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 据说它是在“大蠕动”时期为假面赝会而制作的。

aspecteditems.name: Librarian's Timepiece
aspecteditems.description: One of Ambrose Westcott's appalling roccoco enthusiasms. This one, less ugly than some, was suffered to remain by his sentimental successors.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 安布罗斯·威斯考特洛可可风的狂热作品之一。这件相对不那么丑，所以他那多愁善感的继任者容许它留了下来。

aspecteditems.name: Ninewink Clock
aspecteditems.description: The most effective and irrefutable alarm clock ever to grace the House.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 有史以来最为好用且无可质疑的闹钟降临了居屋。

aspecteditems.name: Inscribed Clock
aspecteditems.description: A gift from Sir David Greene to a favoured retainer.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 大卫·格林爵士送给一位宠臣的礼物。

aspecteditems.name: Compasses
aspecteditems.description: Invaluable for accurate circles, for accurate navigation, and in a grave emergency, for self-defence.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 对于精准画圆、精确导航，以及在重大紧急情况时的自卫来说都是无价的。

aspecteditems.name: Twinned-Fish Stone
aspecteditems.description: This stone disc is lighter than it should be; and the surface is soapy-smooth.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 这只石盘比它应有的质量要轻；表面如肥皂般光滑。

aspecteditems.name: Half-Faceless Face
aspecteditems.description: A mask to fit a face that at the very least began as human.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一副为贴合初为人类的面庞而生的面具。

aspecteditems.name: Librarian's Glasses
aspecteditems.description: They're not lenses; just plain glass! But a certain sort of visitor is disappointed by a librarian who doesn't wear glasses.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 它们其实不是透镜；只是普通的玻璃！但是总有些访客会因为发现图书管理员不戴眼镜而感到失望。

aspecteditems.name: Lunar Globe
aspecteditems.description: It's the Earth; but silvered like the Moon, unlabelled, and pocked with craters.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 实际上还是地球；但如月亮般银光闪闪；没有任何标记，表面坑坑洼洼。

aspecteditems.name: Watchman's Globe
aspecteditems.description: The locations of each of the nine Libraries of the Watchman's Tree are clearly marked.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 守夜人之树九大图书馆的位置被准确无误地标记在上面。

aspecteditems.name: Serpent-Styled Glass
aspecteditems.description: Carved snakes writhe up the frame. A prominent inscription reads TO THE LIBRARIAN WILLEM IN EARNEST OF OUR WAGER.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 雕出的蛇纹自支架蜿蜒而上。一段显眼的铭文写道：谨以我等最郑重之赌约赠与图书管理员威廉。

aspecteditems.name: Serpent-Styled Glass
aspecteditems.description: Carved snakes writhe down the frame. A prominent inscription reads TO THE LIBRARIAN GERVINUS IN EARNEST OF OUR WAGER.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 雕出的蛇纹自支架蜿蜒而下。一段显眼的铭文写道：谨以我等最郑重之赌约赠与图书管理员格维努斯。

aspecteditems.name: Snootle Jar
aspecteditems.description: Useful for calcination, purification, alteration; invaluable for snootlery.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 对于煅烧、提纯、转化均有帮助；作为鼻颈品则是无价的。

aspecteditems.name: Hush House Key
aspecteditems.description: Heavy enough that it takes both hands to turn. Heavy enough to brain someone, though you'd need both hands for that too.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 重到需要两手才能转动；重到足够敲开某人的脑门——尽管这么干你也要用上双手。

aspecteditems.name: Bronze Knife
aspecteditems.description: A long knife of age-darkened metal with a teak handle inlaid with bone. It could be a hunting knife, although it's certainly no older than the nineteenth century, and it's not clear why anyone might have chosen to make a hunting knife out of bronze in the nineteenth century.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一把长刀，刀身因历经岁月而黯淡无光，柚木刀柄嵌有兽骨。它大概是把猎刀，尽管其年代肯定不早于十九世纪，也不知为何会有人在十九世纪选用青铜做猎刀。

aspecteditems.name: Fringed Lamp
aspecteditems.description: A cosy little night light.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一台温馨的小夜灯。

aspecteditems.name: Hurricane Lamp
aspecteditems.description: Proof against storm-wind and moth-swoop alike.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 能有效抵御暴风——以及扑来的飞蛾。

aspecteditems.name: Strategist's Lamp
aspecteditems.description: Purchased by Governor Collers from a complicated general after the Great War.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 由典狱长科勒斯于大战后从一位性情难测的将军处购得。

aspecteditems.name: Cyprian's Lamp
aspecteditems.description: A curio brought back from one of Serena Blackwood's trips to Greece.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 瑟雷娜·布莱克伍德在希腊旅行时带回来的一件珍品。

aspecteditems.name: Cartographer's Lamp
aspecteditems.description: A soft and welcome light.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 柔和而热情的光源。

aspecteditems.name: Mazarine Fife
aspecteditems.description: Whittled according to Kitty Mazarine's patient, eccentric instructions.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 根据凯蒂·马扎林耐心而古怪的指导削制而成。

aspecteditems.name: Regensburg Menorah
aspecteditems.description: A relic of the physician Natan of Regensburg.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 雷根斯堡的纳坦医生的遗物。

aspecteditems.name: Mirrorscope
aspecteditems.description: Bewildering and occasionally useful.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 令人困惑，偶尔有用。

aspecteditems.name: Mortar & Pestle
aspecteditems.description: CRUSH.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 用力捣。

aspecteditems.name: Yellowing Newspaper
aspecteditems.description: It's dated the year that Hush House was abandoned.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 日期定格在噤声居屋被废弃的那一年。

aspecteditems.name: Twilight Pot
aspecteditems.description: A stylised bat grimaces gleefully on its surface.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一只符号化的蝙蝠在它表面幸灾乐祸地做着鬼脸。

aspecteditems.name: Saw
aspecteditems.description: Eternally useful, though not for most librarians most of the time.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 永远派得上用场，虽然大多数情况下对大部分图书管理员都没什么用。

aspecteditems.name: Spice Scales
aspecteditems.description: Redolent of decades of piquant pesage.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 对辛辣之物长年累月的称量使其散发着浓烈的气味。

aspecteditems.name: Shears of the Sisterhood
aspecteditems.description: Black iron shears marked with the Sisterhood's triple knot.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 标有绳结姐妹会三重结印的黑铁剪刀。

aspecteditems.name: Cranial Tchotchke
aspecteditems.description: We all of us come to this condition in the end, but not all of us are fortunate enough to be lovingly buffed and fixed carefully to a stylish wooden stand.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 我们都终将沦落至此种境地，但并非所有人都足够幸运，能在被精心打磨后小心翼翼地固定在一个时髦的木头架子上。

aspecteditems.name: Contained Skull
aspecteditems.description: A skull sealed firmly beneath a glass dome, possibly to prevent misbehaviour.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一颗牢牢封存在玻璃圆罩下的颅骨，恐怕是为了预防不良行为。

aspecteditems.name: Glinting Cranial Tchotchke
aspecteditems.description: We all of us come to this condition in the end, but not all of us are fortunate enough to be lovingly buffed and fixed carefully to a stylish wooden stand.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 我们都终将沦落至此种境地，但并非所有人都足够幸运，能在被精心打磨后小心翼翼地固定在一个时髦的木头架子上。

aspecteditems.name: Spanners
aspecteditems.description: When you need 'em, you need 'em.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 该用的时候，它们自有妙用。

aspecteditems.name: Square
aspecteditems.description: The mason's pride.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 石匠的骄傲所在。

aspecteditems.name: White Matilda
aspecteditems.description: In 1093, twin infant girls were admitted to the care of the sisters here. Both were named Matilda. In 1127, the elder of the two became Abbess.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 1093年，年幼的双胞胎姐妹被送到这里，由修道院的修女们照顾。她们都叫玛蒂尔达。1127年，姐妹中更年长的那位成为了修道院的院长。

aspecteditems.name: Bobos of Spring
aspecteditems.description: A votive vessel for harvest offerings.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 在丰收时用于还愿的祭器。

aspecteditems.name: Cat of Depths
aspecteditems.description: A votive offering to the Horned-Axe.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一只献给双角斧的还愿祭品。

aspecteditems.name: Owl of Spirals
aspecteditems.description: An ancient bird for an ancient place.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一只古老之地的古老鸟儿。

aspecteditems.name: Pigeon Statuette
aspecteditems.description: A beautifully enamelled little image. The maker's mark is 'AW'.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一座精美的搪瓷小雕像。作者署名“AW”。

aspecteditems.name: 'The Velvet'
aspecteditems.description: An Hour of secrecy? Ignorance? Privacy? Shame? The Velvet has never encouraged insight, investigation, or worship. Even an image of her is unusual.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 她是掌管何物的司辰？守密？无知？隐私？羞耻？丝毧从未鼓励过洞察、研究或是崇拜，即便是她的造像也属罕见。

aspecteditems.name: Inscribed Stone
aspecteditems.description: A stone tablet with rows of badly worn scratches that once, probably, were writing.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一块石板，上面有一排排磨损严重、可能曾是文字的刻痕。

aspecteditems.name: Typewriter
aspecteditems.description: Now they call it unromantic. In fifty years it'll be the most romantic thing in the room.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 眼下他们嫌这玩意不浪漫。再过五十年，它就会变成这屋里最浪漫的东西。

aspecteditems.name: Silent Typewriter
aspecteditems.description: An unusual custom device.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一台不常见的定制款。

aspecteditems.name: Red Lotus Vase
aspecteditems.description: A red-glazed chinoiserie vase.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一只中式红釉花瓶。

aspecteditems.name: Watering Can
aspecteditems.description: Good for pottering.
aspecteditems.description_cn: 适合消遣。

aspecteditems.name: Hendrik's Blade
aspecteditems.description: A long hunting knife, or a short close-quarters sword. A plaque reads 'Hendrik Dewulf, 1525'
aspecteditems.description_cn: 一把长猎刀；或是一把偏短的格斗剑。一块牌匾上写着“亨德里克·德沃尔夫，1525”。

skills.name: Preliminal Meter
skills.description: 'Nine modes, nine horizons': the subtle rhythms of words which open ways.
skills.description_cn: “九种方式，九种视界”：开启众道路之言辞的微妙韵律。

skills.name: Pyroglyphics
skills.description: 'One script that all the world must read, even the blind, and it is written in flames.' Matters of fireworks and their kin - lights, colours, infernal detonations.
skills.description_cn: “一种全世界都必须阅读的字体，即使目盲之人也不例外，其书写于烈焰中。”一门关于烟火与其亲眷的技艺：光源，色彩，炼狱般的爆炸。

skills.name: Inks of Containment
skills.description: The inks in which the Histories are preserved.
skills.description_cn: 诸史在这些墨水中存续。

skills.name: Inks of Revelation
skills.description: The inks in which the Histories are revealed.
skills.description_cn: 诸史因这些墨水而揭露。

skills.name: Inks of Power
skills.description: The inks in which the Histories are written.
skills.description_cn: 诸史以这些墨水写就。

skills.name: Drums & Dances
skills.description: The first musics were not made by mortals, but taken; from sand-coil and sea-thorn, from flint-heart and dragon-womb.
skills.description_cn: 最初的音乐并非凡人的造物，而是得自他处；源于沙之虬蟠与海之荆棘，源于燧石之心与龙之子宫。

skills.name: Strings & Songs
skills.description: The harmonies of the lower skies are here reproduced.
skills.description_cn: 下层天域的和声于此重现。

skills.name: Bells & Brazieries
skills.description: That resonance which lingers from the hammer's touch.
skills.description_cn: 锤子敲擂而出的隆隆轰鸣，余音绕梁。

skills.name: Horns & Ivories
skills.description: The Hunter, the Way, and their memories.
skills.description_cn: 猎手，道路，与他们的回忆。

skills.name: Surgeries & Exsanguinations
skills.description: Surgery entails the flow of blood, and the flow of blood entails purification, but the door also opens the other way.
skills.description_cn: 手术必然涉及放血，而放血必然涉及净化，但此门也向另一个方向敞开。

skills.name: Stitching & Binding
skills.description: Nothing is entirely broken nor entirely whole - not so long as we have our needles.
skills.description_cn: 没有什么是完全破碎或全然完整的——只要我们手中还有针。

skills.name: Furs & Feathers
skills.description: Beasts, birds, husbandry, harvest.
skills.description_cn: 走兽，飞禽，畜牧，丰收。

skills.name: Pearl & Tide
skills.description: The depths of the sea, the waves upon the shore, and the memories of their withdrawal.
skills.description_cn: 大海的深邃，岸边的波涛，以及关于它们退去的回忆。

skills.name: Insects & Nectars
skills.description: The Hive, the Nest, and the Chrysalis are the three secret principalities of the lesser world. Two of those three know the temptations of sweetness.
skills.description_cn: 蜂房，巢穴和虫蛹是微观世界里的三个秘密公国。三者其二知晓甜蜜的诱惑。

skills.name: Herbs & Infusions
skills.description: Pluck it, powder it, mix it, warm it, drink it. But not that one.
skills.description_cn: 摘取，碾碎，混合，温煮，饮用。但不是那个。

skills.name: Spices & Savours
skills.description: There is no sacrifice without sustenance.
skills.description_cn: 没有食物就没有献祭。

skills.name: Leaves & Thorns
skills.description: There is no scent without sorrow.
skills.description_cn: 没有悲伤就没有知觉。

skills.name: Orchids & Narcotics
skills.description: There is no greed without beauty.
skills.description_cn: 没有美丽就没有贪婪。

skills.name: Serpents & Venoms
skills.description: These are the Mother's neglected children, and we prefer that they pass not through any door.
skills.description_cn: 这些是被母亲忽视的孩子，我们希望它们不要穿过任何一扇门扉。

skills.name: Sights & Sensations
skills.description: To mix the rarest colours, a merciless detachment is required.
skills.description_cn: 要混合最罕见的色彩，就得有不仁的超然。

skills.name: Desires & Dissolutions
skills.description: The boundaries between flesh, pearl, and pleasure are equally contingent.
skills.description_cn: 肉体，珍珠，以及愉悦之间的界限皆不可妄下定论。

skills.name: Resurgences & Emergences
skills.description: Birth and death are only directions. Between the two we find a crossroads.
skills.description_cn: 生诞与死亡是唯二的方向。于两者间我们觅得了一处交汇点。

skills.name: Rhyme & Remembrance
skills.description: To speak with the dead; to torment the living; to celebrate both.
skills.description_cn: 对话死者；纠缠生者；赞颂二者。

skills.name: Disciplines of the Hammer
skills.description: To purify and to combine the selves and the essences. The Hammer shapes gates and shatters doors, within us and without.
skills.description_cn: 自我与本质的净化以及结合；锤砧既塑造门扉也摧毁门扉，无论是在我们之外还是之内。

skills.name: Disciplines of the Scar
skills.description: To master boundaries through their determination. The Scar marks wisdom and regrets; one is often born from the other.
skills.description_cn: 以其决心掌握界限。伤疤既是智慧也是悔恨；其中一种常自另一种而生。

skills.name: Auroral Contemplations
skills.description: 'To know what will pass in what has passed.' The practitioners of this discipline see endings and beginnings, passages and transitions, in the same mode as dawn and sunset.
skills.description_cn: “见未来于过往。”实践此戒律者可见终末与起始，道路与转变，如见拂晓与日落。

skills.name: Applebright Euphonies
skills.description: 'Breath is the temptation of the soul.' Pleasures and insights that the Church would call 'the Secrets', the Sisterhood 'the Mysteries', and the Bureau 'unsanctioned.'
skills.description_cn: “呼吸乃灵魂的诱惑。”这种欢愉与洞见被教会称为“默祷”，姐妹会称为“秘礼”；而防剿局将其称为“未经批准”。

skills.name: Watchman's Paradoxes
skills.description: 'That amber preserves and is preserved by light; that to hatch is not to die; that the Sun.' There is a place behind the world called the Mansus. Deeds that would be impossible in the world are inevitable there. The Watchman, who knows all the ways of the Mansus, also knows how to make these deeds possible in the waking world.
skills.description_cn: “光藏于琥珀，琥珀存于光；待孵化者并未消亡；其为太阳。”漫宿隐于世界之后。世间不可能发生之事常在彼处发生。而通晓漫宿所有道路的守夜人知道怎样让这些不可能之事发生在醒时世界。

skills.name: Ragged Crossroads
skills.description: 'To understand why four paths were not taken.'
skills.description_cn: “且去理解为何四条道路未曾被选择。”

skills.name: Meniscate Reflections
skills.description: 'Without is purified, within is erased.'
skills.description_cn: “净化其外，抹消其内。”

skills.name: Putrefactions & Calcinations
skills.description: 'Death alters; Snow endures.' - Solomon Husher
skills.description_cn: “死亡更易；白雪存续。”——所罗门·赫舍

skills.name: Solutions & Separations
skills.description: The surgeon plies the knife and the mason plies the chisel. There are subtler tools than either.
skills.description_cn: 外科医生有手术刀，石匠有凿子；还有比这二者更精细的工具。

skills.name: Path & Pilgrim
skills.description: 'The traveller is always returning. One who does not is no traveller.' - Arun Peel
skills.description_cn: “旅者总会归来，不归者非是旅者。”——阿伦·褪皮

skills.name: Purifications & Exaltations
skills.description: 'No-one ever truly wants to be truly changed. Azoth and refulgin are justly feared. But no-one who has been changed would choose to go back.' - George Collers
skills.description_cn: “无人真正想被彻底改变。对阿佐特与耀素之恐惧是应当的。但从未有被改变者选择过回头。”——乔治·科勒斯

skills.name: Transformations & Liberations
skills.description: Forge and Moth are less different than we think. Every change is in some way a release.
skills.description_cn: 铸与蛾之间的差别没有我们以为的大。每次改变都是一次解放。

skills.name: Lockworks & Clockworks
skills.description: The little ways of little machines.
skills.description_cn: 微小机械中的微小道路。

skills.name: Sea Stories
skills.description: The sea has always been the widest road.
skills.description_cn: 大海从来都是最宽阔的道路。

skills.name: Wolf Stories
skills.description: Sometimes we eat the wolf, and sometimes the wolf eats us.
skills.description_cn: 有时我们吞食狼，有时狼吞食我们。

skills.name: Sand Stories
skills.description: Of wandering tribes, watchful vagabonds, and winged devourers.
skills.description_cn: 关于流浪的部落，警惕的浪游者，以及有翼的吞噬者。

skills.name: Sky Stories
skills.description: The nine winds gossip, and sometimes we can listen.
skills.description_cn: 九重风的闲言碎语，有时我们得以听闻。

skills.name: Snow Stories
skills.description: Of wind, woe, and winter.
skills.description_cn: 关于寒风，悲恸与严冬。

skills.name: Stone Stories
skills.description: Of the earth, of its forms, of dwellers living and dead.
skills.description_cn: 关于大地与它的形体，关于活着与死去的原住民。

skills.name: Vak
skills.description: Before gods arose from blood, before ever ape stood upright, this was the language heard in the House of the Sun.... 'I am Vak,' the Peacock Door boasted, 'both the tongue and the Goddess. I am the only entrance into secret light. I was worshipped before you upright apes, and I will be still when all of you are ugly ash. Listen, and I will prove it.'
skills.description_cn: 这是早于诸神自血中诞生，更早于猿人直立行走前，就能在太阳的居屋里听到的语言……“我是伐诃，”孔雀之门自夸道，“是语言亦是女神。我是进入秘密之光的唯一入口。我在你们这些直立猿猴存在前就受崇拜，到你们化为丑陋的灰烬后依然如此。听着，我会证明这点。”

skills.name: Deep Mandaic
skills.description: The most secret script of the innermost rites of the deep sects of the deep desert. The birth-tongue, it is claimed, of the Mother of Ants herself.
skills.description_cn: 深远的沙漠深处隐藏最深的关于最隐秘仪式的手迹。据说，它是蚁母其人与生俱来的语言。

skills.name: Killasimi
skills.description: If there is speech in Nowhere; if there is a language used by the Dead; if the House of the Moon has a native tongue; then it must be Killasimi. If none of this is true, it is still not a language to be spoken in daylight. Each word breathes woe. Read it, as they say, and weep.
skills.description_cn: 如果虚界里有言辞；如果有亡者使用的语言；如果月亮的居屋有其母语；那一定是夜魄语。哪怕这一切都不是真的，那它仍然不是一种能在日光下讲述的语言。每个字都诉说着哀恸。如其所言，读吧，然后流泪吧。

skills.name: Fucine
skills.description: A people lived east of the lost lake Fucino. Horace warned that theirs was the land of witches. This was their language, called by some 'the dry tongue' and by others 'the tongue of witches'.
skills.description_cn: 已经消失的富奇诺湖东侧曾有人居住。贺拉斯曾警告称，那里是女巫之地。而这便是她们的语言。有些人将之称作“干涸之语”，另一些人则称其为“女巫之语”。

skills.name: Sabazine
skills.description: There is a History where Alexander defeated first the Great Knot of Sabazos, and then the King of Kings. There is another History where, instead, he learnt from them. How many more? If we curl our hands into the correct shapes, we may yet understand.
skills.description_cn: 在一重历史中，亚历山大先是击败了萨巴佐斯的伟大绳结，而后击败了万王之王。在另一重历史中，他反而向他们学习。还有多少重历史呢？如果将手蜷曲成正确的形状，我们也许尚能理解。

skills.name: Cracktrack
skills.description: In the Tracks of Beasts, in the Convolutions of his own Carapace, in Egg-vein and Shell-shadow, the Many-Eyed One found the Signs which can be History.
skills.description_cn: 于野兽的踪迹里，于自身介壳的沟回中，于卵之脉与壳之影，多目者发现了那可为历史之兆。

skills.name: Hyksos
skills.description: The Shepherd-Kings brought this speech west from Canaan to use in their wards and snares. Had they never come to Egypt, they might never found a way to write it; given its addictive qualities, that might have been for the best.
skills.description_cn: 牧羊人之王们把这种言辞从迦南带到西方，用于他们的守御和陷阱。如果他们从来没有来过埃及，他们可能永远不会找到书写它的方法；考虑到它令人上瘾的性质，那可能是最好的结果。

skills.name: Ericapaean
skills.description: A language of surpassing beauty and allusiveness, revealed through the ecstatic apprehensions of the Orphics, the Eleusinians, and the Sibyls of the Rhine. Ericapaean, these mystics claimed, allows the elaboration of hues, sensations and states of mind too subtle for grosser tongues.
skills.description_cn: 一种极具美感和暗示性的语言，因俄耳甫斯教众、厄琉息斯教众和莱茵河的女先知们的狂热的认知而展露。这些神秘主义者声称，厄里卡帕奥语所能做出的有关色彩、感觉和精神状态的描绘对那些粗俗的语言来说太过精妙了。

skills.name: Ramsund
skills.description: This language has been called 'mantiq al-tair' and 'lenga aucel' and 'the speech of birds' and 'Ramsund' and 'the hazelnut tongue', but it's a language of secrets, and its true name may never be used. The aviform Hours use it at their Roost, or so the story goes.
skills.description_cn: 这种语言被称为“鸟会之辞”，“禽语”，“鸟言”，“拉姆桑德语”和“榛语”，但它是一种秘密的语言，其真实名称可能永远不会被使用。鸟形司辰在栖木用的就是这种语言，至少在故事里是如此。

skills.name: Sacra Solis Invicti
skills.description: The rites of the Church of the Unconquered Sun, and certain secrets of the gods-from-Light.
skills.description_cn: 无敌太阳教会所使用的仪式，光源诸神的某些秘密。

skills.name: Tridesma Hiera
skills.description: The rites of the Sisterhood of the Triple Knot, which include certain mysteries of the dwellers in the Wood behind the World.
skills.description_cn: 三重绳结姐妹会所使用的仪式，包含了某些栖息于世界背面的林地居民的秘密。

skills.name: Sacra Limiae
skills.description: The rites of an order of immortals who have tried to remain apart. These rites touch on secrets of Hours of the Mansus - chiefly gods-who-were-flesh and gods-from-Light.
skills.description_cn: 力图保持分离的不朽者组成的教团所使用的仪式。这些仪式触及了漫宿诸司辰的秘密——主要是肉源神与光源神的秘密。

skills.name: Sickle & Eclipse
skills.description: Salt and silver; balance, necessity and rebuke.
skills.description_cn: 盐与银；平衡、必要性与责难。

skills.name: Hill & Hollow
skills.description: The ways of the hill-children and the gods-from-stone. Old paths, old secrets, the songs that still echo beneath the earth.
skills.description_cn: 丘陵之子与石源神的道路。古老的道途，古老的秘密，大地之下仍在回荡的歌谣。

skills.name: Pentiments & Precursors
skills.description: Feats and feits of forgotten things: the Carapace Cross, the line of Antaios, the world of a low red sun. 'Though much is taken, much abides.'
skills.description_cn: 被遗忘的事物之事迹：介壳种，安泰俄斯的血脉，低垂的红太阳的世界。“失落虽多，留存亦多。”

skills.name: Coil & Chasm
skills.description: Worms, Seven-Coils, dangerous places; how earthquakes are bound and why they are released.
skills.description_cn: 蠕虫，七蟠，险域；何以束缚地震，以及为何要将其释放。

skills.name: Rites of the Roots
skills.description: The oldest Hours are the gods-from-blood, who rose from sacrifice. That blood was always spilt on the roots, and the rites of its spilling are still remembered.
skills.description_cn: 最古老的司辰是血源神，祂们从献祭中升起。那些鲜血总是被泼洒在根系，而洒血的仪式至今仍被铭记。

skills.name: Door & Wall
skills.description: 'The lock seeks its key, the wall seeks its door, and we who would pass learn at last that they are not our servants.' - Willem Harries
skills.description_cn: “锁寻钥，墙寻门，而意欲通过者终将明晓，它们并非唯命是从。”——威廉·哈里斯

skills.name: Edicts Liminal
skills.description: The precepts of limitation and division; established by the enigmatic conclave of Hours sometimes called the Chancel.
skills.description_cn: 制约与分隔的戒律；由司辰组成的神秘议会制定，其有时也被称为圣坛。

skills.name: Edicts Martial
skills.description: The precepts of struggle and conflict which drive the cosmic engine of change sometimes called the Corrivality.
skills.description_cn: 抗争与冲突的戒律，乃驱使寰宇变革之引擎，其有时也被称为角争。

skills.name: Edicts Inviolable
skills.description: The precepts of occlusion and dissolution; their jealous enforcement is the nature of the Calyptra.
skills.description_cn: 遮蔽与消解的戒律；确保其绝对执行乃根冠之天性。

skills.name: The Great Signs and the Great Scars
skills.description: Some glyphs are too obscure to reside in any language, but too potent to remain unwritten.
skills.description_cn: 有些字形太过隐晦，无法留存于任何语言；却也太过有力，无法不留下任何痕迹。

skills.name: Maggephene Mysteries
skills.description: 'The greater plagues may not be cured, only bound. The very greatest of all may only be entreated… and it is death to do so improperly.'
skills.description_cn: “严重的瘟疫无法治愈，只可遏制；最严重的瘟疫只能祈求……而失当的祈求则会招致死亡。”

skills.name: Weaving & Knotworking
skills.description: 'Hee hee hee hee hee hee hee hee hee. Hee.' - Valentine Dewulf
skills.description_cn: “嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。嘿。”——瓦伦丁·德沃尔夫

skills.name: Anbary & Lapidary
skills.description: 'Lightning is a little life, and jewels are its eyes.' - Eva Dewulf
skills.description_cn: “闪电是小小的生命，而宝石是它的眼睛。”——伊娃·德沃尔夫。

skills.name: Quenchings & Quellings
skills.description: Arts which quench fires and bring solace to the troubled mind. 'A true adept is never troubled by fire, nor by fever, nor by restless spirit.' - Ambrose Westcott
skills.description_cn: 熄灭火焰及慰藉忧心的技艺。“真正的能手永远不会被火焰、高温与焦躁的情绪困扰。”——安布罗斯·威斯考特

skills.name: Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting
skills.description: 'We are all vessels. Let us contain only what will grace us when the light shines through.' - Thirza Blake
skills.description_cn: “我们都是容器。让我们只容纳那些光芒照耀之时为我们增光添彩的事物吧。”——蒂尔扎·布雷克

skills.name: Glaziery & Lightsmithing
skills.description: 'Break a window. What have you made? A way? A new light? A weapon?' - Natalia Brulleau
skills.description_cn: “打破一扇窗户。你制成了何物？一条道路？一缕新光？一把武器？”——纳塔莉娅·布鲁洛夫

skills.name: Sharps
skills.description: Knives, dangers, and things out of place.
skills.description_cn: 刀具，危机，与错位之物。

skills.name: Ouranoscopy
skills.description: 'Consider the Star. Hath each Star, its Seven Names. Observe that these Names are Never Shared.' - Thomas Dewulf
skills.description_cn: “谛星，诸星皆具七名。探其不宣之名。”——托马斯·德沃尔夫

skills.name: Henavek
skills.description: Kernewek Henavek; the oldest form of the language now called Cornish; or something even older.
skills.description_cn: Kernewek Henavek（古老的康沃尔语）；现称康沃尔语的语言最古老的形式；可能是某种更古老的语言。

skills_r.name: Subject: Preliminal Meter
skills_r.description: 'Nine modes, nine horizons': the subtle rhythms of words which open ways.
skills_r.description_cn: “九种方式，九种视界”：开启众道路之言辞的微妙韵律。

skills_r.name: Subject: Pyroglyphics
skills_r.description: 'One script that all the world must read, even the blind, and it is written in flames.' Matters of fireworks and their kin - lights, colours, infernal detonations.
skills_r.description_cn: “一种全世界都必须阅读的字体，即使目盲之人也不例外，其书写于烈焰中。”一门关于烟火与其亲眷的技艺：光源，色彩，炼狱般的爆炸。

skills_r.name: Subject: Inks of Containment
skills_r.description: The inks in which the Histories are preserved.
skills_r.description_cn: 诸史在这些墨水中存续。

skills_r.name: Subject: Inks of Revelation
skills_r.description: The inks in which the Histories are revealed.
skills_r.description_cn: 诸史因这些墨水而揭露。

skills_r.name: Subject: Inks of Power
skills_r.description: The inks in which the Histories are written.
skills_r.description_cn: 诸史以这些墨水写就。

skills_r.name: Subject: Drums & Dances
skills_r.description: The first musics were not made by mortals, but taken; from sand-coil and sea-thorn, from flint-heart and dragon-womb.
skills_r.description_cn: 最初的音乐并非凡人的造物，而是得自他处；源于沙之虬蟠与海之荆棘，源于燧石之心与龙之子宫。

skills_r.name: Subject: Strings & Songs
skills_r.description: The harmonies of the lower skies are here reproduced.
skills_r.description_cn: 下层天域的和声于此重现。

skills_r.name: Subject: Bells & Brazieries
skills_r.description: That resonance which lingers from the hammer's touch.
skills_r.description_cn: 锤子敲擂而出的隆隆轰鸣，余音绕梁。

skills_r.name: Subject: Horns & Ivories
skills_r.description: The Hunter, the Way, and their memories.
skills_r.description_cn: 猎手，道路，与他们的回忆。

skills_r.name: Subject: Surgeries & Exsanguinations
skills_r.description: Surgery entails the flow of blood, and the flow of blood entails purification, but the door also opens the other way.
skills_r.description_cn: 手术必然涉及放血，而放血必然涉及净化，但此门也向另一个方向敞开。

skills_r.name: Subject: Stitching & Binding
skills_r.description: Nothing is entirely broken nor entirely whole - not so long as we have our needles.
skills_r.description_cn: 没有什么是完全破碎或全然完整的——只要我们手中还有针。

skills_r.name: Subject: Furs & Feathers
skills_r.description: Beasts, birds, husbandry, harvest.
skills_r.description_cn: 走兽，飞禽，畜牧，丰收。

skills_r.name: Subject: Pearl & Tide
skills_r.description: The depths of the sea, the waves upon the shore, and the memories of their withdrawal.
skills_r.description_cn: 大海的深邃，岸边的波涛，以及关于它们退去的回忆。

skills_r.name: Subject: Insects & Nectars
skills_r.description: The Hive, the Nest, and the Chrysalis are the three secret principalities of the lesser world. Two of those three know the temptations of sweetness.
skills_r.description_cn: 蜂房，巢穴和虫蛹是微观世界里的三个秘密公国。三者其二知晓甜蜜的诱惑。

skills_r.name: Subject: Herbs & Infusions
skills_r.description: Pluck it, powder it, mix it, warm it, drink it. But not that one.
skills_r.description_cn: 摘取，碾碎，混合，温煮，饮用。但不是那个。

skills_r.name: Subject: Spices & Savours
skills_r.description: There is no sacrifice without sustenance.
skills_r.description_cn: 没有食物就没有献祭。

skills_r.name: Subject: Leaves & Thorns
skills_r.description: There is no scent without sorrow.
skills_r.description_cn: 没有悲伤就没有知觉。

skills_r.name: Subject: Orchids & Narcotics
skills_r.description: There is no greed without beauty.
skills_r.description_cn: 没有美丽就没有贪婪。

skills_r.name: Subject: Serpents & Venoms
skills_r.description: These are the Mother's neglected children, and we prefer that they pass not through any door.
skills_r.description_cn: 这些是被母亲忽视的孩子，我们希望它们不要穿过任何一扇门扉。

skills_r.name: Subject: Sights & Sensations
skills_r.description: To mix the rarest colours, a merciless detachment is required.
skills_r.description_cn: 要混合最罕见的色彩，就得有不仁的超然。

skills_r.name: Subject: Desires & Dissolutions
skills_r.description: The boundaries between flesh, pearl, and pleasure are equally contingent.
skills_r.description_cn: 肉体，珍珠，以及愉悦之间的界限皆不可妄下定论。

skills_r.name: Subject: Resurgences & Emergences
skills_r.description: Birth and death are only directions. Between the two we find a crossroads.
skills_r.description_cn: 生诞与死亡是唯二的方向。于两者间我们觅得了一处交汇点。

skills_r.name: Subject: Rhyme & Remembrance
skills_r.description: To speak with the dead; to torment the living; to celebrate both.
skills_r.description_cn: 对话死者；纠缠生者；赞颂二者。

skills_r.name: Subject: Disciplines of the Hammer
skills_r.description: To purify and to combine the selves and the essences. The Hammer shapes gates and shatters doors, within us and without.
skills_r.description_cn: 自我与本质的净化以及结合；锤砧既塑造门扉也摧毁门扉，无论是在我们之外还是之内。

skills_r.name: Subject: Disciplines of the Scar
skills_r.description: To master boundaries through their determination. The Scar marks wisdom and regrets; one is often born from the other.
skills_r.description_cn: 以其决心掌握界限。伤疤既是智慧也是悔恨；其中一种常自另一种而诞生。

skills_r.name: Subject: Auroral Contemplations
skills_r.description: 'To know what will pass in what has passed.' The practitioners of this discipline see endings and beginnings, passages and transitions, in the same mode as dawn and sunset.
skills_r.description_cn: “见未来于过往。”实践此戒律者可见终末与起始，道路与转变，如见拂晓与日落。

skills_r.name: Subject: Applebright Euphonies
skills_r.description: 'Breath is the temptation of the soul.' Pleasures and insights that the Church would call 'the Secrets', the Sisterhood 'the Mysteries', and the Bureau 'unsanctioned.'
skills_r.description_cn: “呼吸乃灵魂的诱惑。”这种欢愉与洞见被教会称为“默祷”，姐妹会称为“秘礼”；而防剿局会说这是“未经批准的”。

skills_r.name: Subject: Watchman's Paradoxes
skills_r.description: 'That amber preserves and is preserved by light; that to hatch is not to die; that the Sun.' There is a place behind the world called the Mansus. Deeds that would be impossible in the world are inevitable there. The Watchman, who knows all the ways of the Mansus, also knows how to make these deeds possible in the waking world.
skills_r.description_cn: “光藏于琥珀，琥珀存于光；待孵化者并未消亡；其为太阳。”漫宿隐于世界之后。世间不可能发生之事常在彼处发生。而通晓漫宿所有道路的守夜人知道怎样让这些不可能之事发生在醒时世界。

skills_r.name: Subject: Ragged Crossroads
skills_r.description: 'To understand why four paths were not taken.'
skills_r.description_cn: “且去理解为何四条道路未曾被选择。”

skills_r.name: Subject: Meniscate Reflections
skills_r.description: 'Without is purified, within is erased.'
skills_r.description_cn: “净化其外，抹消其内。”

skills_r.name: Subject: Putrefactions & Calcinations
skills_r.description: 'Death alters; Snow endures.' - Solomon Husher
skills_r.description_cn: “死亡更易；白雪延续。”——所罗门·赫舍

skills_r.name: Subject: Solutions & Separations
skills_r.description: The surgeon plies the knife and the mason plies the chisel. There are subtler tools than either.
skills_r.description_cn: 外科医生有手术刀，石匠有凿子；还有比这二者更精细的工具。

skills_r.name: Subject: Path & Pilgrim
skills_r.description: 'The traveller is always returning. One who does not is no traveller.' - Arun Peel
skills_r.description_cn: “旅者总会归来，不归者非是旅者。”——阿伦·褪皮

skills_r.name: Subject: Purifications & Exaltations
skills_r.description: 'No-one ever truly wants to be truly changed. Azoth and refulgin are justly feared. But no-one who has been changed would choose to go back.' - George Collers
skills_r.description_cn: “无人真正想被彻底改变。对阿佐特与耀素之恐惧是应当的。但从未有被改变者选择过回头。”——乔治·科勒斯

skills_r.name: Subject: Transformations & Liberations
skills_r.description: Forge and Moth are less different than we think. Every change is in some way a release.
skills_r.description_cn: 铸与蛾之间的差别没有我们以为的大。每次改变都是一次解放。

skills_r.name: Subject: Lockworks & Clockworks
skills_r.description: The little ways of little machines.
skills_r.description_cn: 微小机械中的微小道路。

skills_r.name: Subject: Sea Stories
skills_r.description: The sea has always been the widest road.
skills_r.description_cn: 大海从来都是最宽阔的道路。

skills_r.name: Subject: Wolf Stories
skills_r.description: Sometimes we eat the wolf, and sometimes the wolf eats us.
skills_r.description_cn: 有时我们吞食狼，有时狼吞食我们。

skills_r.name: Subject: Sand Stories
skills_r.description: Of wandering tribes, watchful vagabonds, and winged devourers.
skills_r.description_cn: 关于流浪的部落，警惕的浪游者，以及有翼的吞噬者。

skills_r.name: Subject: Sky Stories
skills_r.description: The nine winds gossip, and sometimes we can listen.
skills_r.description_cn: 九重风的流言蜚语，有时我们得以听闻。

skills_r.name: Subject: Snow Stories
skills_r.description: Of wind, woe, and winter.
skills_r.description_cn: 关于寒风，悲恸与严冬。

skills_r.name: Subject: Stone Stories
skills_r.description: Of the earth, of its forms, of dwellers living and dead.
skills_r.description_cn: 关于大地与它的形体，关于活着与死去的原住民。

skills_r.name: Subject: Vak
skills_r.description: Before gods arose from blood, before ever ape stood upright, this was the language heard in the House of the Sun.... 'I am Vak,' the Peacock Door boasted, 'both the tongue and the Goddess. I am the only entrance into secret light. I was worshipped before you upright apes, and I will be still when all of you are ugly ash. Listen, and I will prove it.'
skills_r.description_cn: 这是早于诸神自血中诞生，更早于猿人直立行走前，就能在太阳居屋里听到的语言……“我是伐诃，”孔雀之门自夸道，“是语言亦是女神。我是进入秘密之光的唯一入口。我在你们这些直立猿猴存在前就受崇拜，到你们化为丑陋的灰烬后依然如此。听着，我会证明这点。”

skills_r.name: Subject: Deep Mandaic
skills_r.description: The most secret script of the innermost rites of the deep sects of the deep desert. The birth-tongue, it is claimed, of the Mother of Ants herself.
skills_r.description_cn: 深远的沙漠深处隐藏最深的关于最隐秘仪式的手迹。据说，它是蚁母其人与生俱来的语言。

skills_r.name: Subject: Killasimi
skills_r.description: If there is speech in Nowhere; if there is a language used by the Dead; if the House of the Moon has a native tongue; then it must be Killasimi. If none of this is true, it is still not a language to be spoken in daylight. Each word breathes woe. Read it, as they say, and weep.
skills_r.description_cn: 如果虚界里有言辞；如果有亡者使用的语言；如果月亮的居屋有其母语；那一定是夜魄语。哪怕这一切都不是真的，那它仍然不是一种能在日光下讲述的语言。每个字都诉说着哀恸。如其所言，读吧，然后流泪吧。

skills_r.name: Subject: Fucine
skills_r.description: A people lived east of the lost lake Fucino. Horace warned that theirs was the land of witches. This was their language, called by some 'the dry tongue' and by others 'the tongue of witches'.
skills_r.description_cn: 已经消失的富奇诺湖东侧曾有人居住。贺拉斯曾警告称，那里是女巫之地。而这便是她们的语言。有些人将之称作“干涸之语”，另一些人则称其为“女巫之语”。

skills_r.name: Subject: Sabazine
skills_r.description: There is a History where Alexander defeated first the Great Knot of Sabazos, and then the King of Kings. There is another History where, instead, he learnt from them. How many more? If we curl our hands into the correct shapes, we may yet understand.
skills_r.description_cn: 在一重历史中，亚历山大先是击败了萨巴佐斯的伟大绳结，而后击败了万王之王。在另一重历史中，他反而向他们学习。还有多少重历史呢？如果将手蜷曲成正确的形状，我们也许尚能理解。

skills_r.name: Subject: Cracktrack
skills_r.description: In the Tracks of Beasts, in the Convolutions of his own Carapace, in Egg-vein and Shell-shadow, the Many-Eyed One found the Signs which can be History.
skills_r.description_cn: 于野兽的踪迹里，于自身介壳的沟回中，于卵之脉与壳之影，多目者发现了那可为历史之兆。

skills_r.name: Subject: Hyksos
skills_r.description: The Shepherd-Kings brought this speech west from Canaan to use in their wards and snares. Had they never come to Egypt, they might never found a way to write it; given its addictive qualities, that might have been for the best.
skills_r.description_cn: 牧羊人之王们把这种言辞从迦南带到西方，用于他们的守御和陷阱。如果他们从来没有来过埃及，他们可能永远不会找到书写它的方法；考虑到它令人上瘾的性质，那可能是最好的结果。

skills_r.name: Subject: Ericapaean
skills_r.description: A language of surpassing beauty and allusiveness, revealed through the ecstatic apprehensions of the Orphics, the Eleusinians, and the Sibyls of the Rhine. Ericapaean, these mystics claimed, allows the elaboration of hues, sensations and states of mind too subtle for grosser tongues.
skills_r.description_cn: 一种极具美感和暗示性的语言，由俄耳甫斯教众、厄琉息斯教众和莱茵河的女先知们的狂热的认知而展露。这些神秘主义者声称，厄里卡帕奥语所能做出的有关色彩、感觉和精神状态的描绘对那些粗俗的语言来说太过精妙了。

skills_r.name: Subject: Ramsund
skills_r.description: This language has been called 'mantiq al-tair' and 'lenga aucel' and 'the speech of birds' and 'Ramsund' and 'the hazelnut tongue', but it's a language of secrets, and its true name may never be used. The aviform Hours use it at their Roost, or so the story goes.
skills_r.description_cn: 这种语言被称为“鸟会之辞”，“禽语”，“鸟言”，“拉姆桑德语”和“榛语”，但它是一种秘密的语言，其真实名称可能永远不会被使用。鸟形司辰在栖木用的就是这种语言，至少在故事里是如此。

skills_r.name: Subject: Sacra Solis Invicti
skills_r.description: The rites of the Church of the Unconquered Sun, and certain secrets of the gods-from-Light.
skills_r.description_cn: 无敌太阳教会所使用的仪式，光源诸神的某些秘密。

skills_r.name: Subject: Tridesma Hiera
skills_r.description: The rites of the Sisterhood of the Triple Knot, which include certain mysteries of the dwellers in the Wood behind the World.
skills_r.description_cn: 三重绳结姐妹会所使用的仪式，包含了某些栖息于世界背面的林地居民的秘密。

skills_r.name: Subject: Sacra Limiae
skills_r.description: The rites of an order of immortals who have tried to remain apart. These rites touch on secrets of Hours of the Mansus - chiefly gods-who-were-flesh and gods-from-Light.
skills_r.description_cn: 力图保持分离的不朽者组成的教团所使用的仪式。这些仪式触及了漫宿诸司辰的秘密——主要是肉源神与光源神的秘密。

skills_r.name: Subject: Sickle & Eclipse
skills_r.description: Salt and silver; balance, necessity and rebuke.
skills_r.description_cn: 盐与银；平衡、必要性与责难。

skills_r.name: Subject: Hill & Hollow
skills_r.description: The ways of the hill-children and the gods-from-stone. Old paths, old secrets, the songs that still echo beneath the earth.
skills_r.description_cn: 丘陵之子与石源神的道路。古老的道途，古老的秘密，大地之下仍在回荡的歌谣。

skills_r.name: Subject: Pentiments & Precursors
skills_r.name_cn: 主题：覆画残迹与古老前身
skills_r.description: Feats and feits of forgotten things: the Carapace Cross, the line of Antaios, the world of a low red sun. 'Though much is taken, much abides.'
skills_r.description_cn: 被遗忘的事物之事迹：介壳种，安泰俄斯的血脉，低垂的红太阳的世界。“失落虽多，留存亦多。”

skills_r.name: Subject: Coil & Chasm
skills_r.description: Worms, Seven-Coils, dangerous places; how earthquakes are bound and why they are released.
skills_r.description_cn: 蠕虫，七蟠，险域；何以束缚地震，以及为何要将其释放。

skills_r.name: Subject: Rites of the Roots
skills_r.description: The oldest Hours are the gods-from-blood, who rose from sacrifice. That blood was always spilt on the roots, and the rites of its spilling are still remembered.
skills_r.description_cn: 最古老的司辰是血源神，祂们从献祭中升起。那些鲜血总是被泼洒在根系，而洒血的仪式至今仍被铭记。

skills_r.name: Subject: Door & Wall
skills_r.description: 'The lock seeks its key, the wall seeks its door, and we who would pass learn at last that they are not our servants.' - Willem Harries
skills_r.description_cn: “锁寻钥，墙寻门，而意欲通过者终将明晓，它们并非唯命是从。”——威廉·哈里斯

skills_r.name: Subject: Edicts Liminal
skills_r.description: The precepts of limitation and division; established by the enigmatic conclave of Hours sometimes called the Chancel.
skills_r.description_cn: 制约与分隔的戒律，圣坛司辰间的枢机会议制定了它们。

skills_r.name: Subject: Edicts Martial
skills_r.description: The precepts of struggle and conflict which drive the cosmic engine of change sometimes called the Corrivality.
skills_r.description_cn: 抗争与冲突的戒律，乃驱使寰宇变革之引擎，其有时也被称为角争。

skills_r.name: Subject: Edicts Inviolable
skills_r.description: The precepts of occlusion and dissolution; their jealous enforcement is the nature of the Calyptra.
skills_r.description_cn: 遮蔽与消解的戒律；确保其绝对执行乃根冠之天性。

skills_r.name: Subject: The Great Signs and the Great Scars
skills_r.name_cn: 主题：伟大符印与伟大伤疤
skills_r.description: Some glyphs are too obscure to reside in any language, but too potent to remain unwritten.
skills_r.description_cn: 有些字形太过隐晦，无法留存于任何语言；却也太过有力，无法不留下任何痕迹。

skills_r.name: Subject: Maggephene Mysteries
skills_r.description: 'The greater plagues may not be cured, only bound. The very greatest of all may only be entreated… and it is death to do so improperly.'
skills_r.description_cn: “严重的瘟疫无法治愈，只可遏制；最严重的瘟疫只能祈求……而失当的祈求则会招致死亡。”

skills_r.name: Subject: Weaving & Knotworking
skills_r.description: 'Hee hee hee hee hee hee hee hee hee. Hee.' - Valentine Dewulf
skills_r.description_cn: “嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。嘿。”——瓦伦丁·德沃尔夫

skills_r.name: Subject: Anbary & Lapidary
skills_r.description: 'Lightning is a little life, and jewels are its eyes.' - Eva Dewulf
skills_r.description_cn: “闪电是小小的生命，而宝石是它的眼睛。”——伊娃·德沃尔夫。

skills_r.name: Subject: Quenchings & Quellings
skills_r.description: Arts which quench fires and bring solace to the troubled mind. 'A true adept is never troubled by fire, nor by fever, nor by restless spirit.' - Ambrose Westcott
skills_r.description_cn: 熄灭火焰及慰藉忧心的技艺。“真正的能手永远不会被火焰、高温与焦躁的情绪困扰。”——安布罗斯·威斯考特

skills_r.name: Subject: Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting
skills_r.name_cn: 主题：玻璃吹制与容器制造
skills_r.description: 'We are all vessels. Let us contain only what will grace us when the light shines through.' - Thirza Blake
skills_r.description_cn: “我们都是容器。让我们只容纳那些光芒照耀之时为我们增光添彩的事物吧。”——蒂尔扎·布雷克

skills_r.name: Subject: Glaziery & Lightsmithing
skills_r.description: 'Break a window. What have you made? A way? A new light? A weapon?' - Natalia Brulleau
skills_r.description_cn: “打破一扇窗户。你制成了何物？一条道路？一缕新光？一把武器？”——纳塔莉娅·布鲁洛夫

skills_r.name: Subject: Sharps
skills_r.description: Knives, dangers, and things out of place.
skills_r.description_cn: 刀具，危机，与错位之物。

skills_r.name: Subject: Ouranoscopy
skills_r.description: 'Consider the Star. Hath each Star, its Seven Names. Observe that these Names are Never Shared.' - Thomas Dewulf
skills_r.description_cn: “谛星，诸星皆具七名。探其不宣之名。”——托马斯·德沃尔夫

skills_r.name: Subject: Henavek
skills_r.description: Kernewek Henavek; the oldest form of the language now called Cornish; or something even older.
skills_r.description_cn: Kernewek Henavek（古老的康沃尔语）；现称康沃尔语的语言最古老的形式；可能是某种更古老的语言。

incidents.name: A Consultation
incidents.description: Someone would like to know something.
incidents.description_cn: 有人想要了解某事。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Messenger's Casket
incidents.description: In a hidden fold of the mountains above the city of Cluj lies the enigmatic relic they call Saint Mihail's Coffin. Decades of patient work have finally breached its outer shell. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=knock> or <sprite name=moon> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 在克卢日市上方山脉某处隐秘的山谷中，有一个神秘的遗迹，人们称其为圣米哈尔之棺。几代人的不懈努力终于在它的外壳上凿出了裂痕。[对<sprite name=knock> 或 <sprite name=moon> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

moon.label: Acted: Peel
moon.description: Dr Peel, confident that the occupant of St Mihail's Coffin would escape soon, was equally confident that someone, or something, would be eaten by something, or someone. He seemed quite chipper about it.
moon.description_cn: 褪皮博士认为圣米哈尔之棺里的住客很快就会逃脱；他也同样相信届时会有某人或某物被某物或某人吃掉。他似乎为此感到相当快活。

moon.label: Acted: Connie
moon.description: MCO Lee suspected St Mihail's Coffin might contain a name of the Chandler... perhaps, she said, the second one she'd heard mentioned that year. She was clearly perturbed by the possibility.
moon.description_cn: 副警监李怀疑圣米哈尔之棺内可能收容着一位制烛人的具名者……按照她的说法，这似乎是她今年第二次听说此类情况。她对此种可能性感到忧虑。

knock.label: Acted: Coquille
knock.description: Princess Coquille believed she'd learnt from her research at Hush House how to breach the Coffin.
knock.description_cn: 贵胄科基尔相信，她已经在噤声居屋从研究中学到了该如何打开棺柩。

knock.label: Acted: Dagmar
knock.description: 'Daymare' left Hush House with a plan to ensure 'St Mihail', whatever he might actually be, stayed in his coffin.
knock.description_cn: “日魇”带着自己的计划离开了噤声居屋，以确保“圣米哈尔”能待在他的灵柩里——不论他的真面目可能为何。

moon.label: Acted: Yvette
moon.description: Dr Southey, inspired by the stories of St Mihail's Coffin to look into the story of St Columba's sarcophagus, seemed to find what she sought. 'Always the tide,' she said...
moon.description_cn: 骚赛博士，受到圣米哈尔之棺传闻的启发，前来研究圣哥伦巴石棺的传说，并且似乎找到了她想要的东西。“浪潮依旧”，她说到……

knock.label: Acted: Zachary
knock.description: Zachary Wakefield seemed to think he had found the name of the coffin's key, here at Hush House.
knock.description_cn: 扎迦利·韦克菲尔德似乎认为自己在噤声居屋找到了棺柩钥匙的名字。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Grunewald Provision
incidents.name_cn: 格吕内瓦尔德条款事件
incidents.description: After the dissolution of Grunewald's Permanent Circus, its assets were disposed of by the Bureau. That was during one of the Bureau's occasional funding crises, and the 'Grunewald Provision' sanctioned the sale of the Circus' assets for cash, bypassing some of the usual checks for oneiric hazard. In hindsight, this has started to look like a mistake. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=heart> or <sprite name=winter> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 格吕内瓦尔德的长驻马戏团解散后，其资产由防剿局处理。在一次防剿局偶发的资金危机时，“格吕内瓦尔德条款”批准将马戏团的资产出售换取现金，而绕过了对其梦境危险的常规检查。事后看来，这可能是个错误。[对 <sprite name=heart> 或 <sprite name=winter> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

heart.label: Acted: Agdistis
heart.description: Mr Agdistis resolved to do his best to help a friend who'd purchased cursed items.
heart.description_cn: 阿格狄斯提斯先生决定尽他所能去帮助那位不慎购买了被诅咒藏品的朋友。

heart.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
heart.description: DI Moore set off to resolve the Grunewald problem, buoyed by what he'd learnt at Hush House.
heart.description_cn: 受他在噤声居屋学到东西的鼓舞，启明警探摩尔前去解决格吕内瓦尔德造成的麻烦。

heart.label: Acted: Ehsan
heart.description: Ehsan, requested by the Bureau to help them resolve the Grunewald matter, came to Hush House seeking ways to protect himself during the process.
heart.description_cn: 埃桑应防剿局之请，帮助他们解决格吕内瓦尔德相关事务，他来噤声居屋寻找在此过程中的自保之法。

heart.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
heart.description: Father Schaller set off for the Grove of Green Immortals with a 'restless waxwork' - after finding what he needed at Hush House, to keep the thing contained on the journey.
heart.description_cn: 沙勒神父带着一件“不安分的蜡像”去了翠仙苑——在他前来噤声居屋，找到了能在旅途中控制住那东西的方法之后。

winter.label: Acted: Yvette
winter.description: Dr Southey had purchased one of the Grunewald articles. What she learnt at Hush House convinced her to dispose of it.
winter.description_cn: 骚赛博士买了件格吕内瓦尔德的物品。她在噤声居屋的所学所见让她确信该去把它处理掉。

winter.label: Acted: Zachary
winter.description: Zachary Wakefield concluded obscurely that, in the Grunewald matter, he might have enough to understand the possibilities of clarities, conducivities, and 'ovitic forms'.
winter.description_cn: 扎迦利·韦克菲尔德晦涩地总结道，在格吕内瓦尔德这件事中，他也许有足够的能力理解清晰，传导，以及“卵态”的可能性了。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Oriflamme Heist
incidents.description: Oriflamme's Auction House is never robbed. But what if it has been? What if, somehow, priceless treasures have been replaced with pricey forgeries? How could we even be sure? [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=knock> or <sprite name=forge> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 奥里弗拉姆拍卖行不会被盗。但如果这事已经发生了呢？万一无价的藏品被高价的赝品取代了呢？又有谁能保证呢？[对<sprite name=knock> 或 <sprite name=forge> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

knock.label: Acted: Coquille
knock.description: Princess Coquille, investigating ways by which the Oriflamme Heist might have been managed, happened across 'something rather smashing.'
knock.description_cn: 贵胄科基尔在调查奥里弗拉姆失窃案的具体手法的过程中，碰巧发现了某种“更加轰动的东西”。

knock.label: Acted: Dagmar
knock.description: 'Daymare' was clearly concerned that she might be blamed for the heist, real or not, justly or not - but her researches at Hush House gave her hope that she might escape suspicion.
knock.description_cn: “日魇”显然担心自己可能会被指认为某场盗窃案的罪魁祸首，不论她是否真做了这件事——她在噤声居屋的研究结果都给了她洗清嫌疑的希望。

forge.label: Acted: Hokobald
forge.description: Magister Hokobald, employed by Oriflamme's to make improvements to their vault, thought he might have have found useful information at Hush House... although he was careful to point out that it wasn't very useful.
forge.description_cn: 霍科博尔德大师，受奥里弗拉姆的雇佣去改造他们的金库，认为自己可能已经在噤声居屋找到了有用的信息……尽管他也谨慎地指出那并不是非常地有用。

forge.label: Acted: Olympe
forge.description: Mme Bechet thought she'd identified oddities in Oriflamme's account of their security measures... and what she found at Hush House encouraged her to look into the matter further.
forge.description_cn: 贝谢女士认为，她在奥里弗拉姆对其安全措施的描述中发现了一些奇怪之处……而她在噤声居屋的发现给了她进一步调查此事的动力。

forge.label: Acted: Serena
forge.description: Dr Blackwood suspected that someone at Oriflamme's had invented the story of the heist themselves. She couldn't imagine why - but she learnt enough from me to be taken seriously by her contact there.
forge.description_cn: 布莱克伍德博士怀疑是奥里弗拉姆内部的某人编造了整个失窃案件。她想不出原因——但她在我这里了解的信息足以让她在那里的联络人认真对待此事。

knock.label: Acted: Zachary
knock.description: Zachary Wakefield was close-mouthed about his suspicions of what had really happened at Oriflamme's, but he did share one hint: 'One door closes, another door opens. And another.'
knock.description_cn: 扎迦利·韦克菲尔德对他关于奥里弗拉姆事件真相的猜测守口如瓶，但他确实给了一个暗示：“一门闭，一扉启，另有一扉。”

incidents.name: The Affair of the Second Skin
incidents.description: Immortals change more slowly than most of us - but even immortals change sometimes. In the city of Marrakech, the labhite Abecassis has begun a dramatic and dangerous metamorphosis - one that's alarming friends and enemies alike… [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=edge> or <sprite name=scale> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 不朽者的变化比我们大多数人都要缓慢——可就算是不朽者有时也会变化。在马拉喀什城，狻猊阿贝卡西斯已经开始了一场剧烈而危险的蜕变——让他的敌友都为之震惊……[对 <sprite name=edge> 或 <sprite name=scale> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

scale.label: Acted: al-Adim
scale.description: The Aleppine came to believe that Abecassis had accepted gifts of sustenance from 'she who suckles serpents.'
scale.description_cn: 阿勒颇人开始相信阿贝卡西斯已经接受了“为蛇哺乳之人”向他提供的食物。

edge.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
edge.description: Lieutenant Moore resolved to take Abecassis into the custody of the Labyrinth of Lions.
edge.description_cn: 摩尔中尉决定将阿贝卡西斯交由群狮迷宫看管。

edge.label: Acted: Azita
edge.description: The Edge-long Azita's eternal enemy-twin, Mehrad, planned to give Abecassis death with honour. With regret, Azita set out to prevent this.
edge.description_cn: 刃之长生者阿齐塔永恒的孪敌，迈哈德，计划让阿贝卡西斯光荣地死去。带着歉意，阿齐塔决定着手于阻止此事发生。

edge.label: Acted: Chaima
edge.description: Lalla Chaima set out to end Abecassis' misery... although her ultimate intention remained uncertain, even to her.
edge.description_cn: 拉拉·柴玛出发去结束阿贝卡西斯的痛苦……尽管她的最终目的依然不太明确，即便对她自己来说也是如此。

scale.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
scale.description: Fraser Strathcoyne hoped, but not did expect, to shield Abecassis from his hunters.
scale.description_cn: 弗雷泽·斯特拉思科因希望，但并不指望自己能从猎人们手下护住阿贝卡西斯。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Endless Guest
incidents.description: An 'inhabitation of Worms' is never to be taken lightly. In this case, Worms have chosen to inhabit one Spencer Hobson, on assignment by the Bureau in Kraków. Hobson has remained unusually articulate for an inhabitee; and apparently, he considers the Worms his 'guest'. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=knock> or <sprite name=winter> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 对“蠕虫的栖所”决不能掉以轻心。在这次的案例中，蠕虫已选择栖居在斯宾塞·霍布森体内，后者正在克拉科夫执行防剿局的任务。以栖所的标准来看，霍布森始终保持着异乎寻常的表达能力；显然，他认为蠕虫们是自己的“客人”。[对 <sprite name=knock> 或 <sprite name=winter> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

knock.label: Acted: Coquille
knock.description: Princess Coquille suspected that the irruption of Worms in Kraków might be connected, somehow, with the sword Ebrehel.
knock.description_cn: 贵胄科基尔认为克拉科夫的蠕虫入侵，似乎与艾布雷赫剑有某种联系。

knock.label: Acted: Dagmar
knock.description: 'Daymare', unimpressed by the Bureau's claims of expertise, set off to Kraków to make sure that the seals restraining the Worms were up to her standards.
knock.description_cn: “日魇”对防剿局自称的专业性不以为意。她动身前往克拉科夫，以确保拘束蠕虫的防护措施符合自己的标准。

winter.label: Acted: Yvette
winter.description: Dr Southey went to interview Hobson in Kraków - but came first to Hush House to ensure she understood the hazards that might entail.
winter.description_cn: 骚赛博士去往克拉科夫与霍布森面谈——但她先来到了噤声居屋，已确保自己了解可能承担的风险。

knock.label: Acted: Zachary
knock.description: Zachary Wakefield opined that Hobson, who had been his friend, might now be his friends. Faced with a choice between 'out' and 'down', he chose 'out'.
knock.description_cn: 扎迦利·韦克菲尔德认为，他的朋友霍布森，现在可能已经是他的朋友们了。在“向外”和“向下”的选择上，他选择了“向外”。

winter.label: Acted: Zachary
winter.description: Zachary Wakefield opined that Hobson, who had been his friend, might now be his friends. Faced with a choice between 'out' and 'down', he chose 'down'.
winter.description_cn: 扎迦利·韦克菲尔德认为，他的朋友霍布森，现在可能已经是他的朋友们了。在“向外”和“向下”的问题上，他选择了“向下”。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Dappled Rose
incidents.description: In the hissing wastes of sand where once stood a city called Miah… another man has died. But he almost made it out. He made it far enough that a goatherd found him, raving to the end about gardens, with a flower crushed in his hand. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=moth> or <sprite name=rose> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 在嘶鸣的荒沙中，曾经矗立着一座名叫弥阿的城市……又有一个人死在了那里。但他只差一点点就能活着离开。他走了足够远，足够让一个牧羊人在他死之前找到自己。他嘟囔着有关花园的胡话直到咽气，手里还紧攥着一朵皱巴巴的花。[对 <sprite name=moth> 或 <sprite name=rose> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

rose.label: Acted: al-Adim
rose.description: At the behest of his patron the Vagabond, the Aleppine set out to find the piebald garden in the wastes... but his heart was troubled within him.
rose.description_cn: 在他的庇护者浪游旅人的要求下，阿勒颇人前去荒沙中寻找那座斑驳的花园……但他对此忧虑重重。

moth.label: Acted: Peel
moth.description: Dr Peel, as so often, found what he sought at Brancrug, delivered himself of a riddle, and departed, his intentions still obscure.
moth.description_cn: 褪皮博士与往常一样在布兰库格找到了他想要的东西，从一个谜语中解脱，然后自顾自离开。他的目的依然不清楚。

rose.label: Acted: Chaima
rose.description: Lalla Chaima undertook a commission for the Bureau in Miah - whether to find the piebald garden, or conceal it, was never clear.
rose.description_cn: 拉拉·柴玛从防剿局那接到了一项位于弥阿的委托。至于是要她找到斑驳花园，亦或是将它藏匿，就不清楚了。

rose.label: Acted: Dagmar
rose.description: Something in the story of the Dappled Rose made 'Daymare' wonder if she should return to Miah, one more time...
rose.description_cn: 斑驳玫瑰的故事中的某些东西触动了“日魇”，让她开始犹豫，自己是否应该再次回到弥阿……

moth.label: Acted: Olympe
moth.description: Mme Bechet had no intention of going all the way to Miah... but after researching the matter at the House, she remembered an associate who might go there on her behalf.
moth.description_cn: 贝谢女士不打算亲自去弥阿……但在居屋里研究过相关的事件后，她想起一位熟人也许可以代她前去。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Forgivable Debt
incidents.description: Like many criminal enterprises, Reckoners offer loans to the desperate and unwary - but Reckoners can offer loans not only of cash, but of allotted years of life. They usually keep a low profile, but now two Reckoner mobs have gone to war in the unremarkable Lithuanian city of Kaunas. Why? What's in Kaunas? [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=moon> or <sprite name=edge> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 和许多犯罪集团一样，清算人向孤注一掷和掉以轻心的人提供贷款，但清算人提供的贷款不仅包括金钱，还包括可调取的年岁。他们一般低调行事，但现在有两伙清算人暴徒在在立陶宛一座并不起眼的城市——考纳斯开战了。为什么会这样？考纳斯里有什么？[对 <sprite name=moon> 或 <sprite name=edge> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

edge.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
edge.description: Lieutenant Moore found the weapon he needed to put down Reckoners in Kaunas.
edge.description_cn: 摩尔中尉找到了可用来干掉考纳斯的清算人的武器。

moon.label: Acted: Peel
moon.description: Dr Peel went off to Kaunas to collect knives, or sow confusion, or bring peace. Or something.
moon.description_cn: 褪皮博士打算去考纳斯收集刀具，或是制造困惑和混乱，或是带去和平。或是别的什么。

edge.label: Acted: Azita
edge.description: Azita went to Kaunas to, she claimed, knock Reckoners' heads together.
edge.description_cn: 阿齐塔去了考纳斯，她声称，要按着清算人的脑袋，让他们坐下来谈谈。

edge.label: Acted: Chaima
edge.description: Lalla Chaima set off, without enthusiasm, to complete a commission for a Reckoner lord in the sewers of Kaunas.
