edge.description_cn: 拉拉·柴玛毫无热情地出发了，去考纳斯的下水道里完成一位清算人领主的委托。

moon.label: Acted: Connie
moon.description: MCO Lee, greatly concerned that a Reckoner might somehow have found a way to cheat the Madrugad, left for Kaunas in a hurry.
moon.description_cn: 副警监李十分担心可能有清算人已经找到了某种能欺骗昕旦的方法，匆忙赶往考纳斯。

moon.label: Acted: Yvette
moon.description: Dr Southey came to suspect the Reckoner trade in years of life might explain how an ancestor at Brancrug had borne a child so late in life...
moon.description_cn: 骚赛博士开始怀疑，清算人们对岁月的买卖大概可以解释她在布兰库格的某位先人是如何在如此高龄育有一子……

incidents.name: The Affair of the Particular Mystique
incidents.description: The Suppression Bureau has a growing interest in the recent fad for unconventional - often prophetic - religious movements. No laws have been broken. Nothing sinister has come to light. All these movements are comfortingly Solar in nature. But there does seem to be something going on. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=winter> or <sprite name=lantern> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 防剿局对最近盛行的非传统——通常是预言性的——宗教运动越来越感兴趣。没有任何法律被触犯。没有发现任何犯罪举动。所有这些运动本质上都是令人欣慰的太阳崇拜运动。但似乎确实有什么事正在发生。[对 <sprite name=winter> 或 <sprite name=lantern> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

lantern.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
lantern.description: Lieutenant Moore dared to hope that he might begin to understand 'the Sun's Plan'.
lantern.description_cn: 摩尔中尉希望他已经开始理解所谓“太阳的计划”。

lantern.label: Acted: Corso
lantern.description: Corso suggested that the new doctrines had suggested a connection to him - between the enigmatic Hour called the Chandler, and a Name of the Watchman: Sunset Celia.
lantern.description_cn: 科尔索认为，最近兴起的教派向他暗示了某种联系——名为制烛人的神秘司辰，与守夜人的具名者日落西莉亚之间的联系。

lantern.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
lantern.description: DI Moore was mostly concerned that the cults might be a breeding ground for Long - and so increase the incidence of the Crime of the Sky.
lantern.description_cn: 启明警探摩尔最担心的是那些教派可能成为新长生者的摇篮——进而增加发生天孽的风险。

lantern.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
lantern.description: Fraser Strathcoyne believed that something had drawn the Obliviates - the Long who'd secluded themselves in Port Noon - back to the world.
lantern.description_cn: 弗雷泽·斯特拉思科因相信有某种东西促使忘却会——退居午港的长生者团体——重返了世间。

lantern.label: Acted: Serena
lantern.description: Dr Blackwood dismissed the whole business of cults as a popular delusion in a time of change.
lantern.description_cn: 布莱克伍德博士对那些教派嗤之以鼻，认为这只是动荡时代的一种普遍妄想。

winter.label: Acted: Yvette
winter.description: Dr Southey refused the blandishments of the cult called the Ivory Dawn... but suspected that they honoured her by reason of a 'pre-immortal' in her ancestry.
winter.description_cn: 骚赛博士拒绝了一个叫做“骨白拂晓”的教派的邀请……她怀疑，他们之所以如此崇拜她，是因为她的祖先里有位“准不朽者”。

winter.label: Acted: Zachary
winter.description: It wasn't clear what Zachary Wakefield intended with the new crop of cults... but it was clear that it was nothing especially constructive.
winter.description_cn: 尚不清楚扎迦利·韦克菲尔德对那些新兴教派持何态度……但很明显，他并没有给出什么特别有建设性的见解。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Claw and the Clouds
incidents.description: From the far monastery of St Tentreto in the Evening Isles, we hear uncertain and contradictory stories, of unexpected visitors - visitors from behind the sky.  [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=scale> or <sprite name=sky> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 在那薄暮群屿，在遥远的圣滕特雷托僧院，我们听到了一些真伪莫辨而互相矛盾的故事，讲述了关于不速之客——来自天空之后的访客的传闻。[对<sprite name=scale> 或 <sprite name=sky> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

sky.label: Acted: Agdistis
sky.description: Mr Agdistis decided to ignore the summoning to go West, electing to reject the possibility of transformation, and remain what he was.
sky.description_cn: 阿格狄斯提斯先生已经决定无视来自西方的召唤，选择拒绝转变的可能，保持现在的模样。

scale.label: Acted: al-Adim
scale.description: The Aleppine resolved that the Cross-business in the clouds above St Tentreto was worthy of his attention.
scale.description_cn: 阿勒颇人断定，在圣滕特雷托僧院上空云层出现的介壳种踪迹值得自己去关注。

sky.label: Acted: Azita
sky.description: The Edge-long Azita came to believe that her enemy-twin Mehrad was one of those in whom the Cross-nature endured; and she followed him West.
sky.description_cn: 刃之长生者阿齐塔开始相信，她的孪敌迈哈德是那些遗留有介壳种天性的人中的一员；她决定尾随他去西方。

sky.label: Acted: Connie
sky.description: MCO Lee, concerned by the call of the West, decided not to go there in person - instead resolving that the Bureau should do what it could to keep the coasts safe.
sky.description_cn: 为来自西方的呼唤而挂虑，副警监李决定不亲自前往那里调查——而是决定防剿局应该尽其所能地保护沿海地区的安全。

sky.label: Acted: Ehsan
sky.description: Ehsan set out to help patients who had heard the call of the clouds -  by suppressing their mania to travel West - though not without some qualms.
sky.description_cn: 埃桑开始帮助那些听到云层召唤的病人——抑制他们向西进发的狂热——尽管他尚有疑虑。

scale.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
scale.description: Fraser Strathcoyne was eager to travel West and embrace his latent second nature.
scale.description_cn: 弗雷泽·斯特拉思科因渴望去西方旅行，以此拥抱他潜在的第二天性。

sky.label: Acted: Morgen
sky.description: Mlle Matutine, armed with knowledge, travelled West to see the business for herself; and warned that something might also come to the clouds above Brancrug.
sky.description_cn: 平旦女士，备好了知识，打算亲自动身去西方了解情况；并警告说，某种存在也可能会来到布兰库格上空的云层中。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Unfettered Eye
incidents.description: Messana: a prosperous little desert village that has become, in recent years, a place of pilgrimage. There have been peculiar manifestations there of late - villagers gifted with sight, or struck blind. The Church has despatched its representatives to investigate. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=lantern> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 墨萨拿：一个繁荣的沙漠小村庄，近年来已经成为朝圣之地。最近那里出现了一些奇异的现象——有的村民重见光明，有的却双目失明。教会已派出代表前去调查。[对 <sprite name=lantern> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

lantern.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
lantern.description: Lieutenant Moore came to believe that the miracles in Messana might mean the Second Dawn was near. 'When the world changes,' he observed, 'it will change all at once.'
lantern.description_cn: 摩尔中尉开始相信墨萨拿出现的那些奇迹可能意味着第二拂晓将近。“当世界发生变革时，”他评论说，“将会翻天覆地。”

lantern.label: Acted: Corso
lantern.description: Corso determined that the manuscript the Church had given him to authenticate - with its details of the prophecy of the Unfettered Eye - was a forgery.
lantern.description_cn: 科尔索认定，教会委托他鉴别的——那份详述无拘之眼预言的手稿——是件赝品。

lantern.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
lantern.description: DI Moore remained uncertain about events in Messana, but promised to mention to the Bureau that I'd been of assistance.
lantern.description_cn: 启明警探摩尔对在墨萨拿发生的事情似乎仍不太确定。但他答应向防剿局提及我对他的帮助。

lantern.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
lantern.description: Fraser Strathcoyne decided, with some regret, that the events in Messana had nothing to do with his own recurring dreams of eyes...
lantern.description_cn: 带着些许遗憾，弗雷泽·斯特拉思科认定，在墨萨拿发生的那些事与反反复复纠缠着他的眼之梦并无干系……

lantern.label: Acted: Serena
lantern.description: After her visit to Brancrug, Dr Blackwood strongly suspected that the cause of the Messana business was not a Name of the Watchman... but a Name of the Chandler.
lantern.description_cn: 拜访布兰库格后，布莱克伍德博士强烈怀疑墨萨拿异状的罪魁祸首根本不是守夜人的具名者……而是制烛人的具名者。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Other Horizon
incidents.description: Sailors have a term for the compass-whirl phenomenon which occurs before sightings of the city Ys. They say a compass has caught 'the giddy horizons'. There is something of a giddy epidemic in the North Sea this year. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=rose> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 水手们有一个术语，用来形容伊苏城跃入眼帘前罗盘旋转的现象。他们说罗盘捕捉到了“眩晕的地平线”。在北海，这种“眩晕”今年出现得尤其频繁。[对 <sprite name=rose> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

rose.label: Acted: al-Adim
rose.description: The Aleppine suspected that Hendrik Dewulf had been no ordinary mercenary captain... and that a connection between Brancrug and Ys meant he might begin a journey to Ys here, on the Isle.
rose.description_cn: 阿勒颇人怀疑亨德里克·德沃尔夫并不只是个寻常的佣兵队长……而布兰库格与伊苏之间的神秘联系意味着，他可能会从这座岛屿踏上前往伊苏的旅程。

rose.label: Acted: Chaima
rose.description: Lalla Chaima set out to hunt the emissaries of Ys on the Bureau's commmission - though even with what she had learnt at Brancrug, she did not expect to find them.
rose.description_cn: 拉拉·柴玛受防剿局委托，来追捕伊苏的使者——虽然她此行在布兰库格学到了点东西，但还是没指望自己能找到那使者。

rose.label: Acted: Dagmar
rose.description: 'Daymare' definitely decided not to seek Ys. Definitely. Under no circumstances.
rose.description_cn: “日魇”决定不去寻找伊苏。绝对不。无论怎样都不。

incidents.name: The Affair of 'Apollo and Marsyas'
incidents.description: An upcoming production of an opera with a very ancient pedigree indeed. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=grail> or <sprite name=sky> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 一部溯源十分古老的歌剧即将上演。[对<sprite name=grail>或<sprite name=sky>的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

sky.label: Acted: Agdistis
sky.description: Mr Agdistis helped arrange the score for 'Apollo and Marsyas.'
sky.description_cn: 阿格狄斯提斯先生协助编排了《阿波罗与马西亚斯》的配乐。

sky.label: Acted: Azita
sky.description: Azita wanted to ensure that the production got every detail right - to make it the best possible bait for her 'dearest enemy' Mehrad.
sky.description_cn: 阿齐塔想要确保歌剧的所有细节都毫无纰漏——以保证它能够成为吸引她“最亲爱的敌人”迈哈德前来的最佳诱饵。

sky.label: Acted: Connie
sky.description: MCO Lee was reassured that the opera might present a lesser oneiric hazard than she had feared... but resolved still to talk to 'our cousins of the Duties' in Paris.
sky.description_cn: 副警监李认为歌剧带来的梦境危险没有她担心的那么严重，并为此舒了口气……但她还是决定和“巴黎相关机构的同僚”谈谈。

grail.label: Acted: Coquille
grail.description: Princess Coquille was confident she would be the best-dressed woman in the audience.
grail.description_cn: 贵胄科基尔确信自己将会是观众席上打扮得最漂亮的女人。

grail.label: Acted: Corso
grail.description: Corso improved his knowledge of 'stains'... hopefully, enough to identify the 'savour-arts' book he hoped to acquire in Paris.
grail.description_cn: 科尔索增进了他对所谓“污渍”的认识……并希望这足以让他在巴黎辨认出那本他想要搞到手的关于“滋味技艺”的书。

sky.label: Acted: Ehsan
sky.description: What Ehsan learnt at Hush House convinced him that the production would not trouble the lower skies - especially, perhaps, with his intercession.
sky.description_cn: 在噤声居屋学到的东西让埃桑相信，那件作品不会打扰到下层天域——尤其，也许，在他的调停之下。

grail.label: Acted: Hokobald
grail.description: After visiting Hush House, Magister Hokobald believed he had determined the most suitable gifts for the performers. He almost thanked me for it.
grail.description_cn: 在拜访噤声居屋后，霍科博尔德大师相信他已经找到了最适合赠送给表演者的礼物。他差点就为此感谢我了。

grail.label: Acted: Morgen
grail.description: Mlle Matutine was confident she would be the best-dressed woman in the audience.
grail.description_cn: 平旦女士确信自己将会是观众席上打扮得最漂亮的女人。

sky.label: Acted: Morgen
sky.description: Mlle Matutine was confident she would be the best-dressed woman in the audience... even though she had decided on a departure from her usual style.
sky.description_cn: 平旦女士确信自己将会是观众席上打扮得最漂亮的女人……尽管她已经决定背离自己一向的风格。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Invisible Opera
incidents.description: No-one has ever successfully staged an entire performance of 'Wings Within Wings'. That's probably why they call it the Invisible Opera. But now someone is trying again. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=grail> or <sprite name=moth> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 从未有人成功将整场《翼中之翼》搬上舞台。这也许就是他们称其为“无形歌剧”的原因。但现在又有人在尝试了。[对 <sprite name=grail> 或 <sprite name=moth> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

moth.label: Acted: Peel
moth.description: Dr Peel hoped for 'a chat' with Ferezeref the Magpie, Name of the Moth, who he held responsible for the opera's disasters.
moth.description_cn: 褪皮博士希望能与“喜鹊”夫里泽里夫——飞蛾的具名者——“谈谈”，他认为正是后者制造了歌剧现场的灾难。

grail.label: Acted: Coquille
grail.description: Princess Coquille hoped to find her family at the opera - that is, her newest family.
grail.description_cn: 贵胄科基尔希望在歌剧的台下找到自己的家人——准确来说，是她“最新的”家人。

grail.label: Acted: Corso
grail.description: Corso found a bribe that he thought might persuade someone to 'sit at the back' of the performance, and help him authenticate a book that might be a copy of the libretto.
grail.description_cn: 科尔索找到了一份足够的贿赂，足以说服某个人替自己“坐在剧场的后排”，并帮他鉴定一本可能是剧本副本的作品。

grail.label: Acted: Hokobald
grail.description: After visiting Hush House, Magister Hokobald felt prepared to take 'full advantage' of the upcoming operatic disaster. Though he didn't seem especially grateful.
grail.description_cn: 在拜访噤声居屋后，霍科博尔德大师认为自己已经准备好“充分利用”在歌剧上演时将出现的灾难。尽管他似乎并不特别感激。

grail.label: Acted: Morgen
grail.description: Mlle Matutine went to Venice ready for a 'catastrophe' at the opera's opening. She mused that 'Earth is thicker than blood' - hinting, perhaps, at some involvement with the line of Antaios?'
grail.description_cn: 平旦女士去了威尼斯，并准备好迎接歌剧开幕时的“灾难”。她同样提到“大地浓于血”——这可能与安泰俄斯的血脉有关？

moth.label: Acted: Olympe
moth.description: Mme Bechet hoped to help a friend complete, or at least survive, the performance. At Hush House, she found something that she hoped might help.
moth.description_cn: 贝谢女士希望她能帮助一位朋友完成歌剧表演……或者至少从中幸存下来。在噤声居屋，她发现了一些希望能有所帮助的东西。

incidents.name: The Affair of the God in the Wood
incidents.description: The 'Lyterion', a faddish health camp in the Black Forest, has attracted attention after many of its clients seem to have developed sudden, sometimes upsetting, artistic abilities. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=heart> or <sprite name=nectar> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 位于黑森林的“莱特里昂”是一个时兴的养生露营地，因它的许多客户都表现出突如其来的，有时令人不安的艺术才能而引发了人们的广泛关注。[对 <sprite name=heart> 或 <sprite name=nectar> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

heart.label: Acted: Agdistis
heart.description: Mr Agdistis resolved to experiment with honey.
heart.description_cn: 阿格狄斯提斯先生决定尝试蜂蜜。

heart.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
heart.description: DI Moore decided that there was nothing at the Lyterion that merited Bureau investigation.
heart.description_cn: 启明警探摩尔认定莱特里昂没有什么值得防剿局调查的东西。

heart.label: Acted: Ehsan
heart.description: Ehsan noted a resemblance between the operations of the Lyterion, and the work of Thirza Blake, seventh Librarian of the House.
heart.description_cn: 埃桑注意到，在莱特里昂被创作出的作品，与居屋第七任图书管理员蒂尔扎·布雷克的作品有相似之处。

heart.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
heart.description: Father Schaller resolved to speak to some of the patrons of the Lyterion, hoping to understand a change 'in the tempo of the world's pulse.'
heart.description_cn: 沙勒神父决定和莱特里昂的几位赞助人谈谈，希望能对“世界脉搏的节奏”中的变化有所了解。

nectar.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
nectar.description: Father Schaller resolved to visit the Black Forest, sensing an opportunity for something old to be reborn - 'in the right way or the wrong one.'
nectar.description_cn: 沙勒神父决心去黑森林看看，他感觉这是个让某些旧事物重生的机会——“以正确或错误的方式”。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Unfinished Lark
incidents.description: For three years, the sculptor-adept Zuthimalim Zidane has laboured at his masterpiece - an abstract sculpture that 'speaks with the voice of the desert lark'. And now, puzzlingly and suddenly, he is dead. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=forge> or <sprite name=sky> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 三年来，雕刻家兼学徒的祖斯马林·齐达内一直致力于他的杰作——一件“用沙漠百灵鸟的嗓音讲话”的抽象雕塑。可现在，他去世了，事发突然且令人费解。[对 <sprite name=forge> 或 <sprite name=sky> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

sky.label: Acted: Agdistis
sky.description: Mr Agdistis wrote a memorial piece for Zuthimalim Zidane.
sky.description_cn: 阿格狄斯提斯先生写下了祖斯马林·齐达内的悼歌。

sky.label: Acted: Azita
sky.description: Azita believed Zidane had been murdered - and, after investigating possible motives, speculated that he had 'been eavesdropping at the keyholes of heaven.'
sky.description_cn: 阿齐塔相信齐达内是被谋杀的——在调查了凶手可能的动机后，她推测他曾“通过天界的钥匙孔偷听”。

sky.label: Acted: Connie
sky.description: MCO Lee set off to track down the entity that she believed had murdered Zidane - a renegade spirit of the lower skies.
sky.description_cn: 副警监李着手于追踪某个实体——她认为是它谋杀了齐达内，“一个来自下层天域的叛逃灵体”。

sky.label: Acted: Ehsan
sky.description: Ehsan had hoped that Zidane's memorial composition might be played on the Unfinished Lark itself - but after researching the matter at Hush House, he came to believe that might be too dangerous.
sky.description_cn: 埃桑希望自己托人为齐达内所作的悼歌能用“未完工的百灵鸟”播放——但在噤声居屋研究了此事之后，他认为这可能太冒险了。

forge.label: Acted: Hokobald
forge.description: Magister Hokobald planned to 'salvage' Zidane's work when it was (as he hoped) sold for scrap.
forge.description_cn: 霍科博尔德大师计划在齐达内的遗作（如他所愿）差点被当废品卖掉时出面“补救”它。

sky.label: Acted: Morgen
sky.description: Mlle Matutine hoped to complete Zidane's work; and at Hush House, or so she believed, she found what she needed to do so.
sky.description_cn: 平旦女士希望完成齐达内的遗作；而在噤声居屋，她找到，或者认定自己找到了为此要准备的一切。

forge.label: Acted: Olympe
forge.description: At Hush House, Mme Bechet learnt enough (she hoped) to persuade a wealthy patroness to purchase the Unfinished Lark, and save it from being sold for scrap by the authorities.
forge.description_cn: 贝谢女士在噤声居屋了解到了足够多（她希望如此）的信息，以说服一位富有的女赞助人买下未完工的百灵鸟，使它免于被官方当做废品贱卖。

forge.label: Acted: Serena
forge.description: Whatever Dr Blackwood found at Hush House, it convinced her that Zidane had used 'Ys-metal' in his work.
forge.description_cn: 不论布莱克伍德博士在噤声居屋发现了什么，这都使她确信齐达内在他的作品中使用了“伊苏金属”。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Royal Endeavour
incidents.description: The New King has sanctioned the use of the Crown's wealth to fund a visionary new industrial project - one that will transform our economy, and furnish the kingdom with a sense of patriotic mission. Parliament, dazzled, has already passed the Royal Endeavour Act, mandating the construction of the necessary facilities, although the details remain in some respects vague. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=forge> or <sprite name=lantern> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 新王已批准动用王室资产为一项富有远见的新工业项目拨款——它将彻底改变我们的经济，并且使王国上下洋溢爱国之情。议会在目眩神迷中通过了《王室之举法案》，授权建设必要的设施，尽管它的某些细节仍含混不明。[对 <sprite name=forge> 或 <sprite name=lantern> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

lantern.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
lantern.description: Lieutenant Moore was concerned about his great-nephew's part in the Royal Endeavour - but a visit to Hush House soothed those concerns.
lantern.description_cn: 摩尔中尉一度为自己的侄孙在“王室之举”中扮演的角色而担心——但在拜访过噤声居屋后，他的疑虑有所缓解。

lantern.label: Acted: Corso
lantern.description: Corso went glumly back to his 'foreign friends', to warn them that their concerns about the nature of the Royal Endeavour might be justified.
lantern.description_cn: 科尔索有些沮丧地回到他的“外国朋友”那里，警告他们对“王室之举”本质的担忧或许是合理的。

lantern.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
lantern.description: DI Moore came to investigate likely motives for sabotage of the Royal Endeavour by maverick clergy... and left with a 'much better idea about who might need arresting.'
lantern.description_cn: 启明警探摩尔专程调查了个别特立独行的圣职者们破坏“王室之举”的可能动机……离开时，他对“应该逮捕谁这件事心里有数多了”。

lantern.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
lantern.description: The procurement committee of the Royal Endeavour was, it seems, one of Fraser Strathcoyne's many clients. And so he came to Hush House to research their requests. 'Battleships; aerostats; locomotives. What do all these things have in common, Librarian? I'll tell you: names.'
lantern.description_cn: 王室之举的采购委员会似乎是弗雷泽·斯特拉思科因的众多客户之一。所以他来噤声居屋研究他们的订单中隐藏的秘密：“战舰；浮空器；火车头。这些东西的共同点是什么，图书管理员？告诉你吧：它们皆具其名。”

forge.label: Acted: Hokobald
forge.description: Magister Hokobald came to Hush House to learn what he could of the Royal Endeavour's aims and nature. He seemed satisfied with the Endeavour; he seemed almost satisfied with Hush House.
forge.description_cn: 霍科博尔德大师想要尽可能地了解“王室之举”的目的与性质。他似乎对那个项目十分满意；他似乎对噤声居屋也几乎满意。

forge.label: Acted: Olympe
forge.description: After her visit to Hush House, Mme Bechet came to believe that the Royal Endeavour was associated with the Second Dawn... which, she opined, she would prefer to a war.
forge.description_cn: 在拜访了噤声居屋后，贝谢女士开始相信“王室之举”与第二拂晓存在某种关联……她认为，比起战争，她更喜欢“第二拂晓”。

forge.label: Acted: Serena
forge.description: Dr Blackwood was concerned that the Royal Endeavour might be, in some sense, the rebirth of the 'alchemies of the House of Lancaster'... perhaps even a return, in some sense, to the days of the Sovereigns of the Leashed Flame.
forge.description_cn: 布莱克伍德博士担心“王室之举”或许在某些方面上是“兰开斯特家族的炼金术”的再现……在某种意义上，甚至可能是受控之火君王时代的回归。

lantern.label: Acted: Serena
lantern.description: Dr Blackwood was convinced that the Royal Endeavour was fundamentally a matter of light... but that it might be connected to the paradoxical, menacing Hour known as the Chandler.
lantern.description_cn: 布莱克伍德博士确信“王室之举”从根本上讲与光有关……但它也可能与那位矛盾而危险的、被称为制烛人的司辰有关。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Threshold Revolution
incidents.description: In the drier reaches of the Bounds, the Légion du Seuil keeps a brutal peace. Perhaps even a necessary one. But the Légion recruits from among the Bounds-beasts. How trustworthy is it, really?  [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=edge> or <sprite name=grail> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 在更为干燥的边境地区，Légion du Seuil（门关军团）维持着残酷、甚至可能还是必要的和平。可军团的成员却是从边境野兽中募选的。它真的值得信任吗？[对 <sprite name=edge> 或 <sprite name=grail> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

edge.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
edge.description: Lieutenant Moore sympathised with the rebels in the Bounds... but his concerns about their honesty weighed heavily on him.
edge.description_cn: 摩尔中尉对边境的叛军感到同情……但他们是否坦诚让他倍感压力。

edge.label: Acted: Azita
edge.description: Azita found an 'acceptable substitute' for the taenite knives that the Légion du Seuil needed.
edge.description_cn: 阿齐塔为门关军团急需的镍纹石小刀找到了一种“可接受的替代品”。

edge.label: Acted: Chaima
edge.description: Lalla Chaima, armed with what she had learnt at Hush House, set off to offer battle to the enemies of the Légion du Seuil.
edge.description_cn: 拉拉·柴玛，以她在噤声居屋学到的东西武装自己，前去与门关军团的敌人战斗。

grail.label: Acted: Coquille
grail.description: Princess Coquille found a very special gift for her very special officer friend in the Legion.
grail.description_cn: 贵胄科基尔为她在门关军团的一位十分特别的军官朋友找到了一份十分特别的礼物。

grail.label: Acted: Corso
grail.description: Corso sought an unknown Hattington work in the Bounds - and hoped that he'd identified a suitable bribe for the 'lady' who held it.
grail.description_cn: 科尔索去边境寻找一本哈廷顿未公开的著作——并希望自己能找到适合向那位持有它的“女士”行贿的东西。

grail.label: Acted: Hokobald
grail.description: Hokobald found what he needed on 'genealogy, or cuisine, or related subjects', though he was not forthcoming about the connection these matters might have with to the revolution in the Bounds.
grail.description_cn: 霍科博尔德找到了他所需要的“系谱学，或烹饪，或相关主题”，尽管他不愿意透露它们与边境正在发生的革命有何联系。

grail.label: Acted: Morgen
grail.description: Mlle Matutine was certain she'd find the meal she sought, among the battles in the Bounds.
grail.description_cn: 平旦女士确信她在边境的战争中能找到称心合意的大餐。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Rising While
incidents.description: Across the inner sea, across the desert sands, someone styling herself the Oracle of the Rising While has set up a tent-town where she preaches 'the truth of nearly now' to her followers. This would be of no obvious interest to the students of the invisible arts... except that although she has pitched her tents in the shadow of the Temple of Seven Coils, nothing appears to have eaten anyone. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=moon> or <sprite name=scale> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 穿过内海，越过大漠荒沙，有个自称“冉升之时神谕者”的人搭建了一个帐篷村，向她的追随者宣扬“近乎此刻的真理”。对于无形之术的修习者而言，这显然不会提起他们的兴趣……除了虽然她在七蟠寺的阴影下搭了帐篷，却并没有什么吃人的东西冒出来这件事之外。[对 <sprite name=moon> 或 <sprite name=scale> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

scale.label: Acted: al-Adim
scale.description: The Aleppine, suspecting some connection between the Seven-Coils and the Sun, fearing what he might find if he visited the Oracle of the Rising While... chose not to go.
scale.description_cn: 阿勒颇人推测七蟠和太阳之间存在某种联系，却又担心自己在冉升之时的神谕者那里会得知令他害怕的真相……最终决定不前往那里。

moon.label: Acted: Peel
moon.description: Dr Peel propounded an obscure theory about a sacrament of blood which might be shared with the Sun at dusk and at dawn; and exited stage left.
moon.description_cn: 褪皮博士提出了某种晦涩的理论，关于可能在黄昏或拂晓时分与太阳的血之圣餐；然后自顾自地离开了。

moon.label: Acted: Connie
moon.description: MCO Lee, concerned at her superiors' request for her to research an oracle given by the Rising While, began to suspect that a 'Great Counterfeit' played some part in the affairs of the realm.
moon.description_cn: 副警监李的上级要求她研究一则来自“冉升之时”的神谕，这最终让她充满疑虑——她担心“大赝身”在王国的内政中扮演了某种角色。

scale.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
scale.description: Fraser Strathcoyne came to Brancrug to interpret an oracle given by the Rising While; and became certain that he was descended from the Scimafectra-kind of the Carapace Cross; the 'Glory-Winged' ones.
scale.description_cn: 弗雷泽·斯特拉思科因来到布兰库格，希望能理解他在“冉升之时”得到的神谕；并逐渐确信自己是辉诞族——“辉翼”的后裔。

moon.label: Acted: Yvette
moon.description: Dr Southey, troubled by dreams, feared death by water.
moon.description_cn: 骚赛博士，为梦境所扰，惧怕溺亡。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Sandalwood Saint
incidents.description: An odd little image in a church in Strasbourg has become a locus for wild claims of healing and haunting. When it comes to the attention of the Church hierarchy, they'll rule it miraculous or heretical… unless someone takes a hand before then. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=nectar> or <sprite name=scale> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 斯特拉斯堡一座教堂内的一尊奇怪的小雕像成了狂热者们宣称的治病和闹鬼之处。一旦引起教会高层的注意，他们就会将其裁定为奇迹或异端……除非在此之前有人介入此事。[对 <sprite name=nectar> 或 <sprite name=scale> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

scale.label: Acted: al-Adim
scale.description: The Aleppine declared his intention to commit the sandalwood image to the flames, for fear that the deacon might 'begin to buzz'.
scale.description_cn: 阿勒颇人声称那座檀木雕像应该被扔进火里，因为他担心那将“开始嗡鸣作响”。

scale.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
scale.description: Fraser Strathcoyne declared his intention to drown the sandalwood image from the Strasbourg church, hoping it would 'develop further'.
scale.description_cn: 弗雷泽·斯特拉思科因声称他打算将斯特拉斯堡教堂的檀木雕像沉入水中，希望它会“继续成长”。

nectar.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
nectar.description: Father Schaller declared his intention to bury the image called the 'Sandalwood Saint', hoping it might grow... but only slowly, and in the right season.
nectar.description_cn: 沙勒神父声称他打算埋掉那座被称为“檀木圣徒”的雕像，希望它能生长……但只能慢慢生长，而且是在正确的时节。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Friar's Tapestry
incidents.description: A tapestry has been stolen from the Haustorium that depicts details of a very old rite indeed - one that may only be performed at Gladwyn Lake 'when the moon is ripe'. Exactly what it might renew is unclear, but almost inevitably someone will try it anyway. [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=moon> or <sprite name=nectar> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 一块织幔在吸器失窃，织幔上描绘了一个非常古老的仪式的细节内容，这个仪式只有在格拉德温湖的“满月之时”才能举行。仪式究竟会焕新什么尚未可知，但几乎无法避免会有好事之徒去尝试。[对 <sprite name=moon> 或 <sprite name=nectar> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

moon.label: Acted: Peel
moon.description: Dr Peel went off to watch the rite at Gladwyn Lake, intoning sinister names: Robigo the Generous with Hosts; the Crowned Growth; Ortucchio...
moon.description_cn: 褪皮博士已动身去参观将在格拉德温湖进行的仪式，还提到了几个不详的名字：罗比戈，慷慨待主者；戴冠之孳；奥尔图基奥……

moon.label: Acted: Connie
moon.description: MCO Lee researched 'countermeasures' at Hush House, hoping to limit any damage caused by the rite
moon.description_cn: 副警监李在噤声居屋研究了某种“对策”，希望能限制住仪式造成的可能危害。

nectar.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
nectar.description: Father Schaller came to Hush House to investigate the possibility that the rite was a Haustorium trap... and mentioned, perhaps only in passing, that he had managed Teresa Galmier's 'reincorporation'.
nectar.description_cn: 沙勒神父前来噤声居屋调查该仪式是否可能是吸器设下的陷阱……并且大概只是顺口一提，他设法完成了特蕾莎·加尔米耶的“受肉”。

moon.label: Acted: Yvette
moon.description: Dr Southey's patient believed he would be reborn at Gladwyn Lake beneath the moon - and she decided, after visiting Hush House, that it would be futile to try to prevent him from going.'Always the tide...'
moon.description_cn: 骚赛博士的一位患者相信他将在月光下的格拉德温湖得到重生——在拜访了噤声居屋后，她认为阻止他的尝试只会是徒劳。“浪潮依旧……”

incidents.name: The Affair of the Absent Friend
incidents.description: The Ligeian Medusa is long dead, as is well attested. It's nevertheless well-attested also that she walks the streets of Budapest by moonlight. That's just one of those things. But now, for the first time, she's being glimpsed in daylight too. What could that portend? [Visitors with an interest in or Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 丽姬亚美杜莎早已死去，这一点已得到充分证实。不过，她在月光下漫步在布达佩斯街头也已得到充分证实。这些都是不可避免的事。可现在，有人前所未有地在白天也目击到了她。那 可能预示着什么呢？[对 或 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

rose.label: Acted: al-Adim
rose.description: The Aleppine could not determine the best answer for Medusa's Riddle, 'What Is Not Seen?' He suggested wryly that the answer should be he himself.
rose.description_cn: 阿勒颇人还是不确定美杜莎的谜语“何物不得见？”该如何回答。他自嘲地提议道，最好的答案应该是他自己。

edge.label: Acted: Arthur Moore
edge.description: Lieutentant Moore, preparing himself to face Medusa, came to fear that the answer to her riddle - 'What Is Not Seen?' - was not 'Light', as he had long believed.
edge.description_cn: 摩尔中尉正准备接触美杜莎，但他开始担心她的谜语“何物不得见？”的答案，并不是自己原先一直以为的“光”。

edge.label: Acted: Azita
edge.description: Azita set off to play her 'silly games' with her enemy-twin Mehrad in Budapest... competing to cut a scrap from the robe of Medusa herself.
edge.description_cn: 阿齐塔出发去往布达佩斯，为了和她的孪敌迈哈德玩他们那“愚蠢的游戏”……比赛谁能先从美杜莎的袍子上剪下一小块布。

edge.label: Acted: Chaima
edge.description: Lalla Chaima left for Budapest to follow and watch Medusa - having first established at Hush House that she should, above all, not get too close.
edge.description_cn: 拉拉·柴玛已前往布达佩斯跟踪美杜莎——她在噤声居屋学到的第一点就是，绝对不能靠得太近。

rose.label: Acted: Chaima
rose.description: Lalla Chaima left for Budapest to follow and watch Medusa - having first established at Hush House that she should, above all, show respect.
rose.description_cn: 拉拉·柴玛已经动身去了布达佩斯，以跟踪美杜莎——她在噤声居屋学到的第一点就是，一定要表现出足够的尊重。

rose.label: Acted: Dagmar
rose.description: 'Daymare' went off to Budapest to look into the Medusa business, insisting that she wasn't doing so as any kind of favour for any kind of friend, especially not one whose name might begin with K.
rose.description_cn: “日魇”已经动身去布达佩斯调查与美杜莎有关的事。她坚称这么做不是为了帮助自己的朋友，尤其不是为了某个名字以K开头的。

incidents.name: The Affair of the Open Reverend
incidents.description: In a highly specialised clinic in an obscure corner of the capital, specialists study the ecstatic agonies of the case known only as'the Open Reverend', who once was the vicar of the parish of St Agnes Forestreet. The blessings of St Agnes of the Fires and St Agnes of the Shears are ungentle. But St Agnes of the Threshold may be her cruellest aspect...  [Visitors with an interest in <sprite name=heart> or <sprite name=winter> Mysteries will want to talk about this.]
incidents.description_cn: 在首都一个不起眼的角落，一个高度专业化的诊所里，专家们研究了一个名为“开启牧师”的病人狂喜的痛苦，他曾是圣亚割妮前街教区的牧师。火焰之圣亚割妮和剪刀之圣亚割妮的祝福并不温柔，但门关之圣亚割妮可能是她最残忍的一个面相……[对 <sprite name=heart> 或 <sprite name=winter> 的秘密感兴趣的访客将愿意对此事发表看法。]

heart.label: Acted: Agdistis
heart.description: Mr Agdistis learnt that the 'Open Reverend' was not connected with the power Agdistis serves.
heart.description_cn: 阿格狄斯提斯先生明白了“开启牧师”与他侍奉的神灵并无关联。

heart.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
heart.description: DI Moore concluded that the 'Open Reverend' would have to be permanently closed.
heart.description_cn: 启明警探摩尔得出结论，“开启牧师”必须被永久关闭。

heart.label: Acted: Ehsan
heart.description: Ehsan became convinced that the Open Reverend had attracted the attention of the Mother of Ants - but determined, nevertheless, that he would try to heal the poor fellow.
heart.description_cn: 埃桑相信“开启牧师”已经引起了蚁母的注意——但也下定决心，不论如何也要治愈那个可怜的家伙。

heart.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
heart.description: Father Schaller, who had once been a friend of the Open Reverend, felt that he had learnt enough to give him 'what he might want.'
heart.description_cn: 沙勒神父，那位“开启牧师”曾经的朋友，认为他在这里学到了足够的知识，可以给他提供“他可能想要的东西”。

winter.label: Acted: Yvette
winter.description: Dr Southey knew that she could never hope to heal the Open Reverend's flesh - but he had been one of her patients, and she thought perhaps he might be again.
winter.description_cn: 骚赛博士不奢望能治愈“开启牧师”的肉体——但他曾是她的病人，而她认为他可能再次成为她的病人。

winter.label: Acted: Zachary
winter.description: Zachary Wakefield regretted that the Open Reverend would only open outwards... but expressed relief that 'his suffering need not be drawn out any longer.'
winter.description_cn: 扎迦利·韦克菲尔德为“开启牧师”只向外敞开感到惋惜……但也对“他的痛苦不必再拖延下去”而感到宽慰。

incidents.name: A Matter of the Sanctuary Draught
incidents.description: In Numa, visitors will be concerned with matters of comfort, delight, and loss. [As long as this card remains, Numatic visitors will have an interest in <sprite name=grail> Mysteries. Their needs will usually be more exacting than visitors who come during more traditional seasons.]
incidents.description_cn: 在闰时，访客们会关心慰藉，愉悦与失落之事。[只要该卡存在，闰时的访客们将对<sprite name=grail>的秘密感兴趣。他们的需求与常规时节的访客相比更为苛刻。]

grail.label: Acted: Bancroft
grail.description: '...count on a poet to…charlatan. Our daughter...'
grail.description_cn: “……指望一个诗人去……骗子。我们的女儿……”

grail.label: Acted: Rowena
grail.description: 'If I were here, this would comfort me; if I were here, I would reward you better than now I do.'
grail.description_cn: “如果我在这里，这会使我快慰；如果我在这里，我会给你比现在更高的酬劳。”

incidents.name: A Matter of the Feasting Few
incidents.description: In Numa, visitors will be concerned with questions of appetite, of blood, and of their attendant dangers. [Numatic visitors will have an interest in <sprite name=grail> Mysteries. Their needs will usually be more exacting than visitors who come during more traditional seasons.]
incidents.description_cn: 在闰时，访客们会关心食欲，鲜血以及随之而来的危险。[只要该卡存在，闰时的访客们将对<sprite name=grail>的秘密感兴趣。他们的需求与常规时节的访客相比更为苛刻。]

grail.label: Acted: Bancroft
grail.description: '...once we've begun, there's no end to it. Without the Grail, no Intercalate; without the Intercalate, how would the Hours keep from...'
grail.description_cn: “……一旦我们开始，就再无止尽。没有圣杯，就没有置闰；没有置闰，司辰们要如何阻止……”

grail.label: Acted: Rowena
grail.description: 'If I were here… perhaps it is the Twins that would have brought me. It is the Twins who unite what must not be apart. And so I share their patronage with my sisters-in-blood. As Bancroft used to say, there are other appetites than love.'
grail.description_cn: “如果我在这里……恐怕应是孪生子带我到了这里。是孪生子将不应分离之物结合。因此我与我的沥血姐妹们共享她们的庇护。就如班克罗夫特曾说的那样，这世上还有更甚于爱情的欲望。”

incidents.name: A Matter of Counterfeit Memory
incidents.description: In Numa, visitors will be concerned with the tricks and strategems that might have been used in secret by the Hours. [As long as this card remains, Numatic visitors will have an interest in <sprite name=moon> Mysteries. Their needs will usually be more exacting than visitors who come during more traditional seasons.]
incidents.description_cn: 在闰时，访客们会关心众司辰暗地里曾使用过的诡计与谋略。[只要该卡存在，闰时的访客们将对<sprite name=moon>的秘密感兴趣。他们的需求与常规时节的访客相比更为苛刻。]

moon.label: Acted: Aunt M
moon.description: 'Yes, dear. If we don't know what we've lost when we've buried it, we won't know it until they've buried us. I would think about what I'm ready to bury, if I were you. Sleep softly.'
moon.description_cn: “没错，亲爱的。咱今葬它不知所失，待它葬咱才知失孰。如果我是你，我会考虑我该埋葬什么。祝你好梦。”

moon.label: Acted: Coseley
moon.description: '...Ys, the exception, but no exception to Eternity can last forever. That's rather the point! Only when I accepted that...'
moon.description_cn: “……伊苏，例外之城。可在永恒面前，一切例外都只是过眼云烟。这才是重点！唯有当我接受……”

incidents.name: A Matter of the Midnight Twin
incidents.description: In Numa, visitors will be concerned with matters of shadow and substance, revelation and obscurity. [As long as this card remains, Numatic visitors will have an interest in <sprite name=moon> Mysteries. Their needs will usually be more exacting than visitors who come during more traditional seasons.]
incidents.description_cn: 在闰时，访客们会关心虚影与实质，昭然与朦晦之事。[只要该卡存在，闰时的访客们将对<sprite name=moon>的秘密感兴趣。他们的需求与常规时节的访客相比更为苛刻。]

moon.label: Acted: Aunt M
moon.description: 'Yes, dear. Without all those gods in darkness, I don't imagine we'd see much Sun anywhere below Eternity. Sleep softly.'
moon.description_cn: “没错，亲爱的。没有那些黑暗中的诸神，恐怕我们在永恒以外的地方都看不到太阳。祝你好梦。”

moon.label: Acted: Coseley
moon.description: '...my arrogance, fought to overthrow Necessity. I will not say my time was wasted - no blow struck against tyranny is wasted. But only when I saw...'
moon.description_cn: “……是我的傲慢。为了推翻必然而战。我不会说我的时间都是白费的——对暴政的打击没有白费。但唯当我看到……”

incidents.name: A Matter of the Softer Frost
incidents.description: In Numa, visitors will be concerned with how and when things end. [As long as this card remains, Numatic visitors will have an interest in <sprite name=winter> Mysteries. Their needs will usually be more exacting than visitors who come during more traditional seasons.]
incidents.description_cn: 在闰时，访客们会关心事物如何终结以及何时终结。[只要该卡存在，闰时的访客们将对<sprite name=winter>的秘密感兴趣。他们的需求与常规时节的访客相比更为苛刻。]

winter.label: Acted: Coseley
winter.description: '...endings like the pale light before a pale dawn. We can always be certain of a first time - we can never be certain when it is the last...'
winter.description_cn: “……终结就像是苍白拂晓前的苍白微光。我们总可以确定第一次——我们总不能确定最后一次……”

winter.label: Acted: Rowena
winter.description: 'When I was here - when I came here, the first time - I was so angry. That I had been cast aside after I opened the way - that was the least of it. That I had opened the way - that was the worst of it. Though, once, I thought it was the other way around.'
winter.description_cn: “当我还在这里的时候——当我第一次来到这里的时候，我相当生气。我打开道路后就被弃于一旁——这是最微不足道的。我打开了道路——这才是最糟糕的。尽管曾有一次，我觉得情况恰恰相反。”

incidents.name: A Matter of Knot and Tangle
incidents.description: In Numa, visitors will be concerned with the Hours honoured by the Sisterhood of the Knot. [As long as this card remains, Numatic visitors will have an interest in <sprite name=grail> or <sprite name=nectar> Mysteries. Their needs will usually be more exacting than visitors who come during more traditional seasons.]
incidents.description_cn: 在闰时，访客们会关心受绳结姐妹会尊崇的司辰。[只要该卡存在，闰时的访客们将对<sprite name=grail>或<sprite name=nectar>的秘密感兴趣。他们的需求与常规时节的访客相比更为苛刻。]

nectar.label: Acted: Aunt M
nectar.description: 'Yes, dear. No paper without trees; no forest without the axe; no loss without memory. Sleep softly.'
nectar.description_cn: “没错，亲爱的。没有树木就没有纸张；没有森林就没有斧头；没有记忆就没有忘却。祝你好梦。”

grail.label: Acted: Bancroft
grail.description: '...optimism? If you term it that! I do not deny the Hours. But who else than we would make these Histories, in the face of all the Glory's lights, if...'
grail.description_cn: “……乐观？如果你把这称作乐观的话！我无意否定司辰。但除了我们之外，还有谁能直面辉光之光，创造出这诸史呢？如果……”

grail.label: Acted: Rowena
grail.description: 'When I was here - the first time - the first sacrifice I made was to the Grail. Without that, there would be no Hush House at all. Oh, the covenant-stone, the tree, all that, perhaps. But remember that it all begins with birth.'
grail.description_cn: “当我还在这里的时候——第一次——我的第一场献祭是献给圣杯的。没有那场献祭，就根本不会有噤声居屋。噢，还有那盟约石，还有那紫杉树，所有的那些，也许吧。但请记住，一切都始于生诞。”

abilities.name: Chor
abilities.description: Exuberance; instinct; rhythm. [One of the nine parts of the human soul.]
abilities.description_cn: 活力；本能；旋律。[人类的九大魂质之一。]

abilities.name: Ereb
abilities.description: Pride, compassion; hatred and fear. [One of the nine parts of the human soul.]
abilities.description_cn: 傲慢，怜悯；憎恶与恐惧。[人类的九大魂质之一。]

abilities.name: Fet
abilities.description: That part of us which walks in dreams. [One of the nine parts of the human soul.]
abilities.description_cn: 我们在梦中行走的部分。[人类的九大魂质之一。]

abilities.name: Health
abilities.description: The dwelling-place of the soul. [The ninth of the nine parts of the soul; the only one that can be touched.]
abilities.description_cn: 灵魂的憩所。[灵魂的第九部分；唯一能触碰到的部分。]

abilities.name: Health [Half-Drowned]
abilities.description: Shivers wrack my soaked body. [Your health is failing. Find somewhere to warm up.]
abilities.description_cn: 我浑身湿透，也浑身发抖。[你的健康每况愈下。得找个地方暖暖身子。]

abilities.name: Health [Freezing]
abilities.description: It's not even cold any more. I could just lie down right here. I could sleep right here. [You really need to find shelter.]
abilities.description_cn: 已经冷得不能再冷了。我可以就此躺倒。我可以就此长眠。[你真的需要找个栖身之所。]

abilities.name: Mettle
abilities.description: Will; self-discipline; that part of us which makes the right choice. [One of the nine parts of the human soul.]
abilities.description_cn: 意志；自律；是我们用来做出正确选择的那一部分。[人类的九大魂质之一。]

abilities.name: Phost
abilities.description: Sight, perception, inspiration, all the Glory's gifts. [One of the nine parts of the human soul.]
abilities.description_cn: 视界、感知、灵感，皆为辉光的赠礼。[人类的九大魂质之一。]

abilities.name: Shapt
abilities.description: Eloquence and understanding. The door opens both ways. [One of the nine parts of the human soul.]
abilities.description_cn: 口才与理解。双向开启之门。[人类的九大魂质之一。]

abilities.name: Trist
abilities.description: The change and the longing. [One of the nine parts of the human soul.]
abilities.description_cn: 改变与渴求。[人类的九大魂质之一。]

abilities.name: Wist
abilities.description: Name, memory, that part which remains. Most librarians know that books have souls; most librarians hope for books with simple souls of wist and nothing else. [One of the nine parts of the human soul.]
abilities.description_cn: 名字，记忆，存留的部分。很多图书管理员都知道书籍也有灵魂；很多图书管理员都希望书只有由铭晓组成的简单灵魂，别无他物。[人类的九大魂质之一。]

abilities.name: Chor [fatigued]
abilities.description: Exuberance; instinct; rhythm.
abilities.description_cn: 活力；本能；旋律。

abilities.name: Ereb [fatigued]
abilities.description: Pride, compassion; hatred and fear.
abilities.description_cn: 傲慢，怜悯；憎恶与恐惧。

abilities.name: Fet [fatigued]
abilities.description: That part of us which dreams.
abilities.description_cn: 我们在梦中行走的部分。

abilities.name: Health [fatigued]
abilities.description: The dwelling-place of the soul.
abilities.description_cn: 灵魂的憩所。

abilities.name: Mettle [fatigued]
abilities.description: The capacity for meaningful choice.
abilities.description_cn: 是我们用来做出正确选择的那一部分。

abilities.name: Phost [fatigued]
abilities.description: Sight, perception, inspiration, all the Glory's gifts.
abilities.description_cn: 视界、感知、灵感，皆为辉光的赠礼。

abilities.name: Shapt [fatigued]
abilities.description: Eloquence and understanding. The door opens both ways.
abilities.description_cn: 口才与理解。双向开启之门。

abilities.name: Trist [fatigued]
abilities.description: The change and the longing.
abilities.description_cn: 改变与渴求。

abilities.name: Wist [fatigued]
abilities.description: Name, memory, that part which remains. (Most librarians know that books have souls; most librarians hope for books with simple souls of wist and nothing else.)
abilities.description_cn: 名字，记忆，存留的部分。（很多图书管理员都知道书籍也有灵魂；很多图书管理员都希望书只有由铭晓组成的简单灵魂，别无他物。）

abilities.name: Chor: Duendratic
abilities.description: Duendracy is a kind of distraction or of inspiration, or of possession. In the wind, in the sea, in the crackle of flames, there's a music only I can hear, and when I give it too much attention, the world grows red as a rose...
abilities.description_cn: 入魅是一种迷乱或灵感，亦或是一种着迷。在风中，在海中，在火焰的噼啪声中，有一种只有我能听到的音乐，当我太过关注它时，世界就会变为玫瑰般的靓红……

abilities.name: Ereb: Westengryred
abilities.description: Westengryre is what the early monks of St Brandan's called it; that old green-sickness, the raptness of desolation, the terror of the wastes, and it is upon me now. The Wood. The Wood. The Wood...!
abilities.description_cn: 怔悚是圣布伦丹早期修士的叫法；那古老的绿萎病、瘾荒症、慌疾，如今它已将我笼罩。林地。林地。林地……！

abilities.name: Fet: Gisting
abilities.description: In dreams I have visited the House behind the world... and some part of me is trapped there now, even when I wake.
abilities.description_cn: 在梦中，我参观了世界之后的居屋……我的一部分现在仍被困在那里，即使我已醒来。

abilities.name: Health: Sick
abilities.description: I've become unwell.
abilities.description_cn: 我身体抱恙。

abilities.name: Phost: Fascinated
abilities.description: The HIGHER I RISE the MORE I SEE
abilities.description_cn: 我升得越高，见得越多

abilities.name: Shapt: Acusis
abilities.description: The doors of my soul have opened too wide. Every sound rings like a bell - every word scratches at my eyes or skin -
abilities.description_cn: 我的灵魂之门开得太大。每个响动都如声如洪钟——每个字词都撕挠着我的双眸或是肌肤——

abilities.name: Trist: Despairing
abilities.description: Melancholy is the mist on the soul's waters. Despair is the wolf that prowls the water's edge.
abilities.description_cn: 忧郁乃灵魂水面弥漫之薄雾。绝望乃水边徘徊之狼犬。

abilities.name: Wist: Shell-Crossed
abilities.description: My thoughts are tangled and unfamiliar to me. Something of those who came before - the Carapace Cross - has always lingered in humankind. It's risen now in me.
abilities.description_cn: 我的思绪缠结纷乱而难以分辨。先于人类而来者——介壳种曾把某些东西留在了人类的内里，如今它们于我的内里升起了。

visitors.name: Mr Peter Agdistis
visitors.name_cn: 彼得·阿格狄斯提斯先生
visitors.description: Musician, mystic, impresario. Agdistis was a dancer once. One cannot see him without knowing it. The wound in his thigh keeps him from the stage; but his every movement still has the cadence of a prayer.
visitors.description_cn: 音乐家，神秘主义者，舞团经理。阿格狄斯提斯曾是位舞者。你只要看到他就会发现这点。腿根处的旧伤迫使他放弃了舞台；但他的一举一动仍带有祈祷的律动。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'You have nothing? No matter, no matter! There's always another time.'

visitors.name: Dr Ibn al-Adim
visitors.description: 'The Aleppine': Historian, doctor, and above all, traveller. The good doctor has been associated with all but one of the libraries of the Watchman's Tree. He was even Secretary Nunciant of Hush House for a little while, but he has never been on good terms with the Suppression Bureau.
visitors.description_cn: “阿勒颇人”：历史学家、博士，但首先是旅行者。这位好博士与守夜人之树的所有图书馆都有联系——除了某座。他甚至在噤声居屋做过一段时间的通讯理事，不过他和防剿局的关系一向不好。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'Mm. Well, no doubt we shall see each other again.'

visitors.name: Lt Arthur Thomas Moore (Ret.)
visitors.name_cn: 亚瑟·托马斯·摩尔中尉（已退役）
visitors.description: Hero, pilgrim, traitor. He'll always be a soldier, but never again can he be only a soldier.
visitors.description_cn: 英雄，朝圣者，叛徒。他将永远是位士兵，但他已再无可能只是一位士兵。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'Then I'll have to find my enlightenment somewhere else. Good day to you.'

visitors.name: Dr Arun Peel
visitors.description: Exile, riddlemonger, Thunderskin devotee. ('I'd rather say confidant.') Impeccably dressed, but always in dark clothing so the stains don't show. Dark the dressings too at his ankles and his wrists. ('I won't take a seat. It's kind of you to offer. It would be unkind of me to accept.')
visitors.description_cn: 流亡者，谜语散播者，轰雷之皮的虔诚信徒。（“我更愿意说是知己。”）穿着品味无可挑剔，但总穿深色掩饰污渍。他裹于手腕和脚踝的敷料也染得深黑。（“我就不坐了。感谢你的好意，但我接受就不太好了。”）

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'Never mind. The traveller is always returning, no? So if I come back later, am I returning then? Or am I returning now?'

visitors.name: Aunt Mopsy
visitors.description: Collector of proverbs, connoisseur of wines, herald of the Hour called Mare-in-the-Tree.
visitors.description_cn: 谚语收录者，葡萄酒鉴赏家，被称为树中牝马的司辰之使节。

visitors.name: Ms Azita Bukhara
visitors.description: Businesswoman, chess-master, initiate of the scarred Hour sometimes called the Colonel.
visitors.description_cn: 商人，象棋大师，负疤司辰的门徒，这位司辰有时被称为上校。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'My move, then...'

visitors.name: Lalla Chaima
visitors.description: Huntress, goumier, occasional Bureau consultant. When it can't be killed, and it really needs killing, Chaima's the one they turn to.
visitors.description_cn: 猎人，古梅尔人，防剿局的临时顾问。有该杀但难杀的东西出现时，他们就会去找柴玛。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'And your weather. Your weather is also a disappointment.'

visitors.name: MCO Constance Lee
visitors.description: Connie has risen swiftly in the Suppression Bureau, to the exalted rank of Constable-Oculate Minor. Don't get in her way.
visitors.description_cn: 康妮在防剿局中晋升迅速，官至次级督察警监。别挡她的道。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'I can't believe we used to fund this place.'

visitors.name: Princess Coquille Amirejibi
visitors.name_cn: 贵胄科基尔·阿米雷吉比
visitors.description: Artist, socialite... burglar? An unspeakably charming woman with a particular knack for getting adopted.
visitors.description_cn: 艺术家，社会名流……窃贼？一位难以形容的迷人女性，在寻人收养自己上有特别的本领。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'Oh, sweetie. I'm not disappointed, just... well, perhaps I'm a little disappointed.'

visitors.name: Sr. Corso Reverte
visitors.description: Manuscript-hunter, legacy-scavenger... mercenary? Many would question his ethics; few would deny his acuteness.
visitors.description_cn: 原稿猎人，遗产搜刮人……雇佣兵？许多人会质疑他的道德操守；但少有人会否认他的洞察力。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'Well, I have other contacts...'

visitors.name: 'Daymare'
visitors.description: Gräfin Friederike Dagmar Sophia Theresia Helena Benigna von Nagelsburg, if you prefer. She doesn't.
visitors.description_cn: 若你愿意，可以唤她弗雷德里克·妲格玛·索菲亚·本奈娜·冯·纳戈尔斯堡女伯爵。不过这可不合她的意。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'Not to worry! Nice to get a bit of sea air.'

visitors.name: DI Douglas Moore
visitors.name_cn: 启明警探道格拉斯·摩尔
visitors.description: Detective-Illuminate of the Suppression Bureau. A stoic, but weary, fellow. His dearest wish is to move to Chingford and grow roses. But the buggers won't let him retire.
visitors.description_cn: 防剿局的启明警探。一个坚忍但疲惫的家伙。他最大的愿望是搬到清福德种些玫瑰。但那些混蛋不会让他退休。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'Well, mustn't grumble.'

visitors.name: Mr Ehsan Fekri
visitors.description: Formerly; Ehsan was a healer; he was not human; he was Secretary Salvant of Hush House. But not all at the same time. Fussy, kind, famously foul to look upon.
visitors.description_cn: 过去；埃桑曾是一位治疗者；他曾为非人之物；他曾是噤声居屋的护理理事。但以上情况并未同时存在过。过分操心，和蔼，丑得出奇。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'I know the House has been through hard times. But though much is taken, much abides, does it not? Another time.'

visitors.name: Lord Franklin Bancroft
visitors.name_cn: 富兰克林·班克罗夫特勋爵
visitors.description: Rakehell, dilettante, infuriating prodigy. Possibly dead, possibly real.
visitors.description_cn: 浪子，业余的学徒，令人恼火的天才。可能已经死了，可能真实存在。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'That's the bloody thing about bloody libraries.

visitors.name: Mr Fraser Strathcoyne
visitors.name_cn: 弗雷泽·斯特拉思科因先生
visitors.description: Philanthropist, collector, former Librarian. A complicated man, but not a cruel one.
visitors.description_cn: 慈善家、收藏家、前图书管理员。一位复杂的人，但并不残忍。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'This would not have happened in the time of the Curia of the Isle. Goodbye.'

visitors.name: Magister Hokobald
visitors.description: Metallurgist, gourmet, corrupted immortal. And, supposedly, a long-ago king's by-blow.
visitors.description_cn: 冶金学家，美食家，堕落的不朽者。而且，据推测，是一位很久之前的国王的私生子。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'Why is this damned place always so damned desperate to waste my damned time?'

visitors.name: Julian Coseley
visitors.description: Magus, Winter-long, controversial philosopher. For an immortal exalted by an Hour of Silence, especially one who might be dead, he has had a great deal to say for himself over the years.
visitors.description_cn: 术士，冬之长生者，充满争议的哲学家。作为由静默之司辰擢升的不朽者之一，特别是作为一位本应死去的存在，这些年来他攒了很多话要为自己辩说。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'Sometimes, the end comes sooner. Sometimes, there's no damned end to it at all.'

visitors.name: Mlle Margot Matutine
visitors.description: Socialite, yachtswoman... and, under the name 'Morgen', an alukite, a Ligeian. The former means, among other things, that she eats people. The latter means, among other things, that she is not to be taken lightly.
visitors.description_cn: 社交名媛，游艇主人……以及，以“摩根”之名出现时，一位阿卢卡，一位丽姬亚。前者的意思是，抛开其他不谈，她吃人。后者的意思是，抛开其他不谈，她也不容小觑。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'I arrive hungry. I leave famished. Someone will regret that... but not you, not today.'

visitors.name: Mme Olympe Bechet
visitors.description: Essayist, illustrator, critic. Editor of the Kerisham Review.
visitors.description_cn: 散文家，插画家，评论家。《凯尔伊苏姆评论报》的编辑。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'C'est la vie.'

visitors.name: Professor Rowena Hengerst
visitors.description: For many years, under many names, Rowena has done, learnt, or eaten many things she really shouldn't have. But for many years, under many names, she's served as the protectress of Hush House.
visitors.description_cn: 这么多年过去了，罗威娜以不同身份，做了很多不该做的，学了很多不该学的，吃了很多不该吃的。但任时间流转，无论在什么身份之下，罗威娜一直是噤声居屋的守护者。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: The Trust expects better...'

visitors.name: Dr Serena Blackwood
visitors.name_cn: 瑟雷娜·布莱克伍德博士
visitors.description: One-time Librarian of Hush House, one-time Librarian of the Invisible Serapeum in Alexandria, and currently... what, exactly? Serena is close-mouthed, but I know that she has worked with the St Rhonwen Trust.
visitors.description_cn: 一度是噤声居屋的图书管理员，一度是亚历山大港那隐形的塞拉皮雍的图书管理员，而近来……嗯，是什么呢？瑟雷娜口风很严，但我知道她和圣罗文信托有合作。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'So much has been lost, hasn't it? I don't envy you. Good luck.'

visitors.name: Fr. Stanislav John Schaller
visitors.name_cn: 斯坦尼斯拉夫·约翰·沙勒神父
visitors.description: Priest, diplomat, gardener: a soft-voiced man with a very steady gaze.
visitors.description_cn: 教士、外交官、园丁：一个声音柔和、目光坚定的人。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'As God wills, I suppose. (Don't ask me which God!)'

visitors.name: Dr Yvette Southey
visitors.description: Playwright, philologist, psychoanalyst: as happy with questions as with answers.
visitors.description_cn: 剧作家、语言学家、精神分析学家：对谜题与谜底同等喜爱。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: 'Perhaps I'll never understand...'

visitors.name: Mr Zachary Wakefield
visitors.name_cn: 扎迦利·韦克菲尔德先生
visitors.description: Marksman, detective, renegade. He has always been a quiet man, but since he left the Suppression Bureau, he has grown even quieter, and terribly still - except for his fingers and for his eyes, always in restless motion.
visitors.description_cn: 神射手，警探，叛党。他从来都是个沉默寡言的人，但自从离开防剿局之后，他变得更沉默了，安静得可怕——除了他那时刻观察着四周的眼睛和时刻保持紧绷的手指。

embarking_xexts.dissatisfying: Wakefield says nothing at all. But then, he seldom does.
'The Mare's blessings on you. And your Tree.'

weather.name: Snow
weather.description: The world is pale today. 'The White is west of the world, and winter does not wait forever', Solomon Husher once said.
weather.description_cn: 今日世界一片淡白。“纯白在世界以西，且冬不永待”，所罗门·赫舍曾言。

weather.name: Fog
weather.description_cn: 沿滩游雾——月色朦胧，海水晦暗。

weather.name: Hail
weather.description: Ice raps on the roofs and tree-tops.
weather.description_cn: 冰砾敲打着屋顶和树梢。

weather.name: Gale
weather.description: Trees bend, walls creak, travellers bend low against the blast.
weather.description_cn: 树木弯曲，墙壁吱吱作响，旅人弯腰以抵御风力。

weather.name: Sunny
weather.description: The Sun is not what it was, but today he is smiling.
weather.description_cn: 太阳不复往昔，但今日他露出了微笑。

weather.name: Clouds
weather.description: In this country the sky is rarely clear. The Sun goes courteously cloaked.
weather.description_cn: 在这个国家，天空很少是晴朗的。太阳得体地披上了斗篷。

weather.name: Earthquake
weather.description: The gentlest of earth tremors. Just to remind us that the earth is not dead but sleeping.
weather.description_cn: 大地最温和的颤动，仿佛只是为了提醒我们，大地并未死去，只是在沉睡。
